items.description: At Affirm , we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. We’re looking for a curious, driven professional to join our Revenue Analytics team. This builds and owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that power Affirm’s Revenue organization. As a Analyst at Revenue Analytics, you’ll build scalable data products that power day-to-day decision-making - owning end-to-end work across data modeling, metric definitions, dashboards, automation, and enablement. You’ll also help strengthen our semantic layer and data governance, laying the foundation for reliable AI. The ideal candidate combines strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into durable, well-tested data infrastructure. What you'll do Develop dbt data models, dashboards, metrics, and automation processes for the revenue field team and revenue analysts Build and maintain critical reporting data models that power external merchant reporting Build the semantic, metadata, and context layers that allow AI systems to accurately understand Revenue data, metrics, and business definitions Partner with Business Systems, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable, well-tested data products Contribute to the team’s best practices in version control, code review, documentation, and release hygiene (GitHub-based workflows) Develop processes, governance, and foundations to scale the impact of analytics within Revenue. What we look for 3+ years of work experience in an analytics engineering or business intelligence role Strong working knowledge of SQL, dbt, Python, data modeling, and data visualization Hands-on experience with BI tools (Sigma/Looker/Tableau), Databricks, and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake) Understanding of the data foundations required for reliable AI, including semantic layers, metadata, evals, metric definitions, documentation, and data quality Demonstrated experience integrating AI tools into day-to-day analytics engineering workflows to improve development speed, quality, and scalability Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial areas of the business Ability to identify user needs and translate them into robust, scalable data products Ability to start with an ambiguous problem, deconstruct it into tangible steps, and work toward an impactful solution Ability to communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Compensation and Benefits Base Pay Grade - K Equity Grade - 3 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range . Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents ). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company). We are able to offer visa sponsorship for this role, but do require that someone is based in Spain for the role. ESP base pay range per year: 63,000 - 99,000 EUR Additional benefits include: Type of employment: Contract of Employment Flexible Spending Wallets for tech, food and lifestyle Away Days - wellness days to take off work and recharge Learning & Development programs Parental benefits Employee Resource & Community Groups This role is eligible for creative tax benefits, subject to applicable law and company policy Location - Remote Spain The majority of our roles can be located anywhere in Spain. **This job description is not a contractual document, and is not intended to have binding force.** #LI-Remote Remote-first with flexibility built in Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience. Benefits designed for you Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights: Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents. Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you. Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to. Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount. We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help. For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law. By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

items.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
items.summary: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from…
items.description: About Carrot : Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com . The Opportunity Carrot is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our BI function as it scales to meet, and anticipate, the needs of the organization and its clients. This is an executional role providing essential analytics support across the company: you will gather requirements, field ad hoc and recurring data requests, and build the reporting dashboards that leaders across Carrot rely on to make decisions. You will work hands-on with modern data tooling, including SQL, dbt, and enterprise BI platforms, and partner with teams across the business to translate their questions into clear, trustworthy answers. The BI team is highly cross-functional and sits alongside Data Engineering, making this a strong opportunity to sharpen technical skills while building broad business context in a mission-driven environment. What You’ll Own In this role, you will: Design and build data models in SQL with a focus on correctness, clarity, and reusability Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track key business metrics and inform decision-making across the company Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer high-priority business questions from stakeholders across the organization Collaborate with teams across Carrot to understand their data domains, reporting needs, and success metrics Contribute to data quality, documentation, and self-service BI capabilities as the function scales What Success Looks Like In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Delivered accurate, well-documented dashboards and reports that stakeholders across the company trust and use regularly Fully ramped on Carrot's data stack and core data domains, independently owning recurring and ad hoc reporting requests Built strong working relationships with cross-functional partners and established yourself as a reliable analytics resource Improved turnaround and consistency of reporting by creating reusable data models and reducing manual work About You ✨ You likely have: A Bachelor's Degree Intermediate-to-advanced SQL experience: ability to write advanced queries using joins, common table expressions, and window/analytic functions Experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Looker, DOMO, or Power BI) to bring data insights to life for broad audiences Basic statistics proficiency: experiment design, hypothesis testing, statistical significance, probability, and distributions Ability to translate business intelligence needs from a variety of stakeholders into technical execution and clear presentation Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical information to non-technical audiences Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Experience using dbt to transform, test, and document data Experience working with healthcare industry data or in other complex, regulated data environments Experience in a high-growth environment Familiarity with version control systems (Git preferred) Understanding of effective data modeling strategies and implementations Why This Role Matters Data is central to how Carrot operates and grows. Leaders across the company depend on accurate, timely reporting to serve members, support customers, and make sound business decisions. As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will be the connective tissue between raw data and those decisions, ensuring the organization runs on insights it can trust. Your work directly supports Carrot's mission of expanding access to fertility and family-building care worldwide. Better data means better decisions for the members and customers who rely on Carrot every day. Interview Process We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team. For this role, candidates can expect: Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes Performance Task — 60 minutes Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role. Why Candidates Join Carrot Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. Highlights include: A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide. Compensation Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $98,000.00- $125,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com A Note on AI At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves. Why Carrot? Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

items.title: Data Analyst
items.summary: About the JobThe OpportunityAs a Data Analyst at Emetlab, you will turn data into decisions that shape the infrastructure behind elite AI training data.
items.description: About the Job The Opportunity As a Data Analyst at Emetlab , you will turn data into decisions that shape the infrastructure behind elite AI training data. Emetlab is an AI data infrastructure company delivering expert-produced, rigorously validated datasets and end-to-end AI solutions to frontier laboratories, Fortune 500 enterprises, ambitious startups, and sovereign AI programmes across the globe. In this role, you will uncover insights that drive operations, quality, and business strategy. You will analyse contributor performance, dataset quality metrics, production pipeline efficiency, and client delivery outcomes to help the team understand what is working, what is not, and where the greatest opportunities lie. Your work will directly inform how we maintain our 98%+ accuracy benchmark, how we scale our global contributor network, and how we deliver measurable results to clients. This is an opportunity to be the analytical backbone of a company whose entire value proposition is data excellence, where your insights will carry weight, influence direction, and ensure the quality standard that our clients depend on. What You'll Do Analyse contributor performance, production throughput, and quality assurance metrics to surface actionable insights that inform operations and growth decisions. Design and maintain dashboards, reports, and data visualisations that give leadership and cross-functional teams clarity on key metrics across datasets, contributors, and client delivery. Partner with Data Operations, Engineering, and Product teams to define success metrics, measure outcomes, and evaluate the impact of process improvements and platform changes. Conduct cohort analysis, segmentation, and trend analysis across our contributor network to identify opportunities for improving output quality, efficiency, and retention. Monitor and report on dataset quality benchmarks, identifying patterns in annotation accuracy, inter-annotator agreement, and domain-specific performance. Identify data quality issues, propose improvements to tracking and instrumentation, and ensure the integrity of the operational data we rely on. Translate complex analytical findings into clear, compelling narratives that non-technical stakeholders can act on with confidence. What You'll Need to Succeed 2+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related role within a technology or data-intensive organisation. Strong proficiency in SQL and experience working with analytics tools such as Python, R, Excel, or similar. Experience with data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or Metabase. A strong analytical mindset, comfortable working with large datasets, identifying patterns, and drawing meaningful conclusions. Experience thriving in fast-paced environments where you define the metrics and build the analytical infrastructure that the business relies on. Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to present data-driven insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. A collaborative disposition, comfortable working cross-functionally with Data Operations, Engineering, Product, and Quality Assurance teams. Genuine interest in AI, data quality, or machine learning infrastructure is highly valued. Role Details Employment Type: Full-Time and Part-Time positions available Location: Fully Remote Stage: Growth stage, operational About Emetlab Emetlab is an AI data infrastructure company built on a single conviction: the quality ceiling of any AI system is determined by its training data, not its architecture or compute. We produce expert-crafted, rigorously validated training datasets across 12 specialised domains, delivered by a global network of over 5,000 vetted domain specialists spanning 100+ languages and 50+ specialisations. Beyond datasets, we offer end-to-end AI solutions including Fine-Tuning, RLHF & Alignment, Red Teaming, Model Evaluation, Data Annotation, Synthetic Data Generation, and Pre-Training Data Pipelines. We are not a crowd-sourcing platform. We are the data partner that matches the ambition of the teams building the next generation of AI, delivering measurable results: 42% accuracy improvements, 3x faster time-to-production, and 99.4% regulatory precision. Equal Opportunity Emetlab is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome dedicated individuals regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We believe that extraordinary products are built by extraordinary teams, and extraordinary teams are built on inclusion, respect, and the understanding that brilliance has no single origin. If you require accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to our team and we will ensure your needs are met with care. Let's build the future of AI training data, together. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Manager, Data Quality Assurance
items.summary: Do you have a passion for children and education?
items.description: Do you have a passion for children and education? Would you like to positively impact families in need of help? We want to speak with you! Step Up For Students empowers families to pursue and engage in the most appropriate learning options for their children. JOB SUMMARY As a member of the Internal Assurance team, you will play a critical role in translating data governance and controls standards into audit and consulting projects that improve data trust and usability across the enterprise. This role will help ensure that downstream business processes, analytics, reporting, and AI initiatives consume accurate, complete, consistent and valid data by implementing data quality controls, enabling Cloud Data Governance & Catalog (CDGC) capabilities, and driving visibility through data quality metrics and scorecards. This role is hands-on and execution-focused, requiring close collaboration with data stewards, governance leads, data engineers, and application teams to proactively identify, resolve, and prevent data quality issues at scale. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES ◦ Team Translate business-defined data quality rules into technical implementations using techniques including, but not limited to, SQL validations, profiling rules, scorecards, and pipeline controls. ◦ Implement data validation, cleansing, and standardization across enterprise data domains to prevent invalid data from propagating downstream. ◦ Partner with functional teams to implement and monitor data quality controls across our master data domains. ◦ Execute enterprise data quality frameworks, including rule standardization, threshold management, and alignment to critical data elements (CDEs). ◦ Perform data profiling and validation activities, including completeness checks, duplicate analysis, pattern validation, referential integrity checks, and anomaly detection. ◦ Configure and support CDGC capabilities, including dataset onboarding, metadata ingestion, catalog enrichment, governed asset management, and business glossary mapping. ◦ Develop, enhance, and maintain data quality rule mapping, scorecards, dashboards, and data health visibility within CDGC and related reporting tools. ◦ Support CDE classification, governed data asset onboarding, and data product registration within CDGC and data marketplace. ◦ Support and validate technical and business data lineage across our master data, analytics, and downstream platforms for traceability and impact analysis. ◦ Perform root cause analysis (RCA) over data quality errors to identify if they stem from system bugs or user entries, validate fixes through regression testing, and recommend structural and upstream process improvements to prevent recurring issues. EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED: ◦ A minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Statistics or a related field; or 6 years of related experience with a Master's degree; or 3 years of related experience with a PhD; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. ◦ Hands-on experience in data quality, metadata management, master data management, data engineering, or governance-focused technical roles. ◦ Strong hands-on experience with Informatica CDGC, including metadata curation, dataset onboarding, catalog management, data quality rule mapping, and data quality visibility. ◦ Hands-on experience with Purview, Alation, Collibra, CluedIn, or similar data quality solutions for profiling, validation, rule implementation, scorecards, and monitoring. ◦ Strong working knowledge of master data domains, including customer, supplier, and finance, with experience supporting data quality, governance, and lifecycle management processes across ERP environments. ◦ Solid experience with scripting languages (Python or R) for automation. ◦ Familiarity with ETL tools, data profiling software, or cloud data warehouses (e.g., Azure Data Stack, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks). ◦ Experience working with business glossaries, CDEs, data lineage, and governed metadata management. ◦ Strong SQL skills and experience querying databases, developing or supporting ETL, Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC), and SQL-based data pipelines. ◦ Experience performing data profiling, data validation, issue investigation, RCA, regression testing, and remediation tracking. ◦ Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder collaboration skills. ◦ Experience in translating complex, technical data errors into actionable insights for nontechnical stakeholders. PREFERRED: ◦ Experience with enterprise master data management initiatives. ◦ Experience building or supporting data quality scorecards and dashboards using Power BI or similar visualization platforms. ◦ Experience with cloud data platforms such as SILK, Azure Data Stack, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, or equivalent modern data environments. ◦ Familiarity with master data management (MDM) concepts including match/merge, survivorship, validation rules, and reference data management. ◦ Experience supporting data product enablement, self-service analytics, or data marketplace initiatives. ◦ Basic scripting experience using Python, Spark, or related technologies. KEY COMPETENCIES ◦ Data Quality Management: Ensures data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity through the implementation of data quality controls, validation rules, monitoring, and remediation processes. ◦ Data Governance: Supports enterprise data governance practices by maintaining data standards, metadata, business glossaries, critical data elements (CDEs), and data lineage to improve trust and usability. ◦ Technical & Analytical Expertise: Applies SQL, data profiling tools, governance platforms, and analytical techniques to identify issues, evaluate data health, and implement effective solutions. ◦ Root Cause Analysis & Problem Solving: Investigates data quality issues, identifies underlying causes, validates corrective actions, and drives sustainable process improvements to prevent recurrence. ◦ Reporting & Data Visualization: Develops and maintains data quality metrics, scorecards, dashboards, and reporting tools that provide visibility into data health and governance performance. ◦ Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partners effectively with data stewards, engineers, governance leaders, and business stakeholders to implement data quality initiatives and achieve organizational objectives. ◦ Communication & Influence: Communicates complex technical concepts and data issues clearly to diverse audiences, driving understanding, accountability, and adoption of best practices. ◦ Continuous Improvement: Identifies opportunities to enhance data quality, governance processes, and operational efficiency through ongoing evaluation, innovation, and process optimization. CORE VALUES Step Up For Students believes strongly in two key core values to carry out their mission of “We empower families to pursue and engage in the most appropriate learning options for their children.”: ◦ Everyone is an asset. ◦ Every event is an improvement opportunity. To maintain a positive and effective organizational culture, employees are expected to demonstrate these two core values in their everyday work. WORKING CONDITIONS & EQUIPMENT USE ◦ Work is performed indoors in a typical office environment - not substantially exposed to adverse environmental conditions. ◦ Must be able to lift up to fifteen (15) pounds. ◦ Frequent use of office machines to include telephone, computer, and printer. Step Up For Students is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity & inclusion in the workplace. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Main purpose of role The Business Intelligence Analyst is responsible for transforming complex data into actionable insights that support client-facing strategic decision-making and operational efficiency. This role ensures accurate client-facing analytics, maintains analytical tools, and drives data-driven improvements across client and internal initiatives. Key responsibilities Collaborate with program management office to ensure the accurate and timely production of monthly, quarterly, and annual client reports. Complete complex ad-hoc reports to support client requests. Learn and apply effective use of Vendor Management Systems (VMS) such as Fieldglass, Beeline, VNDLY, and Coupa, including report preparation and data utilization. Analyze data from multiple sources to deliver meaningful insights, recommendations, and conclusions that drive client’s business decisions. Maintain and update team tools and documentation to ensure consistency and accuracy of information. Stay informed on industry trends and customer benchmarks to provide relevant analysis on a quarterly basis within assigned verticals. Design and enhance client-facing Power BI dashboards using API integrations to improve data visualization and accessibility. Manage and update client-facing Microsoft Power Pages to ensure current and accurate content. Design and implement automation for client production reports and related workflows to reduce manual effort. Create rate cards for new clients Run market rate analysis requests Skills required for the role Power BI expertise SQL and/or Python proficiency Data visualization capabilities Analytical and critical thinking Attention to detail and accuracy Advanced Excel skills Organizational and problem-solving skills Time management Data gathering from various sources Team collaboration Verbal, written, and presentation skills Educational Requirements Bachelor’s Degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics or Mathematics Experience Minimum of 3 years of experience in business intelligence, data analysis, or market research roles. Proven hands-on experience with Power BI and SQL for data visualization and querying. Familiarity with data warehouse technologies, data modeling concepts, and working with diverse data sources and APIs. items.title: Product Analyst
items.summary: StellarTech is a rapidly growing company at the forefront of innovation in the EdTech industry.
items.description: StellarTech is a rapidly growing company at the forefront of innovation in the EdTech industry. Our team is focused on building scalable products and sustainable business models that shape the future of education. We are looking for a Product Analyst to join our Platform Development Team. Working hand-in-hand with the Product Manager, you will build product analytics for our core platform from the ground up - and become the person who understands user behavior on the platform better than anyone else. What You'll Do: Build product analytics for the core platform together with the Product Manager: define key metrics, events, funnels, and approaches to evaluating user experience. Design and maintain the event tracking framework - ensuring data is complete, consistent, and trusted across product and technical teams. Identify insights across user journeys, segments, and platform usage scenarios - and automate their regular discovery. Create and evolve dashboards, alerts, and analytics infrastructure used by product and engineering teams for day-to-day decisions. Support product hypotheses with data: validate ideas, evaluate feature impact, and help prioritize the roadmap with evidence. Translate user behavior into clear, actionable recommendations and help teams across the company make data-driven decisions. We're Looking For: 6-8 years of experience as a Product Analyst / Data Analyst in a product IT company (B2C platforms, SaaS, or marketplaces are a plus). Strong SQL skills and confident work with large datasets. Hands-on experience with product analytics tools (Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4, or similar) and BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar). Solid understanding of product metrics: activation, retention, conversion, funnels, cohorts, and unit-level user behavior. Experience designing event taxonomies and setting up tracking from scratch or significantly evolving an existing setup. Experience with A/B testing and a working knowledge of statistics for experiment evaluation. Ability to turn ambiguous product questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations. Nice to Have: Python or R for analysis and automation of recurring insights. Experience working with platform/infrastructure products or technical stakeholders (engineers, architects). Experience building analytics processes in a team where analytics did not exist before. Strong communication skills: ability to articulate findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Proactive, problem-solving mindset - comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Why You'll Love Working With Us: Innovative Environment: We're all about trying new things and pushing the envelope in EdTech. We are global remote. Health: company-provided medical expense compensation. AI solutions: AI subscription and other tools. Balance: Flexible paid time off - 21 days of annual leave + 10 bank holidays. Collaborative Culture: Work alongside passionate professionals who are as driven as you are. --- Hiring Process: 1. Recruiter screen 2. Technical Interview 3. Hiring Manager Interview Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Payments Data Analyst
items.summary: Our team is developing a payment gateway for accepting funds from users on behalf of merchants, as well as sending funds from merchants to users.
items.description: Our team is developing a payment gateway for accepting funds from users on behalf of merchants, as well as sending funds from merchants to users. The system involves storing user payment data and is subject to PCI DSS compliance. It contains multiple integrations with payment systems, providers, and other gateways and processors, including 3DS.We're looking for a Payments Data Analyst to join our Product team and transform payment and product data into actionable insights that improve merchant success, platform performance, and business decisions. As a Payments Data Analyst, you will be a strategic partner to the Product, Merchant Solutions, Processor Integrations, and ML teams, helping drive data-informed decisions across our payment platform. You will analyze payment performance, identify trends and optimization opportunities, evaluate the impact of product initiatives, and provide recommendations that improve approval rates, payment efficiency, and merchant experience. Job Responsibilities: Monitor, analyze, and optimize payment performance across merchants, processors, payment methods, and markets. Analyze approval rates, decline patterns, payment routing performance, retry and cascading effectiveness, 3DS performance, and transaction success. Perform deep-dive analyses to identify trends, anomalies, and optimization opportunities across processors, card schemes, BINs, countries, merchants, and payment methods. Measure the impact of new product features, processor integrations, routing changes, payment optimization initiatives, and A/B experiments. Build and maintain dashboards and reports that provide actionable insights for Product, Merchant Solutions, Executive, and other business teams. Define, monitor, and improve key product and payment KPIs. Investigate merchant and processor performance to identify root causes and recommend improvements. Collaborate with Product Managers to support product discovery, feature prioritization, and success measurement. Work closely with Solution Engineers, Integration Analysts, and the ML Specialist to improve payment performance and operational efficiency. Support continuous monitoring of payment performance by identifying anomalies, emerging trends, and opportunities for optimization. Present analytical findings and recommendations in a clear, business-oriented manner to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Requirements You’ll thrive here if you have 4+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Product Analyst, Payments Analyst, or in a similar analytical role. Advanced SQL skills, including complex queries and window functions. Experience with BI tools such as Metabase, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar. Experience with Python (Pandas, Jupyter Notebook) for data analysis. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Experience working with large datasets. Ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations. Nice to Have Experience in FinTech, Payments, SaaS, or E-commerce. Understanding of payment processing, payment orchestration, or PSP integrations. Knowledge of payment routing, retries, cascading, and 3DS authentication. Familiarity with payment KPIs such as approval rate, conversion rate, authorization rate, and decline analysis. Understanding of fraud-related metrics, chargebacks, RDR, and risk signals. Experience working with product analytics, experimentation, and feature adoption metrics. Basic understanding of Machine Learning concepts. Conditions We know that great talent deserves great conditions, so here’s what you can expect when joining us: Full remote work. Competitive compensation with a service contract. Transparent performance reviews twice a year, with bonus opportunities and salary adjustments. An annual allowance that you can use for home office improvements, sports activities, equipment upgrades, and more—tailor it to what benefits you most. Investment in your development: paid language courses, access to various learning platforms, and a mindfulness benefit, including psychological support with 50% coverage. Career growth in a fast-scaling project with opportunities to influence technical decisions. A culture of recognition: our peer reward program celebrates contributions from across the team. This opportunity is also available for those who already live in Limassol, Cyprus. EU-based employment contract and a 3-year Cyprus work visa. Private medical insurance for you and your family, a corporate mobile plan (unlimited in Cyprus with roaming included), and interest-free support for car purchases. 50% coverage of school and kindergarten fees for your children. Fully covered sports benefits, and also access to in-house electric scooters and bike rentals. A fully equipped office in Limassol’s city center, with everything you need for deep work and collaboration. Free catering in the office and an in-house coffee bar with high-quality drinks and a health bar stocked with nutritious snacks. Benefits are provided in accordance with the company’s policies and eligibility criteria. Recruitment process HR interview (40 min); Technical interview (1 hour); Final interview (1 hour); Recommendations check; Job Offer. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Lead Data Engineer- Healthcare Interoperability
items.summary: Lead Data Engineer- Healthcare Interoperability We are seeking an experienced Lead Data Engineer to join our healthcare technology team with a primary focus on healthcare interoperability.
items.description: Lead Data Engineer- Healthcare Interoperability We are seeking an experienced Lead Data Engineer to join our healthcare technology team with a primary focus on healthcare interoperability. This role will be instrumental in designing, building, and maintaining our Azure-based data infrastructure, including databases, data pipelines, analytics platforms, and business intelligence solutions — with an emphasis on integrating with Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and healthcare data exchange standards (FHIR, C-CDA, HL7). The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in the Microsoft data stack, strong architectural thinking, and experience with healthcare data compliance requirements. This senior-level position will also provide technical leadership, mentorship to the broader engineering team and reports to the Director of Data Engineering. Duties & Responsibilities: Design and implement scalable, secure data architectures on Azure to support business intelligence, analytics, and operational systems Build and maintain data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse and related services Contribute to database designs across multiple platforms (Azure SQL Database, SQL Managed Instance, PostgreSQL, CosmosDB) Optimize data storage strategies across Azure Blob Storage, Data Lake, and structured databases Design data models and structures that enable efficient analytics and reporting Design, develop, and maintain complex items.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
items.summary: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life.
items.description: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at . The Opportunity 🚀 Carrot is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our BI function as it scales to meet, and anticipate, the needs of the organization and its clients. This is an executional role providing essential analytics support across the company: you will gather requirements, field ad hoc and recurring data requests, and build the reporting dashboards that leaders across Carrot rely on to make decisions. You will work hands-on with modern data tooling, including SQL, dbt, and enterprise BI platforms, and partner with teams across the business to translate their questions into clear, trustworthy answers. The BI team is highly cross-functional and sits alongside Data Engineering, making this a strong opportunity to sharpen technical skills while building broad business context in a mission-driven environment. What You’ll Own 💼 In this role, you will: Design and build data models in SQL with a focus on correctness, clarity, and reusability Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track key business metrics and inform decision-making across the company Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer high-priority business questions from stakeholders across the organization Collaborate with teams across Carrot to understand their data domains, reporting needs, and success metrics Contribute to data quality, documentation, and self-service BI capabilities as the function scales What Success Looks Like 📈 In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Delivered accurate, well-documented dashboards and reports that stakeholders across the company trust and use regularly Fully ramped on Carrot's data stack and core data domains, independently owning recurring and ad hoc reporting requests Built strong working relationships with cross-functional partners and established yourself as a reliable analytics resource Improved turnaround and consistency of reporting by creating reusable data models and reducing manual work About You ✨ You likely have: A Bachelor's Degree Intermediate-to-advanced SQL experience: ability to write advanced queries using joins, common table expressions, and window/analytic functions Experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Looker, DOMO, or Power BI) to bring data insights to life for broad audiences Basic statistics proficiency: experiment design, hypothesis testing, statistical significance, probability, and distributions Ability to translate business intelligence needs from a variety of stakeholders into technical execution and clear presentation Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical information to non-technical audiences Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Experience using dbt to transform, test, and document data Experience working with healthcare industry data or in other complex, regulated data environments Experience in a high-growth environment Familiarity with version control systems (Git preferred) Understanding of effective data modeling strategies and implementations Why This Role Matters 🧡 Data is central to how Carrot operates and grows. Leaders across the company depend on accurate, timely reporting to serve members, support customers, and make sound business decisions. As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will be the connective tissue between raw data and those decisions, ensuring the organization runs on insights it can trust. Your work directly supports Carrot's mission of expanding access to fertility and family-building care worldwide. Better data means better decisions for the members and customers who rely on Carrot every day. Interview Process 🤝 We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team. For this role, candidates can expect: Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes Performance Task — 60 minutes Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role. Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍 Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. Highlights include: A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide. Compensation 💰 Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $98,000.00- $125,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: A Note on AI At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves. Why Carrot? Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: KPI Architect
items.summary: The KPI Architect Role in Exelab’s Tailor-Made SolutionsAt Exelab, we don’t sell a single off-the-shelf product – we build custom, innovative solutions that directly target our clients’ unique business objectives.
items.description: The KPI Architect Role in Exelab’s Tailor-Made Solutions At Exelab, we don’t sell a single off-the-shelf product – we build custom, innovative solutions that directly target our clients’ unique business objectives. Each client engagement is essentially treated as a mini product development cycle: we start from a specific business goal or problem and craft a tailor-made solution (which might involve software, AI models, systems integration, etc.) to deliver measurable business impact. In Exelab’s methodological framework, performance and measurability of results become central elements of every project. The KPI Architect is the cross-functional figure who ensures rigor, consistency, and depth in performance analysis across all Value projects – the high-impact strategic initiatives at the core of Exelab’s offering. This role is not a traditional data analyst: it's a professional who combines advanced analytical skills with deep business understanding. Someone who knows that numbers tell stories, but only when you ask the right questions. The mission : ensure every project starts with clear objectives, defined measurement criteria, and a monitoring system that reveals whether actions are generating expected impact. The KPI Architect operates across multiple projects, intervening during discovery phases to define measurement frameworks, supporting Value Builders on complex analytical challenges, and verifying the impact of deployed solutions. Reporting directly to the General Manager, maintain an overview of performance across the entire project portfolio. In day-to-day operations, Value Builders must be autonomous in analyzing their project data. The KPI Architect intervenes when defining methodological frameworks, tackling complex analytical challenges, or ensuring client alignment on success criteria. Key Responsibilities The KPI Architect will ensure measurability and objectivity across our AI-enabled solutions. Core responsibilities include: Measurement Framework Definition: Collaborate with Value Builders and Project Managers during discovery phases to define how each project’s success will be measured. Translate vague business objectives into concrete, measurable, and actionable KPIs. Establish baselines, targets, and evaluation criteria that enable objective determination of whether an initiative has generated value. Create reusable templates and methodologies that accelerate this phase on future projects. Client Alignment on Objectives: Facilitate structured conversations with clients to ensure clarity and alignment on success criteria. Clients often have implicit or poorly defined expectations: the KPI Architect makes them explicit, quantifies them, and transforms them into shared agreements. This alignment prevents misunderstandings and creates the foundation for partnerships based on objective results. Complex Analytical Challenge Support: Intervene when Value Builders face analytical problems requiring specialized skills or advanced methodologies. This may involve multi-touch attribution analysis, predictive modeling, advanced segmentation, or interpretation of particularly complex datasets. Bring methodological expertise and work directly on the data alongside the Value Builder. Solution Impact Verification: After deployment, dive into the data to verify whether solutions are generating expected impact. Build the analyses personally, distinguish correlations from causality, identify confounding variables, and build rigorous analyses that enable correct attribution of results. When numbers don’t add up, propose course corrections based on concrete evidence. Purpose-Driven Analysis: Every analysis has a clear purpose and consequent action. Don’t produce reports for the sake of producing them: every insight must translate into a decision or action. Know when data is sufficient to decide and when deeper investigation is needed. Avoid analysis paralysis while maintaining focus on business value. Knowledge Building & Methodological Standards: Build and maintain Exelab’s analytical standards. Document methodologies, create templates, develop best practices that enable the organization to continuously improve analysis quality. Train Value Builders on fundamental analytical competencies, raising the team’s overall level. Portfolio View & Pattern Recognition: Thanks to the cross-functional position, identify patterns emerging across multiple projects. Recognize recurring problems, reusable solutions, reference benchmarks. This portfolio view feeds Exelab’s knowledge base and accelerates future projects. In summary, the KPI Architect is the guardian of measurability and objectivity at Exelab. This role ensures every project starts with clear objectives, proceeds with rigorous monitoring, and concludes with impact verification. The work transforms the promise of "measurable value" from a marketing claim into demonstrable reality. Requirements Ideal Candidate Profile – Skills and Experience Our ideal candidate is a professional with a rare combination: technical excellence in data analysis combined with deep understanding of business dynamics . It’s not enough to know how to manipulate data – you need to know which questions to ask and how to translate answers into valuable actions. Below are the key characteristics and qualifications we expect: Advanced Analytical Skills: Mastery of data analysis tools and methodologies: SQL, Python/R for statistical analysis, BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI). Comfort with statistical analysis: significance testing, regression analysis, cohort analysis, A/B testing methodology. Ability to work with large datasets and heterogeneous sources. Experience building dashboards and monitoring systems. Business Acumen & Strategic Orientation: Deep understanding of how businesses work and which metrics truly matter. Experience with KPIs typical of customer-facing contexts: conversion rate, customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, churn, NPS. Ability to link operational metrics to financial impact. Skill in translating vague business objectives into concrete, measurable indicators. Critical Thinking & Methodological Rigor: Scientific approach to analysis: formulate hypotheses, test them, evaluate evidence with constructive skepticism. Distinguish correlation from causality and identify biases and confounding variables. Don’t settle for the first interpretation: dig until finding the correct explanation. At the same time, know when data is “good enough” to decide. Communication & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional ability to communicate complex insights clearly and actionably. Adapt the message to the audience: executive summary for C-level, methodological detail for technical teams. Skill in facilitating difficult conversations about success criteria, managing expectations and building alignment. Consulting or Multi-Project Experience: Background in environments involving multiple projects/clients in parallel. May come from consulting firms, agencies, or analytics roles in strongly data-oriented companies. Experience across diverse contexts develops pattern recognition and adaptability. Familiarity with CRM and marketing technology is a significant plus. Autonomy & Proactivity: Ability to operate with minimal supervision, proactively identifying where their intervention can create value. Don’t wait for problems to arrive: anticipate analytical needs and step forward. Manage own time across multiple projects, prioritizing based on impact. AI Openness & Continuous Learning: Willingness to learn and use AI tools to enhance analytical activities. Intellectual curiosity and drive for continuous improvement. Data analysis evolves rapidly: we’re looking for someone who embraces this change as opportunity. Native Italian and at least B2-level English required. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Data Scientist, Ad Network (global)
items.summary: beehiiv is the all-in-one newsletter and creator platform powering the next generation of media companies and independent voices.
items.description: beehiiv is the all-in-one newsletter and creator platform powering the next generation of media companies and independent voices. We help creators and businesses launch, grow, and monetize newsletters—now serving tens of thousands of publishers and reaching hundreds of millions of readers monthly. With $30M+ ARR, 100% YoY growth, and a newly expanded product suite (ad network, website builder, paid tiers), we’re entering our next phase of hypergrowth. We are looking for a Data Scientist to bring a rigorous, data-driven approach to our Ad Network team. This role will have a variety of responsibilities across all things data with respect to the ad network, such as BI reporting, analytics, database modeling, entity resolution, graph database modeling, and clustering. You will be driving insights and data pipelines that help us grow and optimize our network for both publishers and advertisers. You will work cross-functionally with Business Leaders, Engineering, and Machine Learning Engineers to identify friction points and surface opportunities and actionable insights. You will help build the data model to power all of this. This is a hybrid role between a Product Data Analyst who works closely with business stakeholders and senior leadership, and someone who can own the Ad Network Data Stack across data modeling, reporting, analysis, and some machine learning. Compensation will be based on skill set, experience, and location. Ideally, this candidate can work EST hours. Ideally, you will have: 3+ years of experience as a highly technical Data Analyst, Data Scientist, or Data Engineer Excellent SQL skills and experience working with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Mode, Metabase, or similar). Experience with R or Python, conducting data-driven research and statistical analysis ( linear regression, k-means clustering) Experience with experimentation methodologies (A/B testing, multivariate testing). Experience with database data modeling to power reporting and analysis Experience with SQL ETL tools to define and materialize KPIs Exceptional ability to translate complex data into actionable insights and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences. Nice-to-Have: You have worked in Ad Tech or Marketing before ClickHouse or another OLAP database Experience building Entity Resolution systems or models Experience with Graph Databases Creator economy or SaaS experience is a plus What you'll be responsible for: Partner with Product Managers and Business Leaders to proactively define and track key success metrics and KPIs (CPC, CPA, CPM, etc.). Build and maintain dashboards and reporting to track campaign performance, network adoption, and impact of new advertisers and campaigns. Own and build out our Clickhouse data model with respect to the ad network. Design and implement aggregation tables to support ML, reporting, and in-app dashboarding. Proactively design and conduct deep-dive analyses to uncover patterns and pain points. Translate data findings into clear recommendations to influence product roadmap and prioritization. Monitor data flows for issues and anomalies - often caused by misconfigurations. Analyze network health to ensure we balance publisher payouts and advertiser value. Recommend tweaks to improve this balance. Collaborate with Engineering and Data teams to improve event tracking, instrumentation, and data quality. Build out a beehiiv universal entity resolution system in collaboration with other engineers Maintain and expand our advertiser conversion attribution logic Design and build a potential 1st-party subscriber enrichment product using interaction data across beehiiv products. Work with ML on running Brand Lift A/B test studies Why this role might be for you: You're a strategic operator with hands-on executional chops. You're comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-paced environments. You're obsessed with customer outcomes and accelerating company growth. You're a clear, concise communicator and can develop cohesive, data-driven narratives verbally and in writing. Why this role might not be for you: Not a traditional 9-to-5 position Need to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders Not comfortable with rapid iteration and frequent context switching High expectations for both speed and quality Must navigate complex organizational dynamics Why beehiiv ? Our values aren't a poster on the wall — they're the bar. It’s how we operate, publicly and privately, and what we should return to when making decisions. That’s how we keep our team's momentum. That’s how we hire and keep A players. beehiiv ’s values. There's no room for B players ⭐: the best makes everyone better. Maniacal sense of urgency ⚡: speed is our superpower. Say what you think with positive intent 💬: disagree openly and give hard feedback directly, with the intent to help someone improve. User-obsessed 🐝: every decision starts with one question: how does this add value for the user? Ego comes second, winning comes first 🏆: we're here to create the best outcome; the team comes before the individual. We'll take care of you: Competitive salary Stock options Health, dental, and vision Insurance 401(k) employer match Unlimited PTO (mandatory 10 days per year minimum) Annual in-person team offsite Unlimited book budget Monthly Wellness Days (every third Friday of the month) Salary: USD 120,000-220,000 (dependent on experience) Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand. Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence. About this role: As a Product Analyst at Liftoff, you'll turn complex data into rigorous analysis that informs product decisions across our machine learning-powered platform. You'll own the analytical needs of your product team end to end: identifying the right questions, executing the analysis, and presenting results that shape what gets built. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Machine Learning Engineers to define success metrics, evaluate experiments, and understand the drivers of user behavior and advertising performance. Responsibilities: Source, scope, execute, and present analyses for your product team, working independently from question to recommendation. Partner with Product Managers and ML teams to define and monitor key success metrics for product features. Design, analyze, and interpret A/B tests and other experiments with statistical rigor. Build and maintain dashboards and reports that enable transparent, self-service monitoring of product performance. Develop reusable SQL, analytical notebooks, and lightweight frameworks, including LLM-assisted workflows, to streamline recurring analyses. Investigate unexpected changes in product or business performance and clearly communicate findings and recommendations. Build a strong working knowledge of Liftoff's core data tables, your product area, and the wider product suite. Collaborate with Data Scientists and Data Engineers to ensure data quality, metric consistency, and reliable instrumentation. Document analytical approaches, assumptions, and methodologies to support reproducibility. Other duties as assigned. Requirements: 5+ years of experience in analytics Strong SQL skills and proficiency in Python for data analysis. Experience delivering analytical projects independently, from scoping through to presentation. Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical results to both technical and non-technical audiences. Familiarity with BI and visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Hex, or similar). Degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Location: This role is eligible for full-time remote work in one of our entities in the Pacific Time Zone: California, Nevada, Oregon, and Washington (State). Travel Expectations: We offer several opportunities for in-person team gatherings, including but not limited to project meetings, regional meetups, and company-wide events. We expect our employees to attend these gatherings at least once per quarter. These gatherings provide essential opportunities for collaboration, communication, and team building. Compensation: Liftoff offers all employees a full compensation package that includes equity and health/vision/dental benefits associated with your country of residence. Base compensation will vary based on the candidate's location and experience. The following are our base salary ranges for this role: SF Bay Area, Los Angeles/Orange County, Seattle : $137,000 - $170,000 All other California, Nevada, Oregon, Washington state locations: $126,000 - $156,000 #LI-REMOTE Liftoff offers a fast-paced, collaborative, and innovative work environment where employees are empowered to grow and make an impact. We’re shaping the future of the mobile app ecosystem—join us and help accelerate what’s next. Liftoff’s compensation strategy includes competitive salaries, equity, and benefits designed to support employee well-being and performance. items.title: Senior Finance Business Partner
items.summary: MGID is a global native advertising platform that helps brands reach unique local audiences at scale.
items.description: MGID is a global native advertising platform that helps brands reach unique local audiences at scale. At MGID , we empower brands and publishers to collaborate transparently through our privacy-first targeting technology. This enables advertisers to drive performance and awareness while allowing publishers to retain and monetize their audiences. Today, we’re creating innovative technologies, and with your help, we aim to reach even greater heights. We are looking for a Senior Finance Business Partner to join our newly established FP&A function and help transform financial planning and business decision-making across MGID . Working closely with business leaders, you will drive commercial insights, improve profitability and cash flow, and play a key role in implementing strategic financial initiatives, including a new prepayments policy. What you will do: Strategic Business Partnering & Commercial Governance Executive Co-Pilot: Serve as the primary commercial advisor to department heads (Publishing, Partnerships, Sales, Operations), translating complex financial realities into actionable strategic choices. Constructive Challenge: Actively evaluate business cases, hiring plans, and commercial assumptions. Ensure commercial decisions are backed by rigorous ROI data. Investment & ROI Evaluation: Support the financial appraisal, scenario planning, and business case framework for major new strategic initiatives, product launches, and capital deployment. Architecture, Financial Modelling & Budgeting P&L & Forecast: Support business leaders and the FP&A team in preparing rolling forecasts and annual budgets, ensuring alignment with business priorities. Driver-Based Forecasting: Build and optimize dynamic financial models that clearly link non-financial operational drivers (e.g., traffic, CPM, CPC, etc) directly to financial outcomes (revenue, margin, cash). Unit Economics Mastery: Lead deep-dive analyses into company profitability, pricing strategies. Data Infrastructure & BI Collaboration Metric Standardisation: Partner with the Business Intelligence (BI) and Data Engineering teams to build automated, scalable single-source-of-truth data models. Dashboard Evolution: Help transition the business away from individual dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Looker, PowerBI) to integrated ones. Requirements Who you are: 7+ years of experience in finance, FP&A, or Finance Business Partnering - ideally in a digital, adtech, marketplace, SaaS, or platform business. Experience building or significantly transforming processes, not just maintaining them. Strong in financial analysis, large datasets, Excel, and financial modelling. Able to explain complex financial topics clearly to non-financial stakeholders and work across functions. Combines strategic thinking with a hands-on, practical approach - comfortable working in an environment where processes are still being built. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field. Will be a plus: Experience with BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar. Professional certification: ACCA, CFA, CIMA, or similar. Big Four background. Experience working with two-sided business models or marketplace economics. Languages proficiency: Fluent English, Ukrainian At MGID , we thrive on innovation , collaboration , and a passion for AdTech . Our culture is built on openness , transparency , and a s hared drive for excellence . We empower our teams to take bold steps, embrace challenges, and grow together in a dynamic, people-first environment. Here, your ideas matter, your contributions are valued, and your potential has no limits. Join us and shape the future of digital advertising ! By submitting your application, you confirm that you have read and understand the MGID Careers Privacy Notice and understand that your personal data will be processed for recruitment purposes as part of this application. You have the right to access, rectify, or erase your data, as well as to object to its processing. We want you to be in control of your personal data. You can request data correction or request to be deleted from our database. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Senior Data Analytics Engineer
items.summary: SUMMARYThe Senior Data Analytics Engineer is responsible for developing and maintaining analytical models, dashboards, and data products that surface meaningful intelligence across the organization.
items.description: SUMMARY The Senior Data Analytics Engineer is responsible for developing and maintaining analytical models, dashboards, and data products that surface meaningful intelligence across the organization. Additionally, this role partners closely with application development, data engineering, and business teams to deliver scalable, well-governed analytics solutions aligned with regulatory and client requirements in the financial services industry. TECHNOLOGY STACK Snowflake Data Cloud. Microsoft SQL Server and advanced SQL. Power BI (report development, data modeling, and deployment). ETL/ELT frameworks and data pipelines. Microsoft Azure. Data governance, security, and access control tooling. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES Designs, develops, and maintains Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic data models that support operational and executive decision-making. Builds and maintains statistical models, trend analyses, and forecasting tools to support fund administration workflows and client reporting. Ensures data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across reporting outputs by partnering with governance and quality initiatives. Documents analytical methodologies, data definitions, report logic, and model assumptions to support transparency and auditability. Monitors and optimizes Power BI and Snowflake query performance to ensure efficient, reliable report delivery. Stays current with emerging trends and capabilities in data science, analytics engineering, and business intelligence tooling. WORKING RELATIONSHIPS Provides analytical guidance and mentorship to internal teams consuming data products. Partners with business stakeholders to gather requirements, defines KPIs, and translates analytical needs into scalable data products. Collaborates with technology team members to influence the design of data pipelines and structures that support analytics and reporting use cases. Mentors associates through instruction, coaching, providing real-time on-the-job experiences, modeling effective practices, and advising on methods used. May perform other duties as required and assigned. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE 3+ years of experience in data science, analytics engineering, or business intelligence, with strong hands on development and deployment of Power BI reports and data models in production environments. Experience querying and working with data in Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms, along with Power BI Service administration, low level security, and enterprise scale deployment. Financial services experience, ideally supporting fund administration or asset management platforms. KNOWLEDGE ETL/ELT tools and modern data engineering frameworks. Regulatory and compliance considerations related to financial data. Statistical analysis, data wrangling, and exploratory data analysis techniques. Machine learning or predictive modeling techniques applied to business use cases. Microsoft Office Suite. Adobe Acrobat. SKILLS AND ABILITIES Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong attention to data accuracy, with experience implementing data validation and quality checks. contributing to or defining enterprise analytics standards and data strategy. Aligns associates with company values and goals. Plans and delegates the work of others. Motivates and inspires others. Assesses the performance of self and associates to make improvements or take corrective action. Plans and develops systems and procedures to improve operating quality and efficiency of department in accordance with company policies and procedures. Troubleshoots issues utilizing creative and critical thinking skills. Multitasking, analytical, and organizational skills. Initiative-taking, strategic, and meticulous approaches with a strong commitment to quality, efficiency, and effectiveness. Demonstrates personal integrity, responsibility, and accountability. Effectively uses resources such as time and information in conjunction with associates. Participates in solving problems and making decisions. Presents and expresses ideas and information, written and oral, clearly, and concisely. Actively listens to others to achieve understanding and supports an open exchange of ideas and information. Identifies needs, arranges for, and obtains resources to accomplish individual and department goals. Establishes and develops effective working relationships with associates and clientele during both favorable and unfavorable situations. Modifies team and individual priorities and deadlines in response to added information, changing conditions, or unexpected obstacles and ensures completion. Equivalent education, experience, and KSA’s will be considered. Ultimus is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of the applicant’s or employee’s race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, citizenship or any other status entitled to protection under federal, state or local anti-discrimination laws.
