items.description: Orchid Software Solutions | Remote, Latin America | Full-time contract About us Orchid Software Solutions builds and operates software for healthcare and family-building services. Our products cover escrow for surrogacy and egg donation, agency management for fertility clinics, medical records retrieval, insurance risk management, and independent dispute resolution for healthcare payments under the federal No Surprises Act. Our engineering team is distributed across the United States and Latin America, with a few colleagues further afield. We work remotely, in writing, and across time zones. About the role This is our first dedicated data and business intelligence role. You will own reporting end to end: the data model, the metric definitions, the dashboards our operations teams run on, and the reporting our enterprise clients see. You will start with our healthcare payments dispute resolution product, which has the largest data footprint and the most immediate reporting need. Once that reporting is running, the role expands across our other products, bringing one set of definitions to metrics that are currently produced product by product. The interesting part of this job is not the dashboards. Much of what our applications display is calculated at read time by application code rather than stored in a column, so the same question can be answered several ways. Your job is to decide what each metric means, document it, prove it reconciles against the systems of record, and defend that definition when someone wants a different number. If you like being the person whose figures nobody argues with, you will like this role. You will work alongside an engineering team of senior fullstack engineers and QA, a product manager, and business leadership in the United States. You will present your numbers directly to executives and to client counterparts, so this is a role for someone comfortable in front of an audience, not only in a query editor. What you will do Build and maintain internal reporting for operational volume, case status and stage, cycle and resolution time, throughput, and service-level metrics. Own payment reconciliation reporting, where the tolerance for an approximate answer is zero. Design and ship scoped, self-service reporting for enterprise clients, so they can answer their own questions without going through our support team. Model data in our analytics warehouse: dimensional models, incremental transformations, and tested, documented pipelines. Own the metric layer. One definition per metric, the query that produces it, the business rule behind it, and a data dictionary anyone can read. Reconcile reporting against the source systems and keep it reconciled as the applications change. Work with role-scoped access and data minimization as a matter of routine. We handle regulated healthcare and payment data, and reporting is built to keep sensitive fields out of it. Improve data quality. Find the defects that make reporting wrong, quantify them, and drive the fixes with the engineering team. Turn ambiguous questions from executives and clients into defined metrics, and say so when a question cannot be answered from the data we hold. Extend the same patterns and definitions to our other products as the function grows. What we are looking for Expert SQL. Complex analytical queries, window functions, and query performance work. You can tell the difference between a number that is surprising and a number that is wrong. Hands-on warehouse experience. ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or Databricks. You have modeled data in one, not only queried someone else’s models. Dimensional and semantic modeling. You have built a reporting layer over a normalized transactional schema and owned the definitions that sat on top of it. Client-facing reporting, shipped. You have built reporting that external customers used, with the scoping and access controls that requires. You write code, not only queries. Production-quality work in Git, code review in both directions, and the ability to build and run your own transformation jobs. Stakeholder judgment. You can sit with an executive or a client, work out what they actually need, and push back when the ask does not hold up. Data governance in a regulated setting. Practical experience with role-based access, handling of personal or health data, and producing evidence for an audit. HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI, or similar. Clear written communication. Our team is distributed and most decisions happen in writing. Professional English, written and spoken. You will present to United States executives and to client counterparts. Fluency is required and is assessed in the first conversation. Time zone overlap. A minimum of four hours of daily overlap with United States Eastern time, 9:00 to 13:00 ET. Able to contract independently. You can invoice and contract as an independent professional in your country of residence, and accept confidentiality and data-handling terms covering regulated healthcare data. Nice to have Healthcare payments, claims, or payer and provider data. Experience with No Surprises Act dispute resolution is a real advantage. dbt or a comparable transformation framework, in production, with tests. Change data capture pipelines and the failure modes that come with them. Financial reconciliation reporting. Python for data work. Enough TypeScript to read an application and trace how a value is calculated. An embedded analytics or BI tool taken to production with external users, including row-level security. AWS, particularly RDS, S3, and IAM as it applies to data access. Prior work with a United States company in a regulated industry. What this role is not It is not a ticket queue for dashboard requests. You own definitions and you are expected to have opinions about them. It is not platform or infrastructure engineering. We have a platform team and you will partner with them. It is not machine learning or model development. That work sits with a separate team. Tech you will work with TypeScript and Next.js applications, MySQL and PostgreSQL as operational stores, ClickHouse as the analytics warehouse, change data capture between them, Python for data work, and AWS throughout. Our older products run on Python and Flask. Originally posted on Himalayas

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote- USA Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. The Community You Will Join: BizTech fosters culture and connection at Airbnb by providing reliable corporate tools, innovative products, and technical support for all teams. We drive technical breakthroughs and strategies that redefine what it means to belong anywhere, delivering greater value for the business and our people. The Global Operations team at BizTech manages production services across Airbnb’s corporate environment, delivering reliable operations through Observability, Incident Management, Core Operations, and AI-enabled automation. We partner across BizTech to scale service quality, efficiency, and resilience. The Difference You Will Make: As an Operations Engineer, you'll apply AI at the forefront of BizTech's operational health: using LLM-powered triage and intelligent automation to resolve tickets, speed up incident response, and build self-healing observability that catches problems before they escalate. AI fluency is core to this role, not an add-on. You'll prototype agentic workflows, embed AI into runbooks and diagnostics, and continuously look for repetitive work automation can take over. Success looks like a shrinking backlog of recurring ticket categories through AI-assisted automation, faster MTTR powered by intelligent alerting and root-cause suggestions, and dashboards/reporting enhanced with AI-driven insights that give stakeholders clear, trustworthy visibility into service health and data quality. A Typical Day: Manage the ticket queue prioritizing and resolving requests while identifying recurring categories to automate or deflect Participate in a rotating on-call and incident response schedule, including weekends, troubleshooting and documenting issues in real time Build and maintain monitoring dashboards (Tableau, Superset, Grafana) that track service health, availability, and data quality, flagging gaps as they emerge Use AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to speed up triage, root-cause analysis, scripting, and documentation — while knowing when a problem needs hands-on judgment instead Write and maintain code in general-purpose languages (Python, Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, Bash) to automate operational workflows Partner with global stakeholder teams to drive issues to resolution Your Expertise: 3+ years of experience with observability and metrics tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ElasticSearch) 3+ years working with data querying and pipelines (e.g., SQL, Airflow, Trino, SQS) Working knowledge of network fundamentals and hardware (e.g., Cisco, Palo Alto) Experience with Infrastructure as Code Hands-on experience with CI/CD and automation tooling (e.g., Jenkins, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions) across AWS, GCP, or Oracle Cloud Comfort working in ticket/workflow-driven environments using Jira and Confluence Experience supporting enterprise SaaS tools (e.g., Salesforce, Workday) and SSO/identity integration (e.g., Okta) is a plus Your Location This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from. Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging: Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com . Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process. We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application. Equal Employment Opportunity: Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. How We'll Take Care of You: Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits. Pay Range $136,000 — $160,000 USD Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ airbnb.com or @ ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/airbnb-operations-engineer-biztech

items.title: Senior Manager, Business Performance & Analysis
items.summary: ABOUT ALUALU provides higher education for a higher purpose.
items.description: ABOUT ALU ALU provides higher education for a higher purpose. Our students declare missions, not majors.They develop the real-world skills to take on the world’s most pressing challenges. And they take ownership of their learning from day one through our peer and student-led approach – because ALU believes in the power and agency of young people to start shaping the future right now. Together with a world-class faculty and staff, our students are igniting a ripple of positive impact across Africa and the world. We are dedicated to fostering an open yet secure environment, balancing the safety of students, staff, and visitors with respect for individual rights, and safeguarding responsibilities. HOW WE WORK The ALU Team works in starkly different ways to traditional academic bureaucracies. We approach education from first principles, empower individuals to design, test, and implement creative new ideas, and work closely together to craft transformative learning experiences. We are deeply passionate about our students and excited by the challenge of building something entirely new. The African Leadership University is committed to ensuring the safety and Well-being of all students under our care. As part of this commitment , we have a comprehensive safeguarding policy in place , which outlines our Zero-tolerance approach to any violation of safeguarding. ABOUT THE TEAM The Business Performance & Analysis team is one of ALU ’s core performance intelligence functions, providing the insight, analysis and challenge required to help leaders understand performance, make informed decisions and improve institutional outcomes. Working across academic and professional functions, the team goes beyond reporting what has happened to understand why it happened, what it means, what is likely to happen next, and what action is required. It brings together performance data, analysis and external benchmarks to identify trends, risks, opportunities and areas for improvement. The team connects strategy, performance and execution by strengthening performance measurement, supporting decision-making and helping leaders translate insight into action. Its impact is measured not by the volume of reports produced, but by the quality of decisions informed and the improvements in institutional performance that follow. ABOUT THE ROLE The Senior Manager, Business Performance & Analysis will lead the analysis, interpretation and management of institutional performance information to support evidence-based decision-making across ALU . The role will translate complex business, financial, operational, academic and student data into clear insights, identify performance trends and gaps, assess their underlying drivers, and provide actionable recommendations to improve institutional outcomes. The role will also strengthen ALU 's performance management and business intelligence capabilities, ensuring that leadership has timely, reliable and forward-looking information to guide strategic and operational decisions. Working across functions and with senior leaders, the role will connect institutional strategy, performance targets and operational results, providing the analysis and challenge required to improve execution and organisational performance. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Institutional Performance Management Lead the development, implementation and continuous improvement of ALU 's institutional performance framework, including KPIs, targets, scorecards and performance measures. Monitor performance against strategic and operational objectives, identify material variances, emerging risks and areas of underperformance, and recommend appropriate interventions. Lead periodic performance reviews and provide analysis that enables leadership to understand not only what is happening, but why it is happening and what action is required. Analyse performance across key institutional areas including enrolment, recruitment, retention, student progression, programme performance, revenue, costs, resource utilisation and other strategic priorities. Establish appropriate performance benchmarks and support leadership in setting meaningful, measurable and outcome-focused objectives and targets. Business and Strategic Analysis Identify trends, patterns, performance drivers and root causes across multiple sources of institutional data. Develop business cases, investment analyses and decision papers, including assessment of financial, operational and strategic implications. Undertake scenario analysis and modelling to assess the potential impact of strategic and operational decisions. Conduct complex business and institutional analysis to support strategic planning, operational decisions and strategic initiatives and prioritization. Provide objective analysis and constructive challenge where data, assumptions or proposed interventions require further scrutiny. Conduct internal and external benchmarking to assess institutional performance against relevant peer institutions, competitors, sector standards and market trends. Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations, implications and actions for senior leadership. Performance Intelligence and Reporting Lead the development of high-quality management information, executive performance reports, dashboards and analytical products for senior leadership and governance forums. Establish standards for performance reporting, data interpretation, and analytical storytelling. Ensure management reports focus on material performance issues, drivers, trends and decisions rather than simply presenting data. Develop forward-looking analysis and forecasts to support proactive management of institutional performance. Work with data and technology teams to improve access to, integration of and confidence in institutional data. Ensure the accuracy, consistency and appropriate interpretation of performance information used for management decision-making. Analytics Capability and Continuous Improvement Develop clear standards for analytical quality, delivery and stakeholder service. Coach team members in analytical thinking, problem solving, business partnering and effective communication of insights. Develop and continuously improve analytical methodologies, tools and processes. Identify opportunities to automate, simplify and improve performance reporting and analysis. Promote a culture of evidence-based decision-making and stronger use of data across ALU . Partner with other functions to develop integrated views of institutional performance. Executive Stakeholder Engagement Establish and maintain data supply arrangements with the functions that own the underlying data: agreed definitions, cut dates, quality standards, and named counterparts. Resolve definitional inconsistency across campuses, programmes and systems so that the institution reports a single number for each institutional metric. Build effective working relationships with senior leaders, Deans, Directors and functional teams across ALU . Present complex analysis clearly to non-technical audiences and translate findings into practical business implications. Facilitate performance discussions and support leaders in identifying appropriate responses to performance gaps. Influence decisions through evidence, insight and constructive challenge, including where findings may challenge established assumptions or practices. Provide analytical support to strategic, executive and governance forums as required. Maintain a strong understanding of the ALU ’s operating environment, priorities and strategic objectives to ensure analysis remains relevant to institutional needs. Ensure the safety and well-being of all young persons and vulnerable adults with whom we deal, by adhering to ALU ’s comprehensive safeguarding policy, maintaining a zero-tolerance approach to any violations of safeguarding standards REQUIRED EXPERIENCE 10+ years of relevant professional experience in business performance, institutional research, strategy, business intelligence, analytics, planning, consulting, financial analysis or a related field. Demonstrable experience leading, developing and managing organisational or institutional performance frameworks, including KPIs, targets, scorecards and performance reporting. Proven experience analysing complex datasets and translating findings into actionable recommendations for senior decision-makers, forecasting, scenario modelling, business case development and quantitative analysis. Experience producing executive-level performance reports, dashboards and decision-support materials. Experience using data to identify performance drivers, diagnose problems and support measurable improvements in organisational outcomes. Demonstrated experience delivering analytical or performance improvement initiatives that resulted in measurable business, operational, financial or institutional impact. Experience benchmarking organisational or institutional performance against external peers, competitors or sector standards is desirable. REQUIRED COMPETENCIES Functional Competencies Strategic and Performance Analysis: Analyse complex institutional issues, identify performance drivers and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Data & Business Intelligence: Analyse complex datasets and develop clear dashboards, management information and performance insights. Financial & Commercial Acumen: Understand the financial, operational and institutional implications of decisions. Forecasting & Modelling: Develop forecasts, scenarios and business models to support planning and decision-making. Problem Solving: Diagnose root causes, test assumptions and develop practical, evidence-based solutions. Executive Reporting: Distil complex information into clear insights, implications and recommendations for senior leaders. Analytics Tools: Advanced Excel and strong proficiency in Power BI and uses digital and AI-enabled tools effectively to accelerate analysis, improve productivity and generate insight, while independently validating outputs and exercising sound judgement. Behavioural & Leadership Competencies Strategic Thinking: Connect performance trends and analysis to broader institutional priorities. Critical Thinking: Question assumptions and assess evidence objectively. Influencing & Challenge: Build credibility with senior stakeholders and challenge constructively using evidence. Executive Communication: Communicate complex findings clearly and persuasively to varied audiences. Collaboration: Work effectively across academic and professional functions. Leadership & Coaching: Develop people, set high analytical standards and build team capability. Delivery Orientation: Focus on turning insight into action and measurable institutional improvement. Match the ALU Archetype: Alignment with the ALU Archetype, including ownership, courage, and stewardship. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Europe, Remote Hello👋I am Puneet , Co-founder and CPO at Kayzen , and I am now looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our team 🙌 But wait, you have not heard of Kayzen before?😃 Kayzen is a mobile demand-side platform (DSP) dedicated to democratizing programmatic advertising. We enable leading apps, agencies, media buyers, and brands to run programmatic customer acquisition, retargeting, and brand performance campaigns through its self-serve and managed service options. Built on the three core pillars of performance, transparency, and control, Kayzen powers the world’s best mobile marketing teams with bespoke solutions that fuel business growth and deliver a competitive advantage. With an unprecedented scale of 160B+ daily ad requests from 1.6B+ unique users worldwide, we serve up to 1B+ ads per day in 180 countries. Kayzen is accessible through our APIs and user interface. The Team You will work with a carefully selected, diverse and globally distributed Data Science team (like Heiko, Chen) on various machine-learning models that process terabytes of data, serving billions of ad requests and users around the globe in real-time. We are highly motivated and aligned in our quest to disrupt the multi-billion dollar ad-tech industry. We would like you to be part of our journey, as our Senior Data Scientist (m/f/d) . Responsibilities Our day-to-day work in Data Science and Machine Learning encompasses a wide range of activities, including: Enhancing Models: Continuously improving existing models by incorporating new features, fine-tuning parameters, and utilizing additional data. Algorithm Development: Collaborating with our Machine Learning Engineering team to develop and deploy scalable supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms. Data Exploration: Identifying and exploring new data sources while researching innovative ways to leverage both new and existing data effectively. Solution Research: Investigating new Machine Learning solutions to optimize every step of our value chain. A/B Testing: Regularly conducting and evaluating A/B tests to drive insights and refine our strategies. You’ll be a great fit if you resonate with the following principles of Data Science and Machine Learning: Simplicity First: We prioritize finding the best solutions to challenges rather than forcing problems to fit predetermined solutions. Impact-Driven: We leverage Machine Learning to enhance our product and drive performance for our clients, always focusing on tangible business outcomes. Collaborative Spirit: Our teams consist of analysts, engineers, and data scientists, making strong communication skills essential for success. Embrace Experimentation: We believe in the power of experimentation to innovate and refine our approach continually. Requirements Minimum 5 years of experience in developing data science products, from initial research through to production deployment. Strong coding skills with a focus on clean, reproducible, and well-tested code. Proficient in key tools and technologies including Python, Spark, Hadoop, Airflow, Docker, and SQL. Hands-on experience with algorithms for handling sparse and large datasets, including applications in prediction, clustering, and outlier detection. Experience in building neural network-based products for tasks such as classification, regression, and multi-task learning is highly valuable. Bonus skills: Knowledge of reinforcement learning and large-scale optimization problems is a significant asset. Good understanding of dashboards and SQL for developing and enhancing monitoring tools. Previous experience in Ad-Tech is a must. What do we offer? Directly working with Founders and an opportunity to drive direct impact Exceptional career growth and learning opportunity A unique opportunity to be part of an experienced team of industry experts and entrepreneurs who bring massive change to the Adtech market A fun, driven, and multinational team located across Germany, India, Argentina, Canada, Spain, the UK and many more countries. A flexible work-from-home arrangement Opportunity to relocate to our office in Berlin A 500-dollar home-office setup budget A 1000-dollar annual learning and development budget Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Lead Product Analyst, B2C Financial Services
items.summary: Tabby is on a mission to give people power over their money.
items.description: Tabby is on a mission to give people power over their money. For too long, financial systems have worked for the institutions that built them, not the people using them. Runaway interest, fine print and limited access have left many behind, feeling shut out of a system that wasn't setting them up for success. We're building a different kind of system, in a complete money app to send, spend and save. One that's clear, flexible and puts people and businesses in control. Founded in 2019, we serve customers and businesses across Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait. Millions of customers and 65,000 global brands, government services and small businesses rely on us today. What began as a better way to pay at checkout has grown into a financial system working the way it should have all along. About the roleThis role focuses on Tabby Cash , and the growing ecosystem of our debit financial products. You will lead a team of analysts that work on activation, engagement, and profitability , helping shape how the product grows from 1 → 100. The role requires balancing user growth with sustainable economics , working across Product, Risk, and Growth teams. You will play a key role in defining how users adopt and use our cards, and how we optimize the products for long-term value. What you will be doing Lead a team of product analysts to provide support to the product and business teams across all aspects of their work. Generate hypotheses, conduct research and A/B tests, and present your findings clearly and compellingly, which highlights the importance of your insights. Regularly work with several stakeholders, including product and marketing teams, on fundamental research as well as on one-time requests. Support and monitor existing metrics for the Financial Products, identify areas for improvement, and develop new metrics that inform decision-making across the organization. Develop data visualizations and reports that are both informative and easily understood by business and product teams. Assist in the planning of necessary data structures and data quality improvements. What you will need Minimum of 4 years of work experience as a data/product analyst. Experience in leading a team of data analysts of any size. Proficiency in SQL and relational databases. Proficiency in data visualization and BI tools. Experience in planning data structures for new products and features. Strong knowledge of Python (Pandas, Numpy, Statsmodels, Matplotlib, etc.) Experience in product analytics in fintech is a plus. Experience in leveraging LLM/AI for analytical purposes is a plus. Strong quantitative skills and a structured approach to problem-solving. Ability to analyze issues, identify root causes, and recommend solutions. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact with business and product teams. At least an upper-intermediate level of English proficiency is required. A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one. You should be comfortable with the idea that the quality of your work will influence the shape of your career. items.description: This role owns the software and cloud-native architecture of AI-enabled applications and retrieval systems, from design to production. It combines architectural leadership with hands-on engineering: designing GenAI and RAG solutions, building cloud-native backend services, and ensuring the security, reliability, and observability required for production workloads. Define cloud-native patterns across microservices, containers, serverless, and event-driven systems. Design and productionize GenAI and RAG solutions: model selection and routing, retrieval strategy, evaluation, guardrails, and cost/latency optimization. Build backend services in TypeScript/Node.js and/or Python, and event-driven workflows with queues, workers, and webhooks. Define non-functional requirements, evaluate trade-offs, and document decisions in ADRs. Translate business use cases into technical designs, assessments, and executive summaries. Own the architecture from discovery to go-live, guiding engineers through architecture and code reviews. Implement observability and secure CI/CD pipelines. Job requirements 7+ years of software engineering experience. Proven experience owning the architecture of production distributed systems (microservices, domain-driven design, REST and asynchronous APIs). Hands-on delivery of production GenAI or LLM applications, including evaluation and AI safety controls. Experience with RAG, embeddings, and vector databases (pgvector, OpenSearch, or equivalent). Strong TypeScript/Node.js or Python engineering experience. Deep knowledge of cloud-native patterns: containers and Kubernetes, serverless, event-driven messaging, and resilience patterns. Strong understanding of security in cloud-native systems: identity, authorization, secrets management, and data protection. Docker, CI/CD, automated testing, and observability (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog, or CloudWatch). Nice to have AWS: Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, EventBridge, Step Functions, ECS/EKS, Aurora PostgreSQL, DynamoDB. Conversational and contact center: WhatsApp Business API, Amazon Connect, Amazon Lex, Twilio, voice bots. Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK. AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional or equivalent. Customer-facing consulting experience and comfort presenting to executive stakeholders. Whether you're solving complex problems or driving bold innovations, your growth is our success, and together, we’ll create the conversations of tomorrow. Empower your impact at Cision. Be seen, be understood, be you. Currently we are looking for young and ambitious person to join our amazing team as Sales Business Analyst. This role is responsible for supporting sales and revenue teams through data analysis, reporting, process administration, and operational execution that improves visibility, consistency, and efficiency across the sales lifecycle. What You'll Do Support recurring and ad hoc reporting related to pipeline, bookings, forecasting, productivity, and performance metrics. Maintain and validate sales data within CRM and related systems to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency. Assist in the administration of sales processes, including territory alignment, account assignment, quota tracking, and pipeline management. Partner cross-functionally to support operational workflows, system updates, and process documentation. Analyze trends in sales data and provide insights to support business planning and decision-making. Contribute to the preparation of dashboards, presentations, and performance summaries for leadership review. Support system enhancements, testing, and user acceptance activities related to sales tools and reporting platforms. Experience supporting sales reporting, pipeline tracking, forecasting, and performance analysis Experience with SalesForce reporting tools, and business intelligence or data visualization tools. items.description: We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking. After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us. With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers! We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️ London or Remote (UK) | £100,000 - £130,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits | Data Team, Borrowing About the team: Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and the planned launch of new initiatives. We aim to create a genuine feel-good factor when it comes to personal credit, and are looking for driven, analytical and creative individuals to help us achieve this goal. With our Flex product we’re reinventing credit cards to give customers more visibility and control over their spending. With our Flex product, we’re reinventing credit cards to give customers more visibility and control over their spending. Flex portfolio management is currently in its infancy—meaning this role is a true "zero-to-one" blank canvas. Flex behaves differently from a standard credit card, so we are looking for a highly strategic Credit Risk Manager who can challenge legacy banking assumptions, think from first principles, and put the customer at the heart of our lifecycle strategies. You will lead an initial team of 3 credit analysts (with scope to grow the team over time) to unlock massive P&L and customer engagement potential on a rapidly growing portfolio. While the immediate focus is scaling safely in the UK, you will help lay the groundwork for a global footprint as Monzo expands into Europe. Our credit teams are part of our Data Discipline which drives a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. We’re great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker which gives analysts the head space to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses. Join a team where your ideas can rapidly transform into reality, leveraging our cutting-edge technology and agile ways of working. Our credit analysts and managers are fully embedded into a product squad alongside Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Marketers, Customer Researchers, Data Scientists etc. This enables us to solve customer problems in a fast paced and innovative way. Your day-to-day: Own Portfolio Monitoring & Forecasting: Build and oversee robust performance frameworks to monitor and forecast both risk and revenue metrics, ensuring our rapidly growing portfolio scales sustainably. Drive Contractual Pricing Strategies: Architect and optimise an ongoing risk-based pricing program that balances commercial viability and fair customer outcomes. Fuel Engagement & Retention Loops: Design and deploy sophisticated credit strategies for lifecycle events, including product upgrades, engagement incentives, and balance transfer propositions that deepen customer loyalty. Execute Data-Driven Loss Mitigation: Develop proactive risk management frameworks—such as credit limit decrease strategies—to safely mitigate losses and support financially vulnerable customers. Lead and Nurture Talent: Manage, coach, and scale a high-performing team of 3 credit analysts, fostering a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and strong commercial focus. Cross-Functional Squad Collaboration: Act as the embedded credit risk expert within a multi-disciplinary squad, working side-by-side with Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Customer Research, and Risk & Control. Cross-functional Leadership: Build deep collaborative ties with wider credit functions and manage relationships with 2nd Line Credit Risk, Legal, and Compliance, while translating complex data into clear narratives for executive-level stakeholders. How we work: Our main tech hub is in London, but our data teams are based all over the UK — from Brighton to the Western Isles. We love meeting in person, but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you’re nearby. You’ll do your best work where you feel most comfortable. We value flexibility, connection, and wellbeing. You’ll have the freedom to work in a way that fits your life, whether that’s school drop-offs, avoiding rush hour, or making time for what matters most. Work the way that works for you at Monzo! You should apply if: What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you! You are a commercial, strategic credit leader with a deep understanding of unsecured lending portfolios—ideally with exposure to credit card lifecycle management. You thrive in ambiguous, "zero-to-one" environments. You love building strategies from scratch, questioning traditional banking norms, and working at pace. You have portfolio management experience, including risk-based pricing, retention, product upgrades, and loss mitigation strategies. You are a champion for both Credit and Conduct Risk. You naturally balance sharp credit instincts with a passion for protecting customers and delivering delightful experiences. You are an exceptional stakeholder manager and storyteller. You can smoothly collaborate with engineering squads, align with legal and compliance partners, and influence up to executive leadership. You love developing people. You have a proven track record of leading analytical talent and are energized by the prospect of managing and growing a high-impact team. You have strong technical and data capabilities. You are comfortable digging into data yourself and driving a data-first culture (SQL is a must-have; Python and Looker experience is a plus). The Interview Process: Our interview process involves 3 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions! Recruiter call Initial call with the hiring manager Final loop of interviews meeting the team Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. What’s in it for you: ✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK ✅ We can sponsor visas This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London). ⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team. Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences ➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here #LI-COD #LI-REMOTE Equal opportunities for everyone Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog , 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report. We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status. If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage

items.summary: ABOUT THE ROLEAs Financial Controller Lead, you will be a strategic finance partner to the executive team, helping drive data-informed decisions that support rapid growth and operational excellence.
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE As Financial Controller Lead, you will be a strategic finance partner to the executive team, helping drive data-informed decisions that support rapid growth and operational excellence. In a fast-paced technology start-up environment, you will own the financial planning and business performance management processes, providing clear insights into revenue, costs, profitability, cash flow, and key business metrics. You will work closely with leaders across Product, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Tech and People to translate complex financial and operational data into actionable recommendations. Beyond traditional financial controlling, you will help build scalable financial processes, improve reporting automation, evaluate strategic investments, and support board reporting, and business expansion initiatives. This is a highly visible role for someone who enjoys combining financial rigor with an entrepreneurial mindset and thrives in an environment where priorities evolve quickly and every decision has a measurable impact. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Serve as the primary finance business partner to functional and executive leadership. Lead the company's budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning processes. Develop financial models to support strategic initiatives, new products, pricing decisions, market expansion, and investment opportunities. Monitor and analyze business performance, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities to improve growth and profitability. Build and maintain executive dashboards and KPIs that measure financial and operational performance. Provide insightful variance analysis and recommend actions to optimize revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, and cash flow. Partner with Product, Commercial and Tech teams to evaluate business cases and resource allocation. Support board presentations, and due diligence processes. Drive continuous improvement of financial planning, reporting, and analytics through automation and scalable processes. Collaborate with Accounting to ensure accurate month-end close, financial reporting, and compliance with internal controls. Evaluate SaaS and technology business metrics, including ARR, MRR, CAC, LTV, churn, retention, and unit economics, where applicable. Support strategic initiatives, including international expansion, partnerships, M&A, and new business models. Build a culture of financial accountability while enabling fast and informed decision-making across the organization. WHAT YOU BRING Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline. 7+ years of experience in Business Controlling, FP&A, Strategic Finance, or Corporate Finance, preferably in a high-growth technology company or start-up. Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills. Experience partnering with senior executives and cross-functional leadership teams. Deep understanding of business drivers, or digital business models. Advanced Excel and financial modeling capabilities. Fluency using AI tools. Experience with ERP, FP&A, and BI platforms (for example MS Dynamics, NetSuite, Oracle, SAP, Workday Adaptive Planning, Power BI, Looker, Tableau, or similar). Excellent analytical thinking with the ability to transform data into strategic business insights. Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence presenting to executives, investors, and board members. Comfortable operating in a fast-changing, ambiguous environment with a hands-on approach. Demonstrated ability to build scalable financial processes in a growing organization. Strong project management and stakeholder management skills. High level of ownership, curiosity, and a continuous improvement mindset. Preferred Qualifications Experience in fintech, blockchain, Web3, digital assets, or cryptocurrency businesses. Understanding of token economics, digital asset accounting, or crypto market dynamics is a plus ROOTIES BENEFITS At RootstockLabs , we don’t just offer a job, we offer a community. Here’s what you can expect when you join us: Competitive compensation package and unique benefits designed to support your growth and well-being. 100% Remote Work from Europe & Latin America, with access to global CoWorking spaces. Work-Life Balance: Paid vacation and sick leave days Continuous Learning: Access to training programs, language courses, and learning sponsorship annually. Unique Projects: Work with cutting-edge blockchain technology in a global, diverse team. REVIEW ABOUT ROOTSTOCKLABS RootstockLabs is a key contributor to Rootstock, Bitcoin's Financial Infrastructure for lending, yield, and onchain capital markets. We build and commercialize the institutional infrastructure that turns Bitcoin into productive capital. What we do: Develop and commercialize Bitcoin-backed lending, tokenized real-world assets, and onchain financial strategies Who we work with: Leading custodians, asset managers, and financial institutions Why it matters: Rootstock is secured by 80%+ of Bitcoin's hash power and has run with 100% uptime since 2018 (bringing Ethereum-style programmability to the world's hardest money). Proof it works: 200+ dApps live on Rootstock, from BTCFi protocols like Sushiswap and Oku to institutional names like Mercado Bitcoin, Animoca Brands, and Paystand Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Software Engineering Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: As a Solutions Integration Engineer at Samsara, you will be an integral member of the Professional Services Organisation responsible for helping Samsara’s most strategic customers build and implement B2B integrations with our IoT platform. In a given week, you may work with a large long-haul trucking company, an industrial-scale food producer, and a public utility to map a customer’s integration needs to current and future API capabilities, help building custom integrations, provide guidance and technical training to implementation teams to follow best practices, troubleshoot issues and advocate for fixes on behalf of customers (working with our tech support team), and ensure a successful customer relationship. A successful Solutions Integration Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of B2B integrations to ensure the proper technical solution is delivered to our customers. Your role will be cross-functional, working alongside and connecting product managers, business operations, sales, and systems engineers, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within. Since Samsara is a fast-growing company with emerging IoT technology, you can expect this role to evolve, with opportunities to take on increasing levels of responsibility and impact our growth. This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster. You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable. You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment. You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there. In this role, you will: Lead system integration projects with customer development teams, Samsara’s partners, 3rd-party systems integrators or build your own enterprise-grade scalable solutions using various Samsara’s Web integration technologies (APIs, Webhooks, Connectors, and more.) Design/develop/define complex project scopes, technical specifications and business requirements between Samsara and multiple stakeholders - from design through delivery and beyond Plans complex projects that involve a variety of people, dependencies, uncertainty, risk and impact. Comfortable making delivery commitments for larger projects Accounts for maintainability, portability, scalability, and reliability in technical designs and knows when to trade them for speed of delivery Build robust and scalable integration architecture to help solve use cases like Real-time Data Streaming, Event subscriptions, Batch processing, etc. Build, test, validate, and review code to ensure completeness and highest quality deliverables Advise and document best practices around integrations using Samara APIs and products Test, validate and review code to ensure completeness and highest quality deliverables Leads by example: conducts thorough code reviews and provides feedback that is actionable and insightful Exchange best practices, share knowledge with the Samsara product team, developer community, and advocate for customer experience Collaborate with the Samsara’s Developer EcoSystem team closely to improve our API experience and featureset Contribute to the enhancement of Professional Services methodologies and tools Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices Minimum requirements for the role: 5+ years of experience designing and developing Integration solutions using proven architecture methodologies Experience in gathering data integration requirements and translating into good technical data designs Can write, read, and understand code in Python and any one additional programming language (for example, JavaScript, AppScript) Proficient in leveraging LLM-based tools for code generation, prompt engineering, automation, and enhancing developer productivity Experience modern Cloud Services (AWS, Azure, or GCP) Hands-on experience in building or working with RESTful APIs/Webhooks and modern databases Knowledge of PowerBI/Tableau, SQL, and data visualization concepts items.title: Vice President, Information Technology
items.summary: For over 35 years, Peak Technologies has been at the forefront of providing end-to-end enterprise mobility, managed services, printing and mobile data capture solutions for performance-driven organizations focused on the optimization of supply chain and field-based business processes.
items.description: For over 35 years, Peak Technologies has been at the forefront of providing end-to-end enterprise mobility, managed services, printing and mobile data capture solutions for performance-driven organizations focused on the optimization of supply chain and field-based business processes. JOB SUMMARY & SCOPE Responsible for the strategic direction, management, and performance of the Company's global technology organization, including infrastructure, cybersecurity, compliance, enterprise applications, data management, and IT operations. This position ensures a secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective technology environment that supports a multi-site, acquisition-driven business while leading technology modernization, enterprise integration, IT governance, cybersecurity, vendor management, and M&A integration initiatives. The role serves as the Company's senior authority on information security and IT risk and partners closely with business and technology leaders to align technology platforms, data, and processes with operational and growth objectives. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES Develop and execute the enterprise IT strategy, roadmap, and operating model aligned with business objectives. Provide leadership and oversight for all IT functions, including infrastructure, cybersecurity, compliance, business applications, data management, and technical support operations. Manage the global technology infrastructure environment, including cloud platforms, networks, telecommunications, endpoints, and site connectivity. Establish standards for system availability, performance, capacity planning, disaster recovery, and business continuity. Lead service desk and technology operations functions, including service management processes, service levels, and operational performance metrics. Direct the enterprise cybersecurity program, including security strategy, governance, monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, and identity and access management. Serve as the executive leader responsible for information security, technology risk management, and security-related stakeholder communications. Oversee third-party technology risk management, vendor security assessments, and customer security compliance requirements. Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory, privacy, and security frameworks, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, and related standards. Maintain the organization's IT risk management framework, audit readiness, internal controls, and compliance reporting processes. Oversee enterprise business applications, including ERP, CRM, productivity, collaboration, cloud, analytics, and workflow management platforms. Drive application integration, process automation, and technology modernization initiatives that improve operational efficiency and data integrity. Partner with executive leadership to establish enterprise data governance, reporting, analytics, and business intelligence strategies. Develop and execute plans to rationalize technology platforms, reduce application redundancy, improve user adoption, and optimize technology investments. Lead IT due diligence, integration planning, and post-acquisition technology integration activities for mergers and acquisitions. Manage the IT operating and capital budgets, ensuring effective financial stewardship, resource allocation, and cost optimization. Direct vendor relationships, contract negotiations, software licensing, and strategic sourcing initiatives. Lead, develop, and mentor IT leaders and teams while communicating technology strategy, risks, priorities, and recommendations to executive leadership and key stakeholders. EDUCATION + EXPERIENCE + KEY TRAITS Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Minimum of 12 years of progressive enterprise IT experience, including at least 5 years leading multi-functional IT organizations at the Director level or above. Demonstrated expertise leading enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, business applications, and IT operations within complex, multi-site organizations. Hands-on experience managing enterprise-scale Microsoft and Azure environments, including Microsoft 365, Entra ID, cloud infrastructure, and related technologies. Experience overseeing enterprise ERP, CRM, data, analytics, and business intelligence platforms, preferably including NetSuite, Salesforce, Azure Data Lake, and Power BI. Proven success developing, implementing, and maintaining cybersecurity, compliance, and risk management programs, including frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, PCI DSS, HIPAA, and GDPR. Demonstrated ownership of significant IT operating and capital budgets, vendor management, contract negotiations, and technology investment strategies. Experience supporting global and multi-country business operations, with strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills. Preferred experience within private equity-backed, acquisition-oriented, or rapidly growing organizations, including technology due diligence and post-acquisition integration. Experience supporting distribution, supply chain, logistics, manufacturing, or field service operations and familiarity with enterprise customer security, compliance, and procurement requirements. Knowledge of AI, machine learning, data governance, and advanced analytics environments. Relevant professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, Azure Solutions Architect, ITIL, or similar credentials are preferred. TYPICAL PERFORMANCE TARGETS SERVICE DELIVERY: Sustained, measured excellence in project & process delivery COST TO SERVE: Sustained, measured excellence in delivery efficiency with expected continuous improvement INNOVATION: Step changed delivery in safety, quality, and/or cost LANGUAGE SKILLS Primary language used in daily operations is English. Additional primary company languages include Spanish, French, and Dutch. Read and interpret documents, procedure manuals and various correspondence from both internal and external. Speak effectively, both individually and before groups of both external customers and/or various levels of employees within the organization. SUPERVISION Responsible for direct and/or indirect reports. DECISION MAKING + REASONING Able to take accountability and responsibility for business target delivery and decision making. WORKING RELATIONSHIPS Peak Executive Team Peak Management Team PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS Activity Amount of Time None Under 1/3 1/3 to 2/3 Over 2/3 Stand X Walk X Sit X Use hands to finger, handle, or feel X Reach with hands and arms X Climb or balance X Stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl X Talk or hear X Lift Up to 25lbs X Travel X Peak Technologies, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer who fully and actively supports equal access for all people regardless of Race, Color, Religion, Gender, Age, National Origin, Veteran Status, Disability, Genetic Information or Testing, Family and Medical Leave, Sexual Orientation and Gender Identity or Expression. items.title: Senior Growth Consultant - PM (Programmatic)
items.summary: Hi, we’re Phiture — the mobile growth consultancy working with the teams behind leading apps like Adobe, Headspace, and LEGO® 👋.
items.description: Hi, we’re Phiture — the mobile growth consultancy working with the teams behind leading apps like Adobe, Headspace, and LEGO® 👋. We’re setting the standard for growth in the brave new digital world, and we need great people to join our global team! WHAT TO EXPECT: Join Phiture as a Senior Growth Consultant, PM (Programmatic ), owning the day-to-day relationship, communication, and delivery for one or more client accounts. You'll act as the main technical point of contact for client communications, owning conversations and decisions directly with the client, while advising the Growth Lead on strategy and execution. This is a hands-on, individual account-ownership role. You'll bring deep expertise in paid user acquisition for mobile apps — including SDKs, SKAN's measurement restrictions, the DSP/SSP landscape, and MMPs — and apply it to scale programmatic media buys efficiently. WHAT YOU’LL DO: Own Programmatic Campaign Management: Own the end-to-end strategy, setup, and continuous optimization of programmatic media buys (DSPs) to scale user acquisition efficiently, proactively monitoring spend efficiency and creative performance, and independently investigating platform-level technical issues (tracking discrepancies, delivery problems, campaign configuration) before escalating. Own the Client Relationship: Own the client relationship end-to-end — day-to-day communication, deliverables (reports, proposals, strategic planning docs), and hands-on execution of the agreed strategy. Lead client meetings, educate clients beyond reporting, and communicate the real, accurate cause of any issue, including when it traces back to our own setup or execution. Apply App-Specific Paid Media Expertise: Bring deep expertise in paid user acquisition specifically for mobile apps — SDKs and their implementation, SKAN's measurement restrictions and their implications for testing and attribution, the DSP/SSP landscape, and what an MMP does and why app marketers rely on one. Bridge Creative & Performance Data: Read performance data well enough to turn it into real learnings — which messages, angles, or formats are working, and why — and use those insights to brief the creative team and discuss creative direction with them as a peer. Analyze Performance & Drive Recommendations: Dive deep into monthly metrics, set targets, analyze trends, and independently identify areas of concern or opportunity, arriving with a point of view and a recommendation grounded in the numbers. Comfort building or reading dashboards in a tool like Looker Studio is expected at a Senior level. Guide Client POCs & Junior Team Members: Lightly guide Client POCs and junior team members as they build expertise, while retaining individual ownership of your own accounts. Given a problem, investigate it, propose a course of action, follow through, and close the loop with stakeholders without needing reminders. WHAT YOU’LL NEED: Solid app-specific paid UA fluency: including SDKs, SKAN, MMP concepts, and the DSP/SSP landscape. Hands-on DSP/programmatic campaign management experience: this is core to the role from day one. Independent data interpretation skills: able to arrive at a point of view and recommendation grounded in the numbers, rather than generic or AI-sounding analysis. Strong written and verbal client communication skills: with confidence leading client meetings and educating clients beyond reporting. A demonstrated track record of proactive ownership: able to walk through a real past troubleshooting example without prompting. Genuine interest in programmatic as a channel: this role is programmatic-heavy. Comfort in an individual account-ownership role : rather than a team-leadership one. NICE TO HAVE: Hands-on experience with DV360 specifically: a strong differentiator for this role. Hands-on experience with at least one MMP (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch, or similar): including reading and troubleshooting attribution data — the single strongest differentiator for this role. WHAT WE OFFER YOU: Flexible Remote Work — Unlimited remote work within your home country (EMEA), plus up to 90 days per year internationally. Generous Vacation Allowance — Enjoy up to 30 days of paid vacation annually, plus extra days for special occasions (country-specific), so you can recharge and pursue your passions. Quarterly Bonus Opportunities — Boost your earnings through our quarterly bonus scheme, directly linked to our shared success. Mental Wellness Prioritized — Free, confidential mental health support from licensed therapists through our partnership with Oliva. Personal Development Investment — €1,000 annual personal growth budget and 10 dedicated learning hours each month, empowering your continuous growth. Flexible Working Hours — Shape your workday around your lifestyle and productivity, choosing working patterns that best suit you. Vibrant Berlin Office — Enjoy a flexible, pet-friendly workspace at our spacious headquarters located in one of Berlin’s most vibrant neighborhoods. Global Team Connection — Regular team-building events and a memorable annual all-expenses-paid company offsite. Tailored Career Growth — A personalized career roadmap and development plan designed to keep you advancing professionally. Home Office Allowance — Monthly remote-work cash allowance to level up your home workspace or help cover internet costs. Premium Onboarding Kit — Branded Phiture gear and your very own MacBook from day one. Thoughtful Celebrations — Responsibly sourced birthday, anniversary, and seasonal gifts, because every milestone deserves recognition. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of their age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. We celebrate diversity and are excited about building teams that represent a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Head of Technical Content
items.summary: About UsTameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online.
items.description: About Us Tameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online. We are looking for a Head of Technical Content to take end-to-end ownership of our technical presence. About the Role This is not a standard copywriting role or strategist role. We want someone with an engineering mind and a marketing insight, someone who figures things out, builds things, and ships them without waiting to be told. Someone who understands who our customers are: engineers and procurement teams at small and medium businesses sourcing industrial components, and what they need to make a confident purchase decision. If you are excited about building AI-driven content pipelines, that matters more than a long track record. You will own technical content from strategy to publication, including its technical accuracy. Your output shapes how engineers find Tameson , how the site ranks, and whether visitors convert into buyers. You work closely with our Product and Operations teams to extract technical knowledge and turn it into content competitors cannot replicate. A Flavor of What You’d Work On Audit our solenoid valve categories, identify what is missing or underperforming, and decide whether the fix is a selection guide, a page restructure, JSON-LD, or additional supporting content. Build it and analyze performance. Take our internal valve performance test data and turn it into a content series: articles, comparison tables, video scripts, email campaigns, social posts. Build assets from proprietary data that competitors cannot replicate. Work with industry partners to reach their communities through forums, sponsored placements, or native articles on their platforms. Analyze pages that get traffic but do not convert. Investigate whether it is a traffic quality, content quality, or conversion issue, implement a fix, and track the result against sales. Get up to speed on a product you know little about, write a buyer guide, fact-check it against manufacturer datasheets, and publish it without a technical reviewer. Key Outcomes & Responsibilities End-to-End Ownership: You will identify gaps in our content, style, and approach. You own the solution from idea to publication. You do not wait for a task list. You analyze the site, find the opportunities, and execute the improvements that drive the biggest impact. Strategic Content Architecture: You decide the format that converts. Sometimes an article is best, but often the customer needs a flow calculator, a comparison table, an upgraded category page, a tooltip, diagram, video, or a selection wizard. You will build the right content for the job to build our brand and convert users. Technical Authority & Accuracy: You are responsible for the technical accuracy of all public-facing content. You must have high engineering knowledge to validate data, correct errors, and ensure our advice is sound. You are the filter that prevents AI hallucinations or inaccuracies from reaching the customer. Build the Content Moat: You will create unique value that competitors and AI models cannot replicate. Go beyond text to produce proprietary assets like physical product benchmarks, expert interviews, and deep-dive technical diagrams or videos. Optimize for the Audience: You will structure information to ensure our content ranks high for search engines, serves as a primary citation source for AI models, and provides clear, helpful guidance for humans (engineers, non-engineers, buyers, etc.). Agile Adaptation: You will stay ahead of marketing trends and follow the data. If a content format stops working, you pivot. You track traffic and conversion metrics to continuously refine your strategy. Requirements What We Are Looking For High Engineering Knowledge: You have a background in engineering, deep experience in technical industries, and can explain the physics of our products easily. Builds With AI: You have designed and built content workflows using AI: research pipelines, structured drafting processes, automated publishing steps. You chose the tools, connected them, and own the quality of what comes out. Outcome Owner: You are driven by results (traffic, conversion, revenue) rather than output (article or word count). You manage the roadmap and deliver end-to-end results. Collaborative Investigator: You do not work in a silo. You actively partner with our Product and Operations teams to extract their internal expertise. You work with them and translate their knowledge into public-facing content that sets us apart from competitors. Versatile Creator: You are comfortable switching formats and could work on writing a white paper, designing calculator logic, auditing category pages, and building dashboards to analyze results all in 1 week. Why Choose Tameson ? Direct Business Impact: Your work directly correlates to sales. Publish the right guide and you can watch organic traffic and conversions move. There is a direct line between what you produce and company revenue. Innovation: We are an aggressive, modern company. We want you to experiment with new formats, tools, and strategies. Company culture: We value collaboration, professional growth, and fun. We regularly have company activities (online and offline) to stay connected and inspired. Growth: We are scaling rapidly. As we expand, your professional opportunities grow. Role Work Conditions Employment type: Full time position (remote). Working hours: Flexible work hours, with availability required Monday through Friday and a minimum overlap of 12:00–17:00 GMT+1. Contract type: You will join as an independent contractor. To simplify hiring outside our registered countries, we engage global talent through freelance contracts. Ready to define the future of industrial e-commerce? If you have the technical mind to understand our products and the strategic mind to market them, apply today. Highlights Tameson seeks a remote Head of Technical Content to build authority, create expert content, and optimize for AI. Independent contractor role. Originally posted on Himalayas
