items.title: Analytics Engineer II
items.summary: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. Financial Systems owns the data and reporting foundation for Accounting, and the operational reliability of the pipelines that power reporting, reconciliations, and automation. We…
items.description: At Affirm , we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. Financial Systems owns the data and reporting foundation for Accounting, and the operational reliability of the pipelines that power reporting, reconciliations, and automation. We are building a single source of truth for financial information using dbt and Snowflake to enable scalable BI and process automation across the org. We are hiring an Analytics Engineer focused on maintaining and optimizing our finance data platform , improving reliability, efficiency, and performance of our pipelines and core datasets. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys operational ownership, building strong foundations, and making data systems easier and safer to run at scale. What You’ll Do Build and maintain dbt models and core datasets that support Accounting reporting and downstream automation use cases. Improve platform reliability through strong testing patterns, alerting, and runbooks. Own and document data pipelines and lineage, ensuring changes are understandable and auditable. Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve production data issues, and drive root-cause fixes. Optimize performance and cost in Snowflake and dbt to support scaling needs. Partner with engineering and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable, well-tested data assets. Contribute to the team’s best practices in version control, code review, documentation, and release hygiene (GitHub-based workflows). What We Look For 3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or similar roles working with production data systems. Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience building in dbt (modeling, testing, documentation). Experience operating in a modern development workflow: Git and pull-request based collaboration (GitHub preferred). Familiarity with standard IDEs and collaborative debugging practices. Experience working with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake preferred). A strong sense of ownership and comfort working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments. Nice to Have Finance/accounting data familiarity (e.g., close concepts, reconciliations, ledger-style modeling). Experience with integration/automation platforms (Workato, Fivetran, or similar). Experience supporting reporting layers and BI tooling. Working knowledge of Python for data manipulation and automation. Familiarity with CI pipelines and quality gates for code quality, testing, and build validation. Interest in applying AI-assisted development responsibly within engineering guardrails. Total rewards We believe the people building honest financial products at Affirm should share in its success. That's why our total rewards are designed to support your health, growth, financial well-being, and future. In service of our mission, we reward employees through a combination of base pay, equity (from parent company), and comprehensive benefits. Base Pay Grade - K 226,000 zł - 346,000 zł Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company). Base pay ranges and placement within those ranges are determined based on several factors, including role, experience, and job-related skills. In addition to base pay, all employees in this role are eligible to receive equity from the parent company each year. This means as Affirm’s parent company grows, employees have the opportunity to share in that growth financially. Equity Grade - 2 (awarded in US Dollars) Affirm Holdings, Inc. Equity Grade example Equity grade: 2 New hire equity: $16,000-$24,000 Annual Refresh: $5,000 Reward equity: $0-$75,000 Affirm also provides flexible spending wallets to all employees for technology and wellbeing related needs, which are reimbursable up to 1390 zł per month. In addition to your compensation, our comprehensive benefits are designed to support you and the people who matter most. Benefits include: Competitive paid time off, paid public holidays, and additional paid Away Days to rest and recharge. Comprehensive private healthcare through Lux Med's Platinum package. A MultiSport card to support your health and well-being. Learning and development programs to help you grow professionally. Family healthcare support through Maven and parental leave support through Parentaly. Mental well-being support through Lyra, including up to 12 confidential counseling or coaching sessions each year for you and your household members. items.title: Media Buyer
items.summary: Our client, Jugabet, is a brand and gaming platform accessible to players in Latin America.
items.description: Our client, Jugabet, is a brand and gaming platform accessible to players in Latin America. With a strong regional focus and localized strategies, Jugabet is quickly becoming a key player in the market. Perfect for those who aim to: Plan, launch, and scale ad campaigns on Facebook and TikTok (Google UAC is a plus) targeting relevant iGaming audiences in Mexico; Build and continuously refine the audience layer: Look-A-Like and Custom audiences based on depositors, high-value players, and in-app events; Design and run retargeting funnels across the full path (install, registration, first deposit, etc.); Launch and optimize ROAS / value-based campaigns (value optimization, tROAS); Manage ad accounts for the long run: respect the learning phase, control creative fatigue cycles, scale incrementally, and keep performance stable over months instead of restarting from scratch; Own the app acquisition funnel: deep links, in-app event mapping, and passing deposit events back to Meta and TikTok via CAPI / server-side tracking; Optimize toward cohort economics, not just front-end CPA: work with D7/D30 ROAS, retention, and player LTV together with the CRM and retention teams; Analyze campaign data, build performance reports, and identify improvement areas across every platform (experience with Tableau or Power BI is a plus); Collaborate with creative and content teams to develop l ocalized ad assets for Regulated Market — language, cultural context, and seasonality; Conduct structured A/B testing (creatives, audiences, bidding strategies) to improve performance and engagement; Stay on top ofMeta and TikTok gambling ad policies and platform updates that affect the vertical; Monitor competitors and market trends across paid social to spot new opportunities. Experience you’ll need to bring: 2+ years of hands-on media buying on Facebook and TikTok (Google UAC is a plus), with a proven track record in regulated LATAM iGaming markets; Experience promoting products on white / regulated iGaming markets — or a strong background in white niches (mobile apps, gaming) with a clear understanding of platforms compliance; Confident work with Facebook Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager: campaign structure, Advantage+/ASC, bidding strategies, CBO/ABO budget distribution; Hands-on experience building and testing Look-A-Like and Custom audiences, with a clear sense of which source audiences actually scale; Experience with retargeting in Facebook: funnel logic, audiences, exclusions, and creative sequencing; Experience launching and scaling ROAS-based campaigns and understanding how conversion data quality drives algorithm performance; Understanding of how FB/TikTok algorithms behave over time: learning phase, signal quality, creative fatigue, incremental scaling instead of aggressive edits; Solid setup of tracking and attribution: Pixel, CAPI / server-side events, deep links, AppsFlyer / Adjust, S2S postbacks, Voluum or similar trackers; Comfortable with app-based acquisition: WebView / iOS / Android apps, MMP configuration, in-app event tracking; Understanding of core metrics: CPM, CPC, CTR, CPI, CPR, CPD, CPA, ROAS / ROMI, plus retention and LTV of acquired players; Experience working with budgets from $50,000+ per month, with a demonstrated ability to scale while keeping CPA profitable; Working knowledge of Meta and TikTok gambling policies: licensed advertiser setup, whitelisting, and healthy ad account structure; Upper-Intermediate level of English. It's a perfect match if you have those personal features: Analytical & Data-Driven mindset: enjoys diving into numbers, spotting trends, and making performance-based decisions; Detail-Oriented: carefully monitors campaign metrics, budgets, and compliance to avoid costly mistakes; Proactive & Results-Oriented: takes initiative, owns performance, and is constantly looking for ways to improve ROMI; Strong Communication & Collaboration Skills: able to clearly communicate ideas, strategies, and results within the team, works well with cross-functional teams (creative, product, CRM, compliance) to hit shared goals. Our clients offer competitive benefits to support your professional and personal growth, including: Health & Wellness Focus; Global Medical Coverage; Growth Opportunities; Benefits Programs (compensation for the gym/stomatology/psychological service Performance-Driven Rewards; Dynamic Work Environment. Apply, and let your growth journey begin. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Marketing Analyst
items.summary: PLEASE NOTE THIS ROLE IS FOR OVERSEAS APPLICATION, NON -U.
items.description: PLEASE NOTE THIS ROLE IS FOR OVERSEAS APPLICATION, NON -U.S. ONLY. NO DOMESTIC (U.S.) APPLICATIONS WILL BE CONSIDERED. Marketing Analyst We are looking for an experienced Marketing analyst to support our marketing team. Your responsibilities will include tracking online marketing trends, collecting and analyzing data, building predictive models, optimizing and reporting marketing campaign performance. Marketing analyst will report into Marketing analytics lead. What You’ll Be Responsible For: Collecting and analyzing customer, marketing, and web behavioral data. Testing campaigns, analyzing key metrics, and identifying opportunities to increase campaign performance. Developing and presenting learnings from your analyses, including actionable insights and recommendations. Developing digital campaign and web measurement strategies. Creating dashboards, data visualizations, and campaign performance reports. Monitoring and analyzing digital media and marketing trends. Communicating and presenting to colleagues, senior managers, and internal clients. In collaboration with data engineers optimize data workflows, control for data consistency and coverage across domains and IT solutions (Looker, Snowflake, etc.). What We’ll Love About You: You are proactive, you take the initiative and offer the lines of approach instead of dumping the problem on the others You know how to communicate your opinion in a simple, well-argued manner backed by the numbers and are able to finish things you have started You like to solve complex and new problems, try new technologies, monitor the market, and constantly evolve. You are not afraid to make mistakes or admit not knowing something You are open to new and difficult challenges What You’ll Need to Have: 3+ years of data analytics work experience. Intermediate in statistical methods, experimental design, using quantitative analysis to impact key decisions. Experience writing SQL queries and working with large data sets. Experience in product analytics and BI tools (eg. GA, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Looker, Tableau, or similar). Understand overall business value, rather than think and care just about numbers and charts. Hands-on experience collaborating with engineering teams on event tracking and analytics implementation (e.g., Google Tag Manager, custom events, data validation) High-level written and verbal communication skills. English language skills at upper intermediate level (or higher). Programming skills in R/Python. Experience applying LLMs (e.g., via APIs) for analytics use cases such as data exploration, anomaly detection, reporting automation, or building internal AI assistants Nice To Have: Familiarity with modern analytics stacks and data transformation tools (e.g., dbt or similar) Understanding of attribution models, incrementality testing, or marketing mix modeling fundamentals What You’ll Love About Us: Competitive base compensation Bonus program Paid Time Off and Work From Home A fun, creative and energetic work environment About Scentbird Scentbird inspires fragrance lovers to go beyond the ordinary and sample scents that evoke passion, confidence, and the unknown. Our mission is to revolutionize the way we perfume by bringing the ultimate fragrance playground right to your fingertips and offering a digital subscription service that lets members choose from over 1000+ designer perfumes each month. About the Brands: Scentbird : The easiest way for fragrance lovers to discover, try, and buy their favorite scented products without a commitment Deck of Scarlet: Deck of Scarlet is on a mission to break the clean category, redefining what clean fragrances should smell like. Composed entirely of vegan, cruelty-free ingredients, our fragrances bridge the gap between the clean and luxury categories, using the highest eau de parfum concentrations housed in sculptural, eye-catching bottles. You shouldn’t have to choose between being luxe and refined, or clean and vegan—now, you don’t have to. Confessions Of A Rebel: We were born in 2018, holding fast to the idea that the fragrance industry was in dire need of a change. When we looked around, all we saw was a sea of sameness: outdated archetypes of femininity and masculinity paired with unrelatable images of luxury that we had no say in. In truth, we are complex in ways that cannot be contained in the traditional heteronormative stereotypes, existing beyond the binary with raw, unfiltered voices that deserve to be heard. Goodhabit: Enriched with a blend of essential oils, Goodhabit’s clean, vegan, cruelty-free fragrances act as bottled intentions you set free with each mist. Our scents are designed to help you align with the good habits you’re building, while working to enhance and boost your mood. Inhale, exhale, and let the good energy flow through you. Sanctuary: Created for those who care about the fate of our planets, Sanctuary offers fragrance for a better future. Our clean, community-driven fragrances are inspired by endangered species and their habitats, each aimed at raising money and awareness for the preservation of their namesake. Drift: Drift began as an alternative to all of the tacky air care products on the market. Our products are designed to blend in, with amazing scents that stand out. We take pride in our fragrances, keeping them free from the traditional chemicals used in the fragrance industry. We are always phthalate and paraben free. We never skimp on quality of our scents or the products that deliver them. Our design ethos is simple but effective. We love our community, those who won’t settle for ordinary, and we want to deliver a best in class experience. Scentbird is committed to bringing individuals from different backgrounds and perspectives into the Nest. We strive to uphold an inclusive environment where individuals of all different backgrounds, ages, colors, ethnicities, gender, or gender identities, genetics, physical or mental abilities, protected veteran status, race, religious or sexual orientation, thrive. We respect the laws enforced by the EEOC and are dedicated internally to going above and beyond in fostering diversity. Come as you are - we’re excited to meet you. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Backend Software Engineer (Mid-Level)
items.summary: About DualEntryFounded in 2024, DualEntry is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI startups.
items.description: About DualEntry Founded in 2024, DualEntry is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI startups. At DualEntry , the future of finance is being written today. ERP is one of the largest fintech markets in the world ($220,000,000,000+). Yet, tens of thousands of companies are still using on-premise systems, and the industry has not seen new entrants in more than 30 years. Our AI-native ERP lets accounting teams achieve more in less time. $5M-ARR businesses to NYSE-listed companies trust DualEntry to automate away manual data entry work with AI. We’re finally making the one-person finance team a reality and putting the pain of legacy ERPs from the 1990’s in the past. We operate with urgency and ownership. We move fast. Why This Role Matters Now Since starting 18 months ago, we’ve raised $100,000,0000+ from world-class investors such as Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Contrary Ventures and Google Ventures, as well as more than 20 angel investors who’ve built, scaled, and exited some of the most impactful companies of the last decade. We got there by moving incredibly fast and hiring an exceptionally sharp, hard-working and deeply committed team from leading tech and accounting companies — Ramp, Meta, Microsoft, Lyft, PwC, Deloitte, J.P. Morgan, Bloomberg, Sage, Xero and Intuit. And some of us don't have a fancy logo on our resume and are here for a shot to prove ourselves. We’re a small team, growing fast with huge momentum - join early. This is an intense, hands-on role with full ownership. We expect you to push for excellence and raise the bar. As our Backend Engineer , you’ll build and own critical features end-to-end, increasing product velocity and powering DualEntry ’s AI-native ERP. This is an intense, hands-on role with full ownership. 📍 Location: Remote - this role is available across all EU/LATAM countries with overlap for the US ET timezone (NYC HQ) Where you'll create impact You’ll own end-to-end execution for backend systems and infrastructure You’ll build APIs, services, and real-time systems handling complex accounting logic You’ll collaborate with founders, product, and frontend engineering to turn complex workflows into secure, performant systems You’ll design, implement, and ship production-ready features at high speed You’ll manage data migrations, scaling challenges, external integrations, and end-to-end reliability You’ll drive measurable outcomes that accelerate DualEntry ’s product velocity and stability What sets you up for success Hardcore work ethic and high agency 5+ years of experience in backend engineering Proven track record in high-growth, high-ownership environments Strong skills in PostgreSQL, SQL, ORMs, migrations, and schema design Experience with AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure Strong API design and testing experience Understanding of CI/CD, deployment, and production readiness Bonus: expertise in Python and modern frameworks (FastAPI, Flask, or Django) Ability to manage complex systems with evolving requirements Fluent English (C1+) with clear communication How You Operate Pragmatic : you like to move forward and make decisions based in reality (not theory). We don't debate if Cassandra has the most theoretical scalability -- we use Postgres until it breaks Hard working : 'You can work long, hard, or smart, but [here] you can't choose two out of three" - Jeff Bezos. We wrote this job post during the weekend Curious : you love to learn, are highly curious about new frameworks and solutions to engineering problems Fast-moving: you deploy daily, iterate quickly, and never wait for permission Why you’ll thrive here Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry Your feedback shapes the product directly High-speed culture High-trust environment with high expectations Ambitious mission - ERP is one of the largest B2B software markets in the world ($220bn per year), this is a once in a lifetime opportunity to build the next generation ERP in an industry that has not seen new entrants in 30+ years Benefits & Perks Base Salary: $65,000 – $135,000 USD Equity: $50,000+ USD Contract type: B2B Remote-first team - the fastest team you will have ever worked with Time Off: 15 PTO days + 12 public holidays Visa sponsorship option for relocation to NYC within 2+ years Early-stage role with high autonomy and real long-term upside Enjoy a learning & development budget for courses, certifications, and language learning to keep growing your skills. Work where you feel most productive at co-working spaces or from your home office with support for setup, internet, and phone. Plus, wellness perks and more to make your workday even better! We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career - an archaic and huge industry like ERP only goes through a restructure like this once in a lifetime. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard! At DualEntry , we believe great products come from diverse teams. We’re an equal opportunity employer, and we’re committed to a culture where everyone feels included, supported, and able to do their best work. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: As the Business Partner, Customer Success (Program), you will be part of a dynamic Program Management Office team assigned to a specific Guidant Global MSP client, reporting into the Program Leader (Program Manager or Program Director). This role is commercially focused and accountable for protecting, growing, and defending the account by expanding spend, monetization, program adoption, and overall client value. It combines the day-to-day program delivery ownership of the Program Lead with the candidate-facing and supplier-facing rigor of the Senior Talent Consultant, wrapped in a strategic Business Partner lens toward the client’s Customer Success organization. You will be empowered to build senior stakeholder relationships, proactively identify new business opportunities within the account, lead a confident commercial talk track, and deliver flawless operations in conjunction with the Client Sponsor, Service Delivery team, and Shared Back-Office Services team. We are looking for an experienced MSP professional with incredibly high integrity, an inquisitive mind, strong commercial instincts, and a passion for operational and customer service excellence. Commitment to our culture, values, and behaviors: Achievement of the position objectives and key responsibilities is attained by: Fostering collaboration and building strong connections that drive Impellam’s strategy and initiatives forward. Championing respect and inclusion, ensuring every interaction reflects our commitment to equal opportunity and a positive workplace culture. Acting responsibly and with integrity, prioritizing the safety and well-being of yourself, others, the environment and our company. Key responsibilities: Commercial Ownership, Customer Success & Business Partnership – your top priority is building relationships and driving measurable commercial impact across the client account: Commercial Ownership – protect, grow, and defend the account by identifying opportunities to increase spend, monetization, program adoption, and overall account value. Business Development – proactively hunt for new opportunities within the account, including new departments, hiring managers, labor categories, service lines, and areas of unmanaged or under-penetrated spend. Senior Relationship Management – build and maintain trusted relationships with senior and executive client leaders, carrying a confident commercial talk track that connects program performance to business outcomes. Customer Success Business Partnering – act as a proactive Business Partner to the client’s Customer Success, HR, Procurement, and Hiring Manager stakeholders, translating program data into practical insight, recommendations, and growth opportunities. Client Relationship & Satisfaction Management – develop and maintain business relationships with key client stakeholders and hiring managers, ensuring the program is positioned as a strategic solution rather than a transactional delivery function. Commercial Thought Leadership – be viewed as a subject matter expert to the client; provide ongoing training, education, and market insight for HR, Procurement, Customer Success, and Hiring Manager stakeholders. Communication – support delivery of relevant corporate, client, and team communications, ensuring messaging reinforces account growth, program value, and stakeholder alignment. Issue Resolution – ongoing management and resolution of program, team, and people issues that may impact client satisfaction, account health, or commercial momentum. Commercial Rhythm, Pipeline & Business Reviews: Pipeline Management – maintain visibility to active and future account opportunities, tracking progress, barriers, next steps, and stakeholder engagement required to convert growth opportunities. Forecasting & Target Management – support account forecasting against growth, spend, utilization, and program expansion targets, using data to identify risks and opportunities early. QBRs & Business Reviews – own or support the regular client business review cadence, preparing clear insights on program performance, value delivered, pipeline, market trends, and recommended actions. Program Management: Day-to-Day Operations – work closely with the Service Delivery and back-office teams to ensure that day-to-day client requirements are being met; ensure SLA/KPI compliance is met at all levels. Supplier/Vendor Operations – actively manage the reporting and KPIs to ensure supplier performance for appropriate job category coverage, response timing and candidate quality, ongoing supplier rationalization and optimization. Escalation Management – proactively identify and successfully manage through day-to-day issues that impact program performance and client satisfaction levels, escalating to the Program Leader as needed. VMS Management – build a strong relationship with the VMS Supplier to ensure system performance meets customer expectations. Experienced with Business Intelligence Tools – Power BI preferred. Billing, Reporting & Analytics: Ensure accurate and timely billing, reporting, and ongoing analysis, including scheduled and ad hoc requests; prepare weekly and monthly status reports on program activity, account health, pipeline, and issues. Project Management – support the management and implementation of program/project modifications and enhancements. Continuous Improvement – use experience, data, and analytics to drive improvements in program process, utilization, satisfaction, and commercial performance. Workplace Health, Safety, and Environmental Compliance: At Impellam, it is our moral obligation to safeguard each other, our customers, our temporary workforce and the environment by operating an injury-free, healthy workplace that minimizes our environmental impact. Impellam is committed to providing a safe and secure working environment for all employees and promoting best practices. You will meet our HSE obligations by committing to: Seek to prevent injury to any employee, customer, worker, or contractor. Actively participating and completing compliance training as required. Consider the safety implications of decisions. Work experience and attributes: Essential: Knowledge of: Staffing Industry, Managed Service Provider (MSP), Vendor Management Systems (VMS), Procurement, Statement of Work (SOW), Human Resources (HR). Experience leading teams to meet service level agreements and key performance indicators relevant for MSP business performance; strong experience, and detailed orientation, in report development, management, and QA. Experience in identifying and leading initiatives for process improvement. Project Management experience. Effective communication, presentation, time management, organization, and planning techniques. MS Excel and MS PowerPoint. Experienced with Business Intelligence tools and driving decisions using analytics. Commercial account management disciplines, including pipeline management, forecasting, QBR/business-review preparation, stakeholder mapping, and growth planning. Modern sales technology and CRM platforms, including Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics, and tools such as ZoomInfo, Outreach, Gong, Highspot, or similar enablement and intelligence platforms. Ability to: Demonstrate a track record of growing and maturing client relationships. Demonstrate fiscal responsibility for account management. Manage by influence. Demonstrate excellent communication. Problem solves and present conceptual information to all levels of internal and external management. Initiate, recommend, or provide solutions through designated channels. Build and execute project plans. Manage data collection and reports for regular and ad hoc reporting needs. Core Competencies: Passion for excellence. Stress tolerance and ability to thrive in a dynamic environment. High level of attention to detail. Proactive approach to supporting a team and client partnership. Urgency and speed of response. High level of dedication and accountability. Minimum of 3 years of experience as part of a Managed Service Program or Staffing management environment. General Understanding of: MSP / Human Capital / Staffing. Human Resources. Procurement. Contracts. This job description describes the principal purpose and main elements of the role. It is a guide to the nature and main duties as they currently exist but is not intended as a wholly comprehensive or permanent schedule and is not a contractual document. This document may be amended to meet the changing needs of the business. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Compensation & Benefits Manager
items.summary: In the MGID team, we're currently seeking a driven individual who thrives on challenges and is eager to dive into the world of analyzing performance and understanding people's behaviors through data.
items.description: In the MGID team , we're currently seeking a driven individual who thrives on challenges and is eager to dive into the world of analyzing performance and understanding people's behaviors through data. Our ideal candidate is someone who embraces uncertainty and is determined to forge mutually beneficial relationships. At our company, we're all about evolution and innovation. We're constantly refining our processes and exploring new ideas. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to experiment with various strategies and see your ideas come to life. You'll be joining a dynamic team that's committed to growth and success. While we can't promise it'll be a walk in the park, we can guarantee an exciting journey filled with interesting goals, demanding challenges, learning and growth. As we continue to expand rapidly, you'll be part of a team that operates in its own time zone, constantly pushing boundaries and embracing diversity. So, we are looking for a highly skilled and experienced professional to join our HR department as a Compensation & Benefit Manager. This role will focus on overseeing and managing our company's compensation and benefits programs on a global scale. If you're ready to take on new challenges and be part of a vibrant, forward-thinking team, then we want to hear from you! Apply now and let's embark on this journey together Who We are: MGID is a global advertising platform helping brands reach unique local audiences at scale. In MGID we empower brands and publishers to work together transparently through our privacy-first targeting technology to enable advertisers to drive performance and awareness, and publishers to retain and monetize their audiences. Today, we’re creating unique technologies and with your help, we are looking to aim even higher. What You'll Do: Improving and managing global compensation and benefits policies to align with organizational objectives and comply with local regulations. Analyzing market trends and conducting benchmarking to ensure competitive and attractive compensation and benefits packages for potential and existing employees. Utilizing financial analysis skills to assess the impact of compensation and benefits programs on the company’s financial performance. Monitoring the effectiveness of KPIs and balancing them with the business (revenue, expenses, margin). Providing guidance and support to HR teams globally on compensation-related matters, including salary structures, bonus programs, and incentive schemes. Progressing and refining compensation and benefits programs to provide a competitive level of pay, motivation, and reward to employees, as well as protection. Enhancing fair and attractive incentives and/or bonus programs for specific employee categories. Collaborating with HR and finance teams to develop and monitor budgets for reward programmes. Creating dashboard reports to track the reward dynamics of different groups of employees. Calculate variable pay, commissions, and bonuses for different departments accurately and on time (e.g., applying specific metrics and rules for Sales, PubDev, and other teams). Prepare and update regular reports, as well as generate ad-hoc (on-demand) reports for HR or management when needed. Requirements Who You Are: 7+ years of relevant experience in Compensation & Benefits, financial controlling, FP&A, workforce analytics, or a similar analytical role, with substantial hands-on exposure to compensation management. Experience supporting or designing compensation governance , including approval processes, budget controls, salary exceptions, promotions, new hires, and replacement hiring. Strong analytical capability, including experience interpreting large datasets, identifying anomalies and trends, conducting audits, and providing management with clear data-driven recommendations . Experience conducting market compensation benchmarking and translating market data into actionable recommendations on pay positioning and compensation adjustments. Practical experience in designing, reviewing, or managing compensation structures , including salary ranges/bands, job levels, annual salary review processes, variable compensation, and benefits. Experience working in a multi-country/international organization and understanding the challenges of compensation across different markets. A degree in HR Management and/or Statistics/ Finance is preferred. Professional certifications (GRP, WorldAtWork, etc.). B2 level or above proficiency in English. Technical Skills: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills , including complex formulas, lookups, Pivot Tables, financial models, and analysis of large datasets. Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar BI tools is preferred. Analytical Mindset: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on working accurately with numbers and financial metrics. Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy and responsibility, especially when calculating bonuses and working with sensitive payroll information. Ethics & Confidentiality: Strict understanding of corporate ethics and the ability to maintain absolute confidentiality regarding employee compensation data. Communication: Strong written and spoken communication skills to collaborate effectively with the HR team and answer basic employee questions. MGID is an awesome place to work for those who share results-driven culture, passion for AdTech, innovation, and human focus . We set ambitious goals, approach challenges with enthusiasm, and value honesty, transparency, and empathy. We celebrate the diversity and the unique contributions of each individual. By embracing these values, we create a culture of excellence, creativity, and empathy. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Join us and unleash your full potential in a fun and rewarding environment! Let's create better together. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Data Science Manager
items.summary: We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking. After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint…
items.description: We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking. After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us. With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers! We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️ London or UK remote | £100,000 to £130,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits | Technology - Data ⭐ About Data at Monzo Data is at the heart of how we make decisions and build products at Monzo. Our Data teams bring together Data Science, Analytics Engineering, Data Analytics and Machine Learning, working closely with Product, Engineering and other teams across the business. Our Data Scientists are embedded within product and business areas across Monzo, where they use experimentation, causal inference, statistical modelling, machine learning and analytics to understand our customers, identify opportunities and influence the direction of our products and strategy. As a Data Science Manager , you'll lead a team of Data Scientists and other Data professionals within one of these areas, combining people leadership with strategic data leadership and close partnership with senior stakeholders. You'll play a key role by... You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering and senior leaders to ensure data plays a central role in how we understand problems, make decisions and develop our products. You'll lead and develop a team of talented Data Scientists, helping them do their best work while setting a high bar for analytical quality and impact. You'll provide strategic direction across complex problems, help teams identify where Data Science can have the greatest impact, and ensure insights translate into meaningful decisions and product changes. We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across Monzo. We're big believers in powerful, accessible analytics and empowering teams across the business to answer questions themselves. Around 90% of our day-to-day data-driven decisions are supported by self-serve analytics through Looker, giving our Data teams the space to focus on higher-impact problems. Your day-to-day Lead, develop and grow a team of exceptional Data Scientists and other Data professionals. Hire, coach and retain talented people while creating an environment where they can develop and do their best work. Set the Data Science direction for your area and identify where data can have the greatest customer and business impact. Partner with Product, Engineering and senior stakeholders to shape strategy and influence product direction. Bring analytical rigour to complex and ambiguous problems and help teams turn them into clear, actionable opportunities. Ensure teams are using the right analytical approaches, from experimentation and causal inference through to statistical modelling and machine learning. Help connect Data Science work to measurable customer, product and commercial outcomes. Work with Analytics Engineering, Machine Learning and other Data disciplines to ensure teams have the data, tooling and infrastructure they need. Contribute to the wider Data Science discipline at Monzo, helping us continually raise the bar for how we work. We'd love to hear from you if... What we're doing at Monzo excites you! You have significant experience managing and developing Data Scientists. You're a strong strategic data leader who uses data to influence decisions and direction. You have experience partnering with senior and executive stakeholders across different functions and levels of seniority. You're comfortable working autonomously in a fast-growing and evolving organisation. You have a strong understanding of Data Science approaches including experimentation, causal inference, statistical analysis and machine learning. You're comfortable with tools and languages such as Python and SQL, and understand how to choose the right analytical approach for a problem. You can build credibility with Product, Engineering and senior business leaders and influence without relying on authority. You have strong product judgement and experience using Data Science to shape product development and strategy. You know how to balance technical excellence with pragmatic decision-making and business impact. You have experience helping Data Scientists develop their technical, product and leadership capabilities. The interview process Our interview process involves 3 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions! 30-minute recruiter call 45-minute call with the hiring manager 3 x 1-hour video calls with various team members Our average process takes around 3–4 weeks, but we'll always work around your availability. You'll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during the process. What's in it for you ✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK ✅ We can sponsor visas This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK, with ad hoc meetings in London. ⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team. Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences ➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here #LI-LG1 #LI-Remote Equal opportunities for everyone Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog , 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report. We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status. If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage

items.title: Payments Product Manager
items.summary: Precoro is an innovative AI-powered procurement centralization & automation platform, helping companies eliminate manual tasks and control purchasing activities across all subsidiaries.
items.description: Precoro is an innovative AI-powered procurement centralization & automation platform, helping companies eliminate manual tasks and control purchasing activities across all subsidiaries. With over 1,000 customers in more than 80 countries, Precoro has proven its ability to create real business value and deliver substantial cost savings. Over the past 10 years, we have: Gathered 100+ the best specialists on our team Launched 10 large-scale integrations (including with Amazon, Slack, and Google) Helped 1000+ clients improve purchasing operations We're looking for a proactive, hands-on Payments Product Manager with a track record of owning payment integrations end-to-end. You'll take full ownership of how Precoro connects to payment providers and processes transactions, making sure the payment layer scales reliably across our customers in 80+ countries. This role comes with real autonomy: room to bring your own ideas, drive the direction, and the resources to make it happen - without micromanagement or endless approval chains. What you'll do Own the Payments product area end-to-end - from discovery and requirements through delivery, launch, and post-launch iteration Understand customer payment workflows across our global client base and translate them into a prioritized, ROI-driven roadmap Create and maintain integrations with payment providers, ensuring reliability, security, and compliance across markets Coordinate across Engineering, CS, Marketing, Sales, and external payment partners to keep the product ready for new markets and payment methods Define and track success metrics, using data to identify friction points and measure impact on adoption and revenue Lead your cross-functional team, setting a standard for clear documentation, sharp prioritization, and shipping with quality What we look for Hands-on experience building or scaling payment integrations from scratch (routing, PSP/acquirer integrations, virtual cards, ACH, or cross-border payments) 3-5+ years as a Product Manager, with a track record of shipping features end-to-end Strong ability to work with APIs and technical integrations, including the messy parts: partner limitations, versioning, error handling, reconciliation Critical thinking and comfort navigating ambiguous, multi-layered problems with no obvious shortcuts Outstanding skills in stakeholder management - you can align internal teams, and external partners around a shared roadmap Experience working with data to inform decisions - comfortable writing SQL queries or using BI tools (Power BI/Tableau/Looker) for KPI analysis Nice-to-have skills Experience with B2B SaaS or API-first product development Familiarity with using AI tools as part of your day-to-day product workflow Why you'll love working at Precoro Trust-based management: No micromanagement - your ideas and initiatives are always encouraged. Supportive team culture: You're not alone, our team is open, honest, and always ready to help. Reimbursement for professional learning: We invest in your growth through courses, lectures, and more. Flexible hours: We care about results, not how long you sit at your desk. 26 days off annually : Work-life balance is a priority for us. Medical insurance and unlimited sick leave without requiring a medical certificate. Your health matters most. Hiring Process Our hiring is quick and straightforward: Recruiter interview (45 minutes) Interview with a manager (1 hour) Test task Test task presentation with the team (1 hour) We foster an environment where everyone is encouraged to contribute ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive business growth! Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: BI Analyst – Trading Operations (Esports) (m/f/x)
items.summary: • Do you have experience building BI dashboards or automated reporting systems that support trading or sportsbook performance monitoring?
items.description: Do you have experience building BI dashboards or automated reporting systems that support trading or sportsbook performance monitoring? Have you worked with large datasets using SQL to create clean, analysis-ready tables, and used them to generate actionable insights Are you comfortable translating complex data set into clear insights and recommendations for non-technical stakeholders, such as traders? About the role GRID is looking for a BI Analyst to join our Trading team and support esports trading operations through data, reporting, and statistical tools. The core focus of this role is to build and maintain statistical modules for traders and provide clear performance and actionable insights to trading. You will work closely with traders, analytics, and data teams to ensure trading decisions are supported by accurate, timely, and actionable data. Requirements What you will do Build and maintain trading performance dashboards and reports using appropriate BI and reporting tools Build clean, reliable datasets using advanced SQL to support analysis and modeling, and collaborate with Engineering to productionize scalable data solutions Develop automated tools and dashboards that help stakeholders monitor performance, identify opportunities, and make data-informed decisions Develop dashboards and reports for monitoring trading performance Create automated reporting pipelines for daily/weekly performance metrics Establish KPI frameworks and performance tracking systems Work closely with Analytics and Data teams to align metrics and data definitions Optimize data queries and ETL processes for performance Ensure data accuracy and consistency across reporting systems Support traders with ad-hoc analysis and insights Your skills will include 2–5 years of experience in BI, analytics, or reporting roles Advanced proficiency in SQL and experience building structured, analysis-ready datasets Experience with BI platforms (Tableau, PowerBI, Looker, or equivalent) Understanding of sportsbook or trading KPIs (turnover, GGR, margin, exposure) Strong attention to detail and data quality Ability to communicate insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders A demonstrated ability to translate large, complex datasets into clear recommendations and effectively communicate insights to cross-functional partners A proactive, collaborative mindset with a strong interest in performance optimization Nice to have Experience in esports or sports betting Familiarity with statistical analysis for trading Python knowledge would be a plus, but not a requirement Highlights Drive the growth of GRID ’s esports data across the emerging prediction markets ecosystem. Apply today! Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Manager, Business Performance & Analysis
items.summary: ABOUT ALUALU provides higher education for a higher purpose.
items.description: ABOUT ALU ALU provides higher education for a higher purpose. Our students declare missions, not majors.They develop the real-world skills to take on the world’s most pressing challenges. And they take ownership of their learning from day one through our peer and student-led approach – because ALU believes in the power and agency of young people to start shaping the future right now. Together with a world-class faculty and staff, our students are igniting a ripple of positive impact across Africa and the world. We are dedicated to fostering an open yet secure environment, balancing the safety of students, staff, and visitors with respect for individual rights, and safeguarding responsibilities. HOW WE WORK The ALU Team works in starkly different ways to traditional academic bureaucracies. We approach education from first principles, empower individuals to design, test, and implement creative new ideas, and work closely together to craft transformative learning experiences. We are deeply passionate about our students and excited by the challenge of building something entirely new. The African Leadership University is committed to ensuring the safety and Well-being of all students under our care. As part of this commitment , we have a comprehensive safeguarding policy in place , which outlines our Zero-tolerance approach to any violation of safeguarding. ABOUT THE TEAM The Business Performance & Analysis team is one of ALU ’s core performance intelligence functions, providing the insight, analysis and challenge required to help leaders understand performance, make informed decisions and improve institutional outcomes. Working across academic and professional functions, the team goes beyond reporting what has happened to understand why it happened, what it means, what is likely to happen next, and what action is required. It brings together performance data, analysis and external benchmarks to identify trends, risks, opportunities and areas for improvement. The team connects strategy, performance and execution by strengthening performance measurement, supporting decision-making and helping leaders translate insight into action. Its impact is measured not by the volume of reports produced, but by the quality of decisions informed and the improvements in institutional performance that follow. ABOUT THE ROLE The institution generates a great deal of information and data across campuses, programmes and systems held by functions with different definitions and different reporting rhythms. The Manager, Business Performance & Analysis will assemble it, identify what matters in it and put that in front of the people who have to decide. You are expected to find the insight inside fragmented institutional information and make it usable by the people who have to act on it. This role goes beyond producing analysis to deciding what the analysis means, what can reasonably be concluded from it, and the form in which that meaning will actually land. The role will enable the University to act on what its own information is telling it by bringing together fragmented evidence, establishing what matters and putting it in front of the right person in a form they can use. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Research, Economic Analysis and Insight (the core of the role) Produce quantitative and economic analysis underpinning material submitted to the Executive Committee and the Board including scenario work, unit economics, capacity and cost modelling, cost behaviour, and the baseline scenario against which a decision should be judged. Take fragmentary, inconsistent and incomplete inputs from several functions and produce one defensible view, with the areas of remaining uncertainty named rather than smoothed over. This is the central skill of the role. Interrogate the question behind the request. Where the question as asked will not produce a useful answer, clarify the decision that needs to be supported and propose the more useful analytical question. Maintain relevant external evidence, including comparator institutions, sector benchmarks, published research and precedent relevant to current analyses and decisions. Build and maintain the external evidence base: comparator institutions, sector benchmarks, published research, and precedent relevant to decisions in front of ALU . State assumptions explicitly, and state plainly what an analysis does not establish. Where required data does not exist, publish the gap rather than substituting a proxy without saying so. Review recurring analysis and underlying assumptions, identify material gaps or inconsistencies, and raise findings where further scrutiny is required. Communication and Decision-Ready Output Design data and insight presentations so the key finding is immediately visible rather than presenting the dataset in full. Treat chart selection, sequencing and emphasis as analytical choices. Determine the appropriate format for each piece of work, whether a written memo, one-page decision brief, chart, dashboard, model walkthrough or verbal briefing, based on the decision, audience and complexity involved. Write for senior readers with limited time: lead with the finding or decision required, support it with the relevant evidence, and state what remains unknown and what would resolve it. Adjust the level of detail, language and presentation across audiences including the Executive Committee, Board, departmental leaders and technical counterparts. Present analysis clearly and confidently, including the assumptions, limitations and implications of the work. Automation and tooling Support the development and maintenance of automated workflows for data extraction, reconciliation, monitoring and reporting, reducing recurring manual effort. Use AI-enabled tools, agents and scripted workflows to accelerate recurring analytical tasks, including drafting, summarisation, exception detection, data preparation and scheduled checks. Apply judgement to AI-generated outputs, validate results and identify where automation should not replace human review. Build and maintain escalation triggers within recurring analytical and monitoring processes so that exceptions, overdue actions or material changes generate timely alerts. Document analytical tools and workflows to a standard that allows another team member to operate, understand and modify them without reliance on the original author. Analytics Capability and Continuous Improvement Improve analytical methodologies, templates, reporting processes and tools used by the Business Performance & Analysis function. Identify recurring requests and manual processes that can be standardised, automated or redesigned. Establish practical quality checks for recurring analysis and reporting. Share analytical methods, tools and lessons learned across the team and support the development of analytical capability. Performance Tracking and Follow-through Maintain accurate records of key decisions, actions, owners, assumptions and review dates arising from performance and planning activities. Monitor agreed actions and escalation triggers and raise overdue or off-track items appropriately through appropriate and well suited digital tools. Maintain the document repository to support continuity, transparency and effective handover. Executive and cycle coordination Coordinate engagement requirements against the University's planning, review and reporting calendar, including committee dates, planning cycles, statutory requirements and reporting deadlines. Prepare the analysis, briefing material and supporting information required for those engagements. Track actions and commitments arising from key meetings and ensure they are reflected in the appropriate working records and follow-up mechanisms. Coordinate inputs across functions to ensure materials are complete, consistent and ready for review. Ensure the safety and well-being of all young persons and vulnerable adults with whom we deal, by adhering to ALU ’s comprehensive safeguarding policy, maintaining a zero-tolerance approach to any violations of safeguarding standards REQUIRED EXPERIENCE 6 to 8 years of relevant professional experience, with demonstrated experience producing analysis that informs decisions taken by people more senior than yourself, in a research institution, consultancy, financial institution, policy body, university, or comparable analytical function. Economic reasoning, evidenced by training or by practice. You think in terms of opportunity cost, marginal effects, incentives and counterfactuals, and you state your assumptions before your conclusions. A degree in economics or experience across consulting, policy research, financial analysis or a quantitative discipline. Demonstrated ability to turn complex analysis into concise executive communication, including decision briefs, presentations, dashboards or written recommendations. Working competence in Python or R for data analysis and evidence of having built or supported an analytical workflow that can run with limited manual intervention. Practical experience using AI-enabled tools, including large language models, agents or scripted workflows, to improve analytical productivity, automation or decision support. Demonstrated ability to take incomplete and conflicting inputs from multiple sources and produce a single defensible view. Demonstrated ability to become productive quickly in an unfamiliar subject area and build sufficient domain understanding to analyse it effectively. Experience working across functions with different data sources, priorities and perspectives is strongly preferred. Exposure to executive, Board or committee reporting is desirable. REQUIRED COMPETENCIES Functional Competencies Analytical Reasoning: Break down complex questions, identify the relevant variables and determine the analysis required to support a decision. Data Interpretation and Judgement: Analyse information critically, identify patterns and anomalies, test assumptions and assess what can reasonably be concluded. Economic and Financial Acumen: Understand opportunity cost, incentives, cost behaviour, revenue, contribution and the financial implications of decisions. Modelling and Forecasting: Build and interpret scenarios, forecasts and sensitivity analyses to support planning and decision-making. Digital and AI Fluency: Use analytical, automation and AI-enabled tools confidently to improve speed and quality while independently validating outputs. Executive Communication: Distil complex analysis into clear findings, implications and recommendations appropriate to the audience and decision required. Behavioural & Leadership Competencies Judgement: Recognise what matters, make sound calls with imperfect information and know when further analysis is warranted. Constructive Challenge: Question assumptions, identify weaknesses and raise material concerns directly and objectively. Ownership: Take responsibility for analytical quality, timeliness and usefulness from problem definition through to delivery. Collaboration: Work effectively across Finance, Data/IT, academic and professional functions while respecting ownership of underlying data and business processes. Delivery Discipline: Manage competing demands, coordinate contributors and deliver high-quality work to agreed timelines. Continuous Improvement: Improve processes, tools and ways of working so that recurring work becomes more efficient, reliable and scalable. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Federated Registry Data Scientist
items.summary: Company Overview Rhythm is a global, commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company committed to transforming the lives of patients living with rare neuroendocrine diseases.
items.description: Company Overview Rhythm is a global, commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company committed to transforming the lives of patients living with rare neuroendocrine diseases. We develop medicines for previously untreatable or undertreated diseases. We recognize the courage it takes for patients and their caregivers to begin their journey of advocacy to find the answers they need. Their courage inspires us to challenge convention, ask bold questions and seek answers for them. Every day, we strive for excellence through our willingness to adapt, learn, and our tenacity to overcome barriers, together. Opportunity Overview The Federated Registry Data scientist will contribute to the design, development and operation of a multi-country federated registry platform based on the Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership Common Data Model (OMOP CDM), in collaboration with specialized vendors for Extract-Transform-Load (ETL), hosting, and federated analyses. The role will serve as a primary point of contact between Rhythm, the selected vendors, and participating registries for data-related activities. The Data Scientist will oversee the local registry data collection (mapping, transformation, quality-check) and the federated analyses specifications and outputs within a federated OMOP CDM-based environment provided and maintained by the vendors. Responsibilities & Duties Federated analyses Oversee and supervise the vendor’s technical and analytical deliverables Oversee data collection, data quality check, ETL logic and data mapping to OMOP CDM Lead preparation and review of the statistical analysis plan, cohort definitions, variable definitions, and federated query specifications supported and executed by the vendors based on research questions proposed by the Scientific Committee, the participating centers or internally Perform external research proposals’ feasibility assessment before review by the Scientific Committee Ensure analytical outputs are clear and consistent with research questions, develop report for review by the scientific committee, and support the drafting of related publications Collaboration with vendors Collaborate with the vendor on source data review, OMOP mapping, ETL logic, and data quality checks, helping to identify, prioritize, and resolve quality issues Help with data-related questions raised by the vendor and coordinate timely responses from centers when local input is required Ensure that data-related discussions remain aligned with Rhythm’s scientific objectives, project scope, timelines, and budget Collaboration with sites/registries owners Support sites in understanding project data requirements, minimum datasets, expected formats, timelines, and quality control processes Coordinate with sites and the vendor to investigate data quality issues such as missing data, inconsistent values, duplicate records, etc. Collaborate with research teams (scientific committees, internal stakeholders, participating sites) to develop insights and drive evidence generation Perform any other relevant tasks as needed to support the team and company objectives. Qualifications & Skills Advanced degree in Life Sciences, Data Science, Information Systems, or an equivalent scientific or technical discipline Strong experience with healthcare data sources, including clinical registries, electronic health records, claims databases, healthcare databases, and real-world evidence projects Strong proficiency in R and/or Python Knowledge of healthcare standards, including OMOP CDM, Fast Health Interoperability Resources (FHIR), Systemized Nomenclature of Medicine Clinical Terms (SNOMED CT), etc. Knowledge of statistical methods in real-world evidence (RWE) Strong communication and interpersonal skills, capable of engaging with senior leadership and key stakeholders. Not accepting the status quo, working with a sense of urgency to deliver results Self-starter mentality who feels comfortable working in a fast-paced environment Cross-functional mindset focused on a seamless collaboration with internal and external partners Fluent in English This role is home office based. Rhythm operates in a hybrid-work model. Candidates applying must be willing and able travel internationally. More about Rhythm We are a dynamic and growing global team spanning more than a dozen countries. At Rhythm we are dedicated to transforming the lives of patients living with rare melanocortin-4 receptor (MC4R) pathway diseases by rapidly advancing care and precision medicines that address the root cause. Our team is passionate about expanding access to reach more patients and developing novel therapies for other rare neuroendocrine diseases, including congenital hyperinsulinism. At Rhythm Our Core Values Are We are committed to advancing scientific understanding to improve patients’ lives We are inspired to tackle tough challenges and have the courage to ask bold questions We are eager to learn and adapt We believe collaboration and ownership are foundational for our success We value the unique contribution each individual brings to furthering our mission Inherent in our core values is the commitment to act ethically and with integrity in all we do. items.title: Lead Vulnerability Intelligence Analyst (Europe or LATAM, Remote)
items.summary: Company Overview:Intel 471 empowers enterprises, government agencies, and other organizations to win the cybersecurity war using near-real-time insights into the latest malicious actors, relationships, threat patterns, and imminent attacks relevant to their businesses.
items.description: Company Overview: Intel 471 empowers enterprises, government agencies, and other organizations to win the cybersecurity war using near-real-time insights into the latest malicious actors, relationships, threat patterns, and imminent attacks relevant to their businesses. Founded in 2014, Intel 471 provides comprehensive intelligence and monitoring on threat actors. The company’s centralized TITAN platform enables intelligence and security professionals to access structured information, dashboards, timely alerts and intelligence reporting via web portal or API integration. Our pedigree is unmatched and we count upon a team with experience operating in the intelligence services, military, law enforcement and private threat intelligence companies in nearly every continent on earth. The Role: You own the technical depth of our vulnerability intelligence practice. When a new CVE drops, you're the person who determines what's actually true and decides what our customers should do about it. This is a team lead role where you'll set the technical standard for how we validate, assess, and communicate vulnerability risk. You'll also build and maintain the tooling that lets a small team cover the ever-growing world of vulnerability research. What You'll Do: Design, build, and deploy honeypot systems to monitor for exploitation activity. Acquire, test, and validate proof-of-concept exploits in virtual environments to confirm or refute claims about exploitability. Develop practical mitigations for cases where patching is delayed, impossible, or insufficient. These mitigations could include configuration hardening, network segmentation, ACLs, disabling features, or other controls. You'll devise techniques for detecting both attempted and successful exploitation by illuminating the artifacts defenders should hunt for. You'll write vulnerability reports that dive into the details about an exploit such as how it works, who is using it and who is being targeted. Automation is a key component of the role; you will build and maintain the systems we use to streamline vulnerability assessment and automate triage of vulnerability alerts. Required Qualifications: Every candidate must be able to: - Validate and test PoCs to verify the validity of exploitation claims. - Devise mitigation techniques beyond patching. - Devise techniques for detecting exploit activity, attempted or successful. - Write vulnerability reports such as Vulnerability Spotlights. - Identify new sources of vulnerability intelligence. - Train and mentor junior team members. Technical foundation: - Proficiency with at least one programming language (Python, Go, C/C++, or similar) sufficient to read exploit code, modify PoCs, and build tooling. - Hands-on fluency with virtual machines, containers, and re-usable lab environments for safe detonation and analysis. - Solid computer science fundamentals. - Thorough understanding of computing and internet fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS, TLS, authentication and authorization models, and how real systems are actually deployed. - Demonstrated subject-matter-expert-level depth. - A working bias toward automation. Strong candidates additionally bring: - Experience building honeypot or sensor systems to monitor real-world exploitation activity. - Experience building systems that streamline or automate PoC testing and validation. - Demonstrated ability to integrate a new intelligence source end-to-end, from evaluation and ingestion to normalization, enrichment and delivery. Also valuable: original vulnerability research or CVE credits; reverse engineering skills; detection engineering (Sigma, Snort/Suricata, YARA); SOC experience; familiarity with CVSS, CWE, EPSS, and the KEV catalog; public speaking or published writing. Benefits: Competitive compensation Remote-friendly culture Wellness programs A variety of professional development opportunities Inclusive culture focused on people, customers and innovation Our Culture: The Intel 471 team is constantly growing and is always on the lookout for talented professionals who seek to operate on the forefront of the fight against threat actors impacting our customers and partners. Our culture of humility and quiet professionalism is a core attribute of Intel 471 and everyone within it. Our culture is collaborative, supportive and fast-paced. We're a mission-driven company. We're looking for talented, 'can-do' minded people with a passion for always doing the right thing. We believe in supporting a progressive culture that allows all our people to be themselves, enjoy exciting opportunities and grow with us. That's why our culture is founded on our core values of openness, inclusion, integrity and client focus, which set the tone for how we work together and treat each other in order to empower us all – and foster a unique team spirit. Salary: Market competitive Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: San Francisco, CA or Remote (U.S.) Commercial Data Scientist Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients. At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you. This role can be filled in the Northeast (New York, NJ, Philadelphia, Boston), our San Francisco headquarters, OR other remote locations in the U.S. As a Commercial Data Scientist , you’ll work within cross-functional delivery teams alongside other analysts, engineers, and commercial stakeholders in discovering data insights to help improve healthcare. How you’ll make an impact: Deliver novel and impactful insights for client organizations using machine learning and AI technologies. Work closely with our Product, Platform Data, Insights & Strategy, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses. Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates and future projects. Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform. Embrace the challenge of a fast-paced environment to exceed client expectations The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team As an organization we value diversity - in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team. Collaboration —The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth. Passion for Data —You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights. Reliability – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success. Curiosity – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight. Respect – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals. About you: At least 4 years of professional experience as a Data Scientist or other related roles working with complex, high-volume, structured and unstructured datasets. Prior experience in a data science consulting role at firms such as ZS, Trinity, IQVIA, BlueMatter, etc., where you thrived in a fast-paced environment Advanced knowledge of statistical concepts — particularly exploratory data analysis, experimental design, and probability theory. Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques Proven ability to design, train, and evaluate large-scale production models using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. Advanced SQL proficiency — skilled at writing and optimizing complex queries across multiple tables and data relationships. Advanced Python skills, including understanding of object-oriented programming, production-grade code design, and modern data science libraries. Hands-on experience with distributed data processing tools and concepts for scalable analysis and model training. Excellent data visualization and storytelling abilities, with the capacity to translate technical insights into clear, compelling narratives for internal and client stakeholders. Curious, fast learner with a demonstrated passion for data, continuous learning, and staying current with advances in machine learning research. Fun Facts About the Client Intelligence team We have access to one of the richest healthcare datasets in the world, with deep information on hundreds of thousands of clinicians and their connections. Business decisions at Doximity are driven by our data, analyses, and insights. The members of our team bring a diverse set of technical and cultural backgrounds. We like to have fun - company outings, team lunches, and other social events! Compensation The anticipated total compensation for this role is $119,333 - $172,800 depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity. Our total compensation package may include: Base salary Equity (where applicable) Annual bonus or incentive compensation (where applicable) Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process. Some of our offerings include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance 401(k) with company match Flexible paid time off and company holidays Paid parental leave Professional development and learning opportunities Wellness and mental health resources Remote work support and home office stipend (where applicable) Why You'll Love Working Here At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care. Work with exceptional teammates. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation.
