items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Phoenix, Arizona URL: https://adventuretravel365.com/ Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform We have a big idea, and we’re looking for a top-notch Senior Full-Stack Developer to help us bring it to life. We’re building a new contractor referral and services marketplace, think Thumbtack or Angi , where clients can easily find and connect with contractors and service providers. The vision includes both an interactive web platform and mobile app, with everything from user accounts and referrals to job tracking, payments, advertising, and more. This is a fully remote, full-time, ongoing position, and we’re open to applicants worldwide. There are a lot of moving pieces, which is exactly why we’re looking for someone who has built something like this before and gets excited about taking a platform from an idea to a working product, then continuing to grow it with us. What You’ll Help Us Build The platform will have two main sides: clients looking for services and contractors/vendors looking for business. Some of the functionality we’re planning includes: Client and contractor/vendor accounts and profiles Contractor listings, categories, search, and filtering Service requests, inquiries, referrals, and lead management Job and project tracking Client and vendor dashboards Online payments and transaction tracking Reviews and ratings Notifications and communications Banner advertising and paid promotional opportunities Admin tools for managing the platform Reporting and analytics Secure management of user, job, and transaction data And probably more! We have a strong vision for where we want this to go, but we also want the right developer to help us determine the smartest way to build it. This will be an evolving platform, so we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with it, not simply complete a checklist of features. Who We’re Looking For We’d love to find someone with strong experience in full-stack web and mobile development , especially someone who has worked on a marketplace, booking platform, service-provider network, or another multi-user platform. You should be comfortable with: Full-stack web development Mobile or cross-platform app development Strong front-end and back-end development Multi-user marketplace platforms User authentication and account management Payment gateway integrations Databases and APIs Third-party integrations Dashboards and reporting Secure, scalable application architecture Cloud hosting and deployment Testing, maintenance, and optimization Using modern AI-powered development tools and integrating AI capabilities into web and mobile applications If you’ve worked on something similar to Thumbtack, Angi, TaskRabbit, Upwork, or another two-sided marketplace , we definitely want to hear about it. More Than Just Coding We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of instructions and starts coding. We want someone who can look at the big picture, ask the right questions, recommend the best technical approach, flag potential challenges, and help turn our ideas into a platform that’s intuitive, scalable, and built to grow. You’ll also be expected to study established platforms like Thumbtack and Angi , understand how their user journeys and marketplace functionality work from both the client and service-provider sides, and use those learnings to help us determine the best approach for our own platform. You should be able to take the project through planning, architecture, development, testing, launch, and beyond , while communicating clearly with a non-technical team along the way. Strong spoken and written English communication skills are important. You should be comfortable discussing ideas, explaining technical decisions clearly, and communicating regularly with a non-technical team. This is not a short-term build-and-leave project. We’re looking for someone who can stay with the platform as it grows, helping us continually improve, expand, and maintain it over time. Interested? Tell Us About Yourself Please send us: A quick introduction Your resume or LinkedIn profile Your portfolio and links to websites/apps you’ve built Examples of marketplaces, booking platforms, referral systems, or payment-enabled platforms you’ve worked on What you personally worked on for those projects Your experience using AI in development What technologies/frameworks you’d recommend for a project like this and why Your availability A short video introduction would be great, too! Nothing overly formal, just a quick introduction so we can get to know you, hear about your experience, and get a feel for how you communicate. Most importantly, show us what you’ve built. If you’ve helped create a multi-sided marketplace similar to Thumbtack or Angi, tell us about it. We’d love to see it. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/adventure-travel-365-senior-full-stack-developer-marketplace-web-mobile-platform

items.description: AI at Zapier At Zapier , we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently . Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process , including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to. Job Posted: 08/26 Location: Americas (North, Central and South America) Hi there! Zapier is hiring a Manager, Analytics & Strategy to lead our newly formed GTM Analytics team. This team is the central analytics home for Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and Customer Ops, with a mandate to deliver trusted GTM insights, improve the quality and speed of decision-making, and turn repeated questions into durable self-service analytics assets. You will manage a team of embedded analysts supporting Marketing, Sales, and Support/Customer Ops. Your team will own the day-to-day analytics interface for GTM leaders: funnel reporting, campaign performance, sales and support analytics, forecasting inputs, recurring business reviews, dashboarding, metric definitions, and urgent executive questions. This is a hands-on analytics leadership role. we're looking for someone who has deep analytics judgment, strong SQL skills, and real GTM domain expertise. You might come from a sales analytics, marketing analytics, revenue analytics, finance, or investment banking environment. The common thread is that you know how to operate with urgency, precision, and a high quality bar, and you are energized by analytics work: scoping ambiguous business questions, pressure-testing numbers, coaching people through complex GTM data questions, and delivering clear recommendations under time pressure. This is not a pure people-management role. You should be able to lean into advanced analytics, understand core statistical concepts, and guide work on experimentation, forecasting, or segmentation when the work calls for it, but the center of gravity is analytics leadership: trusted reporting, business partnership, analytical QA, stakeholder management, and building a faster, more consistent operating model for GTM data. You should also be AI-native in how you work and excited to make this team a proving ground for self-service analytics, analyst automation, and governed AI-assisted data workflows. Our Commitment to Applicants Culture and Values at Zapier Zapier Guide to Remote Work Zapier Code of Conduct Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier About You You are a hands-on analytics manager. You have 6+ years of experience in analytics, finance, revenue operations, marketing analytics, sales analytics, business operations, investment banking, or a related field. You have managed analysts or analytics-adjacent teams for at least 3 years, but you are still comfortable rolling up your sleeves to review SQL, inspect a dashboard, pressure-test assumptions, and help frame the answer. You have strong GTM analytics expertise. You understand how marketing, sales, customer operations, and revenue motions fit together. You have worked with funnels, pipeline, bookings or ARR, campaign performance, sales productivity, support performance, forecasting, attribution, segmentation, or lifecycle analytics. You know how to translate GTM questions into metrics, cuts, cohorts, and recommendations that leaders can act on. You are excellent with SQL and analytical reasoning. You read and write SQL, reason about grain and joins, identify data quality issues, and coach analysts toward cleaner, more reliable methods. You are comfortable with statistics and advanced analytics concepts such as confidence intervals, incrementality, cohorting, regression, forecasting, and experiment readouts, and you know when to partner with Data Science for heavier modeling work. You bring finance-grade rigor and urgency. You can operate in a fast-twitch environment where leaders need clear answers quickly. You know how to separate what must be directionally right today from what needs a deeper follow-up, and you keep quality high even when timelines are short. Experience in investment banking, finance, FP&A, revenue analytics, or another high-intensity analytical environment is a strong plus. You set a high bar for quality, trust, and communication. You know that GTM analytics only works when stakeholders trust the numbers. You build review mechanisms, documentation habits, and QA standards that make dashboards and analyses easier to trust. You can explain caveats without hiding behind them, and you help teams align on source-of-truth metrics across Data, Finance, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Ops. You are an excellent manager and coach. You raise the performance of analysts through clear expectations, thoughtful feedback, technical coaching, and strong prioritization. You know how to help analysts grow and coach them through ambiguous requests and work that should be automated or moved into self-service. You are AI-native and automation-minded. You actively use modern AI tools to accelerate analysis, QA SQL, summarize stakeholder context, produce documentation, and prototype workflows. You are excited to make AI central to the team's operating model, and to turn repeated analyst workflows into governed self-service assets, AI primitives, reusable dashboards, or model improvements. You can manage across analysts and data engineers. You understand the difference between stakeholder-facing analytics and data foundation work, and you help both groups work together effectively. Things You'll Do Lead the Analytics & Strategy team, managing analysts embedded with Marketing, Sales, and Support/Customer Ops. Build a fast, trusted operating model for intake, prioritization, QA, stakeholder communication, and recurring business reviews. Coach analysts to deliver high-quality work across funnel reporting, campaign performance, sales analytics, support analytics, forecasting, segmentation, attribution, and executive readouts. Partner with GTM leaders to clarify ambiguous questions, identify the decisions at stake, and make sure the team's work leads to concrete business action. Review SQL, dashboards, metric definitions, data caveats, and analytical narratives so the team can move quickly without lowering the quality bar. Make the team the intake point for self-service and AI automation opportunities: recognize duplicate asks, separate one-off requests from repeatable workflows, and turn recurring patterns into AI primitives, governed dashboards, metric documentation, and model improvement requests that build the robot over time. Bring advanced analytics judgment to experimentation, incrementality, cohort analysis, forecasting, segmentation, and statistical readouts, while partnering with Data Science for deeper modeling needs. Leverage AI tools in your own workflow and your team's workflows, helping the team move faster while maintaining accuracy, documentation, and governance. Develop analysts through clear expectations, direct feedback, growth paths, and a strong peer learning culture. How to Apply At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional. Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process. After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter! Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws. Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can review our privacy policy here . Zapier is committed to inclusion. As part of this commitment, Zapier welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and will work to provide reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact jobs@zapier.com . Application Deadline: The anticipated application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled. Even though we’re an all-remote company, we still need to be thoughtful about where we have Zapiens working. Check out this resource for a list of countries where we currently cannot have Zapiens permanently working.

Volunteers are core contributors whose work directly supports our mission of global compassion, collaboration, and action. About Solution Community : Solution Community is an international 501(c)(3) non-profit organization, pioneering an innovative social platform dedicated to enabling actionable change. With volunteers from over 70 countries, we are a testament to the power of global collaboration. Our team members bring experience from some of the world's most successful companies, including Apple, Toyota, Google, Netflix, Walmart, Meta, and many others. Our Mission: To foster a global community of compassion, uniting individuals and organizations to solve the world's social problems. We are the bridge that connects non-profits, businesses, philanthropists, and volunteers, empowering them to create meaningful change. Our Vision: A world united by collaboration, compassion, and action — where every person can thrive. At Solution Community , we are turning that vision into reality. Position Overview: We are seeking a Volunteer AI Full Stack Engineer who builds production software the way top AI-native engineers build in 2026: primarily through AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent), not the classical write-every-line, sprint-by-sprint engineering lifecycle. This is a vibe-coding role in the best sense — you move at the speed of AI-assisted development, but you bring the engineering judgment to keep quality high. Most "vibe coders" ship fast and buggy; we need someone who ships fast and correct. You'll design, generate, review, debug, and deploy real features for our platform, working directly with our CEO (who builds the same way) and our engineering team. Key Responsibilities AI-Accelerated Development Build and ship full features — front end, back end, integrations — primarily by directing AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.), not manual line-by-line coding. Rapidly prototype, iterate, and deploy working software in days, not sprints. Apply strong engineering judgment to review, debug, and harden AI-generated code — catching the bugs, security gaps, and architectural mistakes that typical vibe-coded output has. Design clear, specific prompts and technical specs that get AI tools to production-quality output on the first or second pass. Full Stack Ownership Develop and maintain responsive web applications, APIs, databases, and cloud services end to end. Own your features from spec through deployment — no separate QA/handoff cycle to lean on. Ensure application security, performance, and reliability despite the compressed build timeline. Collaboration & Support Work directly with the CEO and engineering lead on architecture and priorities — minimal process overhead. Document what you build clearly enough that another AI-native engineer (human or agent) can pick it up without you. Mentor other volunteers on AI-assisted development practices. What We Are Looking For Required Advanced, daily, hands-on proficiency with Claude Code, Codex, or an equivalent AI coding agent — able to architect, generate, debug, and ship full applications with AI as the primary development method, not an autocomplete assistant. Solid full-stack fundamentals (front end: React, Vue, or similar; back end: Node.js, Python, or similar) — enough to review, debug, and correct AI-generated code, not necessarily to write everything by hand. Experience with RESTful APIs and SQL and/or NoSQL databases. Familiarity with a cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure). A track record of shipping working software fast, with the discipline to test and verify it before calling it done. Preferred Experience with LLM/AI application development (OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, LangChain, RAG, vector databases, prompt engineering). Docker, Kubernetes, or other cloud-native deployment experience. Prior volunteer, nonprofit, or social-impact work. Skills Strong problem-solving and independent judgment — you catch what the AI gets wrong. Clear written communication (specs, docs, async updates). Comfortable operating with high autonomy and minimal process. Genuine interest in AI-native development and technology-driven social impact. Application requirement Include 2–3 examples of production apps or features you built primarily using an AI coding agent, with rough build time for each. This is the main filter — general dev experience without demonstrated AI-native speed will not be a fit for this role. What Success Looks Like Features shipped in days, not weeks, with bug rates comparable to (or better than) traditionally coded work. Code and architecture that the rest of the team can read, extend, and trust without a rewrite. Reliable, secure, working software in production — not demos. Growing autonomy: less spec detail needed from the CEO/lead over time as trust is established. What We Offer Global collaboration with leaders and strategists from top global companies. Meaningful impact on global causes and communities. A vibrant, multicultural team spanning 70+ countries. A supportive environment rooted in compassion, integrity, innovation, and collaboration. Flexible work with full autonomy. Opportunities for personal and professional growth. Originally posted on Himalayas

The role emphasizes Global partner engagement, relationship development, work quality, operational efficiency, long and short-term planning, and customer-oriented thinking. Through strong partnerships with Sharecare departments and global partners, the Manager of Global Central Operations drives market-leading performance quality and continuous operational excellence. Essential Job Functions: Provide support to Global partners’ leadership teams and global trainers to ensure they become SMEs. Deliver feedback and provide direction to Global partners. Ensure accountability and support of Global partners in meeting their SLAs. Communicate essential updates to internal initiatives, procedures, and policies. Support necessary documentation buildout, updates, and organization. Work closely with onshore Central Operations leadership team to ensure all workflows for global DC/QC teams align with internal SOPs, processes and procedures. Ensure adoption of and accountability of change management initiatives and ongoing oversight of implemented policies and processes for the Global team. Respond to escalated client/requester/interdepartmental issues. items.description: Design Headquarters: Remote - North America Why AssemblyAI AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. Our models serve 600M+ inference calls monthly, process 1M+ hours of audio daily, and power 2 billion+ end-user experiences. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for folks truly excited to join a small team and help define the future of the industry. We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - with under 100 people generating roughly $600K ARR per employee, we sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. That's not an accident; it's a deliberate choice to stay lean, move fast, and give every person on the team outsized ownership and impact. With thousands of customers including Granola, Fireflies, Figure AI, and CallRail, the company has real scale - processing over 2 million hours of audio daily and handling more than 1 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven and the trajectory is steep, but the team is still small enough that your fingerprints are on everything. If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build, this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name. We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. No matter your race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply! About the Role We're hiring our first Senior GTM AI Engineer . This is a software engineering job inside the revenue org. You will build the pipelines, internal tools, and agents that decide which companies we go after, how we reach them, and what our sellers see when they open their laptop in the morning. Most of what a sales ops team used to do by hand is now something you can write software to do. Finding every company building voice AI before they contact us. Researching an account and drafting the first email. Watching product usage and telling an AE when a customer is about to expand or churn. Keeping the CRM clean without anyone filling in forms. You will build those systems, run them in production, and be judged on whether pipeline and revenue move. Your users are our AEs, SDRs, and GTM leaders. Your job is to make a small team perform like one three times its size. What You'll Do Write code every day. Python services, SQL models, scheduled jobs, and small internal apps are most of the job. You'll use Claude Code and similar tools to ship in days what used to take a quarter. Build agents that do the work: account research, lead qualification, outreach drafting, CRM hygiene, and usage monitoring. Design them, give them tools and data, evaluate their output, and keep them running. Turn product usage data in BigQuery and Looker into signals sellers act on: usage alerts, expansion triggers, and account health scores. Build the account targeting machine: sourcing, enrichment, dedupe, and ICP scoring, from raw data to a ranked list in a rep's queue. Integrate the systems the team already uses (our CRM, enrichment providers, outbound tools) so data moves between them without a human in the loop. Keep funnel data trustworthy: routing rules, field governance, and attribution. Prototype fast, measure what works, kill what doesn't, and work directly with Sales and Marketing leadership on what to build next. Document what you build so it keeps running without you. What You'll Need 4+ years as a software engineer, data engineer, or growth/GTM engineer, with time spent shipping systems that other people depend on. Strong Python and SQL. You have owned production automations end to end: APIs, webhooks, scheduled jobs, retries, error handling, and monitoring. Experience building with LLMs beyond a single prompt: multi-step agents, tool use, retrieval, and evaluation. You can tell whether an agent's output is good, and you know when a plain script is the better tool. AI-assisted development is how you work. You use Claude Code or similar tools daily, and you have the engineering judgment to review, test, and stand behind what they produce. Solid fundamentals: clean code, version control, code review, debugging, and a habit of thinking in systems. You do not need an engineering team to ship. Curiosity about how a sales org works. You don't need a RevOps background, but you need to care about how deals get found and closed, and be willing to learn our CRM and the tools around it quickly. A builder's mindset with an operator's judgment: you scope for business impact, ship iteratively, and measure results in pipeline and revenue. Low ego, high ownership, and comfort being the single-threaded owner of an entire domain. Nice to Have Hands-on Salesforce or other CRM work at the object and API level, or experience with enrichment and outbound tools like Clay. dbt, BigQuery, and Looker, or an equivalent warehouse and BI stack. Time at a developer-facing or API-first company, or selling to technical buyers. You've been the first engineer in a sales or growth org and built the function from scratch. Pay Transparency: AssemblyAI strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size, stage, and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefit, and other reward opportunities we provide. There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level, qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range. The provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range which will be communicated to candidates throughout the interview process. Salary range: $160,000 to $220,000 AI to Interview: If you’re selected for an interview, please review this resource to better understand how AssemblyAI approaches the use of AI in our interview process. GDPR privacy notice: Candidates from the EU should review this job applicant privacy notice before applying. Keep Exploring AssemblyAI: Speech-to-text | Streaming speech-to-text | Speech Understanding | LLM Gateway Try the Playground Our $50M Series C fundraise Check us out on YouTube! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/assemblyai-senior-gtm-ai-engineer

items.description: Product Headquarters: Czech Republic - Remote Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work. Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. About the Role: You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. As the leading collaborative work management platform, Wrike generates an enormous amount of rich, interconnected data, including work item content, relationships between entities, complex business processes, user interactions, and direct user input. The mission of the DS/ML department is to transform this data into intelligent, AI-powered capabilities that help users gain deeper insights, automate routine work, enhance productivity, and create a more seamless work experience. As a Data Scientist in the Work Intelligence Unit, you will play a key role in product development through the application of state-of-the-art AI and machine learning technologies with a particular focus on leveraging Large Language Models and other emerging technologies. You will work on both user-facing AI features and foundational intelligence platform that power intelligent experiences across the product. Your Impact: Creating new and improving existing AI solutions Involvement in the whole process of data-driven development from analyzing product requirements to launching the feature or system to production (with the help of MLOps specialists) and improving it based on results of monitoring and feedback Communicating with fellow data scientists, product owners, and developers Applying best software engineering practices to build a reliable codebase Performing code reviews Working in agile environment and presenting the results of your work on regular sprint reviews Your Qualifications: 4+ years of experience in AI, Data Science, and Machine learning Experience in LLMs, LLM-based APIs, prompting techniques, metric-driven development of prompt-based features, agentic systems, and other related topics Experience in building complex multipart and multistep LLM-based and ML systems Proficiency in Python (including pure Python, and not only jupyter notebooks) Experience in using reproducible research techniques Experience in developing AI solutions for production usage Full professional proficiency in English Standout Qualities: Experience in AI and ML solutions related to one of the areas: social networks, recommendation systems, ranking, entity matching, process mining, system personalization, risk estimation Confident statistical and machine learning skills Experience in creating core AI systems that are foundational to the product and are used in many parts of it Experience in classical software development and architecture Interpersonal skills: Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills required with the ability to work within all levels of an organization. You are proactively pushing yourself to develop your skills and knowledge Decision making and argumentation skills Open to feedback and ready to react on it Ability to work autonomously on a project level Our Work Style: Code: Python, Jupyter, mypy, uv, black, flake8 Data: pandas, SQL, BigQuery GenAI & LLMs: Langchain, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Vertex AI, Braintrust LLM Platform: Versioned Prompt Registry(jinja2), Declarative LLM Feature Configs (multi-step workflows, model routing) ML: scikit-learn, lightgbm, pytorch Cloud: GCP, Dagster, MLFlow Coding Agents: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor Team Dynamics: As part of Wrike’s AI center of excellence — you will help scale AI feature development across teams by collaborating closely with product, engineering, design, research, and other departments across the organization. You will explore new AI-driven opportunities, validate hypotheses through experimentation, and drive innovations from research prototypes to production-ready capabilities that deliver tangible value to millions of users. Benefits & Perks: 5 Weeks of paid vacation Sick Leave Compensation 5 Paid Uncertified Sick Days 2 weeks fully paid w/ medical certificate, additional 4 weeks paid at 80% salary rate Parental Leave (fully paid): 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity 2 Volunteer Days Meal Vouchers (CZK 220 per working day) Annual Prague Travel Card (Lítačka) Hybrid Working Model Benefit budget with flexible options, including a MultiSport card, Canadian Medical membership, contributions to a pension savings plan and additional choices available through Benefit Plus What’s Next? Introduction Call with a Recruiter Technical interview Cultural interview Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova , Lead Recruiter. #LI-AV1 Who Is Wrike and Our Culture We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow. Hybrid work mode Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations. While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection. Our persona Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched. Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too! Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful. Our culture and Values Customer-Focused We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind. Collaborative We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement. Creative We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions. Committed We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth. Check out our LinkedIn Life Page , Company culture page , Instagram , Wrike Engineering Team , Medium , Meetup.com , Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wrike-senior-data-scientist

items.description: About this Role Location: Remote (Global) Type: Volunteer, Pro bono Commitment: 10 – 15 hours a week, minimum of three months Reports To: Head of People Operations Works Closely With: Team Leads, Department Heads, People Team Position Summary Solution Community seeks a strategic, data-driven Volunteer Retention Manager to lead the organization's volunteer engagement and retention strategy. This role ensures volunteers remain connected, engaged, productive, and supported throughout their volunteer journey. The Volunteer Retention Manager serves as the central partner between the People Team and functional Team Leads, helping establish a culture where volunteer success and retention are shared responsibilities across the organization. The successful candidate will develop retention initiatives, oversee volunteer engagement analytics, identify attrition risks, support Team Leads in managing volunteers effectively, and create systems that improve volunteer satisfaction, productivity, and long-term commitment. This position combines workforce analytics, relationship management, volunteer experience design, and organizational development. Why This Role Matters At Solution Community , volunteer retention is not solely the responsibility of the People Team. Volunteers remain engaged when they experience meaningful work, effective leadership, consistent communication, recognition, and opportunities to contribute. Team Leads shape those experiences daily, while the People Team provides the systems, processes, and support that enable success. The Volunteer Retention Manager ensures both groups work together to create an environment where volunteers thrive, contribute, and remain connected to the mission over time. Key Responsibilities Volunteer Retention Strategy Develop and implement organization-wide volunteer retention strategies. Create programs that improve volunteer engagement and long-term participation. Monitor volunteer lifecycle trends from onboarding through ongoing engagement. Establish retention goals and success indicators across departments. Recommend improvements to volunteer processes, policies, and experiences. Volunteer Engagement Analytics Manage volunteer engagement and retention reporting. Analyze volunteer participation, activity levels, and engagement trends. Monitor Volunteer Health Indicators (Green, Yellow, Red). Identify volunteers at risk of disengagement and coordinate intervention plans. Produce monthly and quarterly retention reports for leadership. Track key metrics including: Retention Rate Volunteer Lifespan Engagement Scores Check-In Completion Rates Time to First Assignment Team Lead Effectiveness Metrics Partnership with Team Leads Act as the primary retention advisor to Team Leads. Support Team Leads in developing engagement plans for volunteers. Ensure volunteers receive proper onboarding, team integration, assignments, and recognition. Monitor completion of regular volunteer check-ins. Assist Team Leads in addressing volunteer concerns and performance challenges. Share best practices for volunteer engagement and development. Develop and maintain asynchronous volunteer management resources for Team Leads, including training videos, playbooks, toolkits, templates, guides, and best-practice documentation. Volunteer Experience Management Design initiatives that strengthen volunteer belonging and connection. Develop recognition and appreciation programs. Create volunteer feedback mechanisms and pulse surveys. Monitor volunteer satisfaction throughout the volunteer lifecycle. Identify barriers that may hinder volunteer participation and contribution. Recommend solutions that improve volunteer experiences across departments. Attrition Prevention and Intervention Develop early warning systems that identify volunteers at risk of disengagement. Review engagement indicators and trends to proactively address issues. Coordinate intervention plans with Team Leads. Conduct retention interviews with volunteers showing signs of disengagement. Lead efforts to recover and re-engage inactive volunteers when appropriate. Exit Analytics and Continuous Improvement Conduct and analyze volunteer exit interviews. Identify organizational, leadership, and role-related causes of attrition. Develop recommendations based on exit trends. Present findings and retention improvement opportunities to leadership. Track implementation of corrective actions. Leadership Reporting Prepare executive-level dashboards and retention reports. Present retention insights to leadership teams. Identify high-performing teams and engagement best practices. Highlight departments that require additional support. Support data-driven decision-making regarding volunteer management. Required Qualifications Experience in volunteer management, talent management, employee engagement, HR, organizational development, community management, or related fields. Strong analytical and reporting skills. Experience working with volunteer, workforce, or people analytics. Ability to build relationships across diverse teams and functions. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Experience designing engagement or retention programs. Strong problem-solving and project management abilities. Preferred Qualifications Experience managing large volunteer communities in a nonprofit setting. Familiarity with volunteer lifecycle management. Knowledge of workforce analytics and dashboard reporting. Experience using Airtable, Power BI, Excel, or similar reporting platforms. Experience leading cross-functional engagement initiatives. Core Competencies Volunteer Experience Management Stakeholder Partnership Data Analysis & Reporting Engagement Strategy Retention Planning Change Management Relationship Building Coaching & Advising Continuous Improvement Strategic Thinking Success Measures (KPIs) The Volunteer Retention Manager will be measured on: Volunteer Outcomes 30-, 60-, and 90-day retention rates Volunteer engagement scores Volunteer satisfaction results Volunteer re-engagement rates Reduction in preventable attrition Team Lead Accountability Measures Monthly check-in completion rates Volunteer assignment completion rates Volunteer health status trends Recognition activity rates Team-specific retention performance Organizational Measures Improvement in overall retention rates Reduction in volunteer inactivity Increased volunteer participation levels Increased average volunteer lifespan Improved volunteer experience scores What We Offer Global collaboration with leaders and strategists from top global companies. Meaningful impact on global causes and communities. A vibrant, multicultural team spanning 70+ countries. A supportive environment rooted in compassion, integrity, innovation, and collaboration. Flexible work-life with full autonomy. Opportunities for personal and professional growth. A formal recommendation upon successful completion of your volunteer term. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Design Headquarters: Remote US At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. About the Risk & Analytics Team The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability. Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges, from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks. We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently. One Role, Multiple Teams We are hiring multiple Analyst I roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A. If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process. Potential team placements include: Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel. Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences. Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience. Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions. Servicing: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency. International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets. About the Role As an Analyst I in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Analyst I roles share a common foundation: using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities, and help Affirm make better decisions. You will learn the fundamentals of consumer lending while executing scoped analytical work under the guidance of senior analysts and managers. You will leverage SQL, Python, and modern analytical tools to help optimize business strategies, monitor performance, and turn complex data into actionable insights. You are a thoughtful, driven individual eager to build a strong technical foundation, learn how to navigate exogenous market changes, and integrate modern AI tooling to solve hard problems efficiently. What You Will Do Derive Insights & Support Strategy: Leverage data analytics to uncover insights that help optimize product, risk, or growth strategies across geographies. Monitor Portfolio Health: Assist in tracking performance metrics, user behavior, and macroeconomic trends that impact business outcomes, flagging risks and anomalies to senior team members. Technical Execution: Write clean, working SQL and Python to build scalable reporting and partner with Engineering to support the deployment of machine learning and risk models. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to understand evolving consumer lending regulations and market requirements, assisting in translating them into foundational data models and operational policies. Drive Launch Alignment: Support cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with our operational capabilities and risk appetite. AI Fluency & Efficiency: Integrate AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and copilots into your daily workflows to accelerate data mining and routine tasks, while carefully verifying outputs. What We Look For 1–3 years of experience in an analytically driven role. Relevant internships or prior experience in consumer lending, fintech, or the broader financial services industry are highly valued. Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Solid working knowledge of SQL, Python, or other scripting languages. Familiarity with data mining, data visualization, and foundational statistical modeling. Basic understanding of, or deep curiosity about, consumer lending regulations, fair lending principles, and how machine learning techniques apply to real-world business problems. Exceptional communication skills, humility, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional peers. Pay Grade - I Equity Grade - 5 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range . Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company). USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $115,000 - $165,000 USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $101,000 - $151,000 #LI-Remote Remote-first with flexibility built in Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience. Benefits designed for you Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights: Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents. Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you. Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to. Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount. We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help. For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law. By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/affirm-analyst

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Netherlands URL: https://www.testgorilla.com/careers ✨ Where do we hire from? Find out if we're hiring in your location from hiring at TestGorilla Hi there, I'm Mehak , interim Head of Marketing at TestGorilla. We’re excited to share more about the Sr. Demand Generation Manager role and our team. About the role As our Sr. Demand Generation Manager , you'll be essential in achieving TestGorilla's vision of helping one billion people land their dream job. You'll own our largest acquisition lever, a multi-six-figure monthly Google Ads investment, along with the lifecycle, enrichment, and website systems that turn that spend into revenue. This isn't just a role, it's your chance to make a real difference by proving, with data, that every dollar of spend becomes pipeline. You'll directly contribute to sustainable, cost-efficient growth as TestGorilla scales. Responsibilities In this role, your responsibilities will include but not limited to: Upholding TestGorilla's behaviors and fostering an inclusive, supportive culture. Owning the demand generation number across paid and organic channels, including managing and scaling paid spend across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube) and adjacent channels, while testing and developing emerging acquisition opportunities such as advertising on ChatGPT and other AI-native platforms. Setting the channel mix, budget allocation, and account structure required to hit MQL, SQO, and pipeline targets. Building and owning source-of-truth reporting across paid and organic funnel performance, including SQL, dashboards, attribution modeling, and incrementality testing, so channel investment decisions are backed by evidence rather than platform screenshots. Owning the roadmap for paid landing pages, ad creative, and offers, and running rapid A/B tests to lift conversion with proper statistical rigor. Designing and owning automated nurture workflows and enrichment infrastructure (n8n, Make, HubSpot, Clay) so paid-sourced leads convert, and feeding that data back into targeting and ICP decisions. Partnering with Sales and RevOps on lead quality and conversion by campaign, and presenting performance and recommendations to marketing and GTM leadership in clear, business-first language. Staying ahead of advertising platform, AI ecosystem, and privacy changes, and turning successful tests into repeatable, automated systems rather than one-off wins. What you’ll bring We're looking for someone who: Is passionate about TestGorilla's mission to help one billion people find their dream jobs. Has excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Thrives in a fast-paced, async-first, remote-only environment. Has proven experience in performance or growth marketing, including hands-on ownership of a Google Ads budget of at least six figures per month (B2B SaaS strongly preferred), and a track record of scaling spend while holding or improving CAC and ROAS. We typically expect 7+ years of experience in performance or growth marketing to have developed the core skills necessary for this position. But it may be more or less than that, according to your career journey so far. Has deep expertise across the Google Ads stack, including Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube, Smart Bidding, conversion tracking, and Google Tag Manager. Working knowledge and hands-on expertise of Clay, HubSpot (or a comparable CRM) and GA suite. Has a solid grasp of funnel and unit economics (CAC, LTV:CAC, ROAS, payback period, cohort analysis) and comfort with experimentation design, including significance, sample sizing, and reading results honestly. Has hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to build real growth workflows, from lead scoring to automation logic, not just surface-level use. Has an ownership mentality: treats this budget like their own P&L, ships the workflow, dashboard, and test themselves, and is comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration as pipeline needs shift. We seek diversity and encourage applications from everyone. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups can be hesitant to apply unless they meet every requirement. If you're interested in this role but your experience doesn't perfectly match the description, please still apply. Bonus skills While these skills aren’t a requirement, we’d be very interested to hear from you if you have: Experience managing an agency or freelancers alongside in-house execution. Exposure to PLG or hybrid PLG/sales-led GTM. Experience presenting to VP/C-level stakeholders on performance and budget. Experience owning SEO or content-led demand generation programs alongside paid channels. Has strong working SQL, fluency in GA4 and at least one BI tool What’s in it for you? Please note: Some specifics, particularly around leave, may vary depending on your country of residence. This will be discussed during the hiring process. Global Team: Join a fully remote, mission-driven team from around the world Competitive compensation: Receive a competitive pay (€65,650-€84,500 per annum) + Share Appreciation Rights (SARs) Remote & flexible work: Work from almost anywhere*. Enjoy flexible hours and asynchronous work to balance work and life. * Check out the countries we currently hire from here Remote work budget: €1,000 available each year or up to €2,000 from day 1 if you're buying a laptop! Growth & development: Invest in yourself and your career with a 3.5% L&D budget per year and clear growth opportunities Parent/Caregiver support: We provide a caregiver-friendly work environment with paid 8-16 week parental leave and tailored return-to-work approaches Work-life balance: Our unlimited and flexible time off policy empowers you to take the time you need to recharge and maintain your well-being Interested? At TestGorilla, we believe your skills speak louder than your resume. That's why we champion a skills-first approach, using cutting-edge, AI-powered assessments to uncover your true potential. Forget traditional biases; we're building the world's largest skills-tested talent pool, making hiring fairer, faster, and smarter for everyone! When you apply, you'll get to experience our platform firsthand by taking an assessment – it's your chance to shine and show us what you can do! While our platform is powered by AI, every hiring decision is made by humans, ensuring a truly unbiased and thoughtful process. Check out our Applicant Privacy document to see how we protect your data. We're passionate about building diverse teams where every voice is heard. We genuinely welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences. Concerned about test anxiety? We've got you covered. Accommodations are readily available as part of the assessment setup, and requesting support will never impact your application. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/testgorilla-senior-demand-generation-manager

items.description: Metabase is the easiest way for people to get insights from their data, from tiny startups who get up and running quickly to major corporations with tens of thousands of users. That’s why people love us. We bring data tools with the elegance and simplicity of consumer products to the crufty world of enterprise business intelligence. We provide an opinionated open source starting point for how companies should measure, analyze and share their data, which is used by tens of thousands of companies. About the role Our Finance & Analytics team owns the authoritative view of Metabase’s business performance, and the opinionated read on what’s driving it. Internally, this is used to drive decisions; externally, this is used to meet our obligations to investors, auditors, and tax authorities. We’re looking for a quantitative-minded generalist to lead a portfolio of analytical projects across the business and own an area of finance operations. Your analytical projects will focus on how we measure and understand the broader business: establishing authoritative definitions for key metrics and investigating what’s driving changes in the data. In your operational area, you’ll run the work and build systems that make it reliable and increasingly automated, drawing on external specialists for technical expertise. This isn’t a traditional finance role: we’re a small team of generalists who think in systems, learn unfamiliar domains quickly, and reason through problems from first principles. Responsibilities Leading analytical projects that change how we understand the business. Examples include: Adapting our ARR definition as our business model evolves Evaluating the health of our sales and marketing funnel Finding relationships between product initiatives and expansion or churn Owning a traditional finance domain (such as Accounting or Tax). This will involve a combination of operational work, managing external experts, and evaluating the overall health of the operation Automating the workflows in your domain so our operational and compliance requirements take as little manual effort as possible. Our aspiration is that areas of traditional finance are treated similarly to analytical systems: a set of inputs that are transformed via defined logic to produce a targeted outcome or insight Leading cross-functional projects to tackle operational problems as they arise About you You think in systems: you understand how pieces fit together, build reliable processes, and automate repetitive work You think in terms of numbers and are comfortable in a wide range of analytical domains, whether that’s financial modeling, doing intermediate statistical analysis, reviewing the methodology of external vendors, or transforming raw data. You can spot inconsistencies quickly, and enjoy getting to the right answer. SQL experience strongly preferred (nice-to-have: analytics engineering experience) You know how to use AI to improve efficiency, and enjoy experimenting with novel applications of the technology. Just as importantly, you know the limitations of AI and don’t use it as a substitute for your own thinking You learn fast. For example, you don’t need to be an accountant, but you can learn the rules of accounting (or other specialist domains) and apply them to day-to-day problems You are adept at managing vendors, building strong relationships, and holding them accountable when needed You have strong organizational skills with a high attention to detail: you enjoy checking items off your checklist, and can seamlessly balance multiple threads of work Minimum 3–5 years experience, preferably in a high-growth startup Strong quantitative undergraduate degree (nice to have: MBA) Based in the US, Canada, or UK Low-ego attitude: no job should be too small or too large Nice-to-have: some familiarity with accounting principles or coursework Compensation The US base salary range for this role is $150K–$200K annually , plus equity and benefits. Compensation is determined by role, level, location, and individual qualifications, including skills, experience, and scope of responsibility. Pay may vary by geographic location and other job-related factors. Benefits We offer meaningful equity and a comprehensive US benefits package, including fully employer-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance (with 75% coverage for dependents), a 401(k) with employer match available to enroll after the first 30 days, flexible and unlimited paid time off including sick time, and an asynchronous, remote-first environment. We’re a global team (50% outside the US), fully distributed (from Thailand to California), who get things done asynchronously, with plenty of uninterrupted time, supporting each other to do the best work of our careers. We offer flexibility (define your own schedule and work from wherever you want), autonomy, and an environment that fosters growth, learning, and development. We’re relentlessly user-focused and believe in building long-term value, not short-term hacks. And we raised a $30M Series B to take our approach to the next level for years to come. For U.S. applicants: Metabase participates in the federal E-Verify program, which confirms employment authorization of newly hired U.S. based employees. E-Verify is not used as a tool to pre-screen candidates and is only initiated upon hire. E-Verify Participation Notice (English/Spanish) Right to Work Notice (English/Spanish) We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

items.title: Staff Application Security Engineer at Fingerprint
items.summary: Fingerprint empowers enterprises to detect and stop online fraud with the world’s most accurate device intelligence. We lead our industry with bleeding-edge identification capabilities and work on turning new ideas and discoveries in the fraud detection space into reality. Our customers range from innovative startups to leading enterprise companie
items.description: Fingerprint empowers enterprises to detect and stop online fraud with the world’s most accurate device intelligence. We lead our industry with bleeding-edge identification capabilities and work on turning new ideas and discoveries in the fraud detection space into reality. Our customers range from innovative startups to leading enterprise companies, including Plaid, Dropbox, and Booking.com. Fingerprint is a globally dispersed, 100% remote company. We were named on on the 2026 Forbes Best Startup Employers list and ranked #803 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies. We have raised $77M and are backed by Craft Ventures (Tesla, Facebook, Airbnb ), Nexus Venture Partners ( Postman, Apollo.io, MinIO, Druva) and Uncorrelated Ventures ( Redis, Rollbar, Gradle). The Role in Context Fingerprint’s device intelligence platform processes billions of identification events for some of the world’s most security-conscious companies — financial institutions, fraud prevention operators, and enterprises that rely on us to stop attackers. That makes our own application security a product feature, not a back-office function: our customers’ adversaries are, by definition, motivated to probe what we build. As we scale with large enterprise customers, we’re investing in application security as a dedicated, first-class engineering discipline. Security is already part of how our teams build — scanning in the pipeline, a Cloud Platform team that treats security as a partner, and a mature compliance posture — and we’re now standing up a focused AppSec function, led by a Senior Manager, Application Security who owns the program and strategy, to take it to the next level. You will be the founding senior engineer of that function — the person who turns strategy into a working secure SDLC, finds and fixes what matters, and raises the security bar across engineering through technical depth, tooling, and influence. This is a hands-on Staff role. You will design, build, and operate — not just advise. What You’ll Do Secure SDLC & Security Engineering Design and build Fingerprint’s secure development lifecycle: security requirements, threat modeling at design time, secure code review, and pre-release security testing — integrated into how engineers already work, not bolted on as a gate Own and operate the security tooling pipeline: SAST, DAST, SCA/dependency scanning, secrets detection, and container/IaC scanning (Snyk and equivalents) — tuned for signal over noise, integrated into CI/CD, with clear ownership and SLAs for findings Build the pipeline AI-first: AI-assisted triage and auto-remediation, security review agents that run inside the coding-agent loop and in CI, and AI-augmented testing — and decide, with evidence, what each is trusted to block, flag, or fix on its own Build paved-road security: secure defaults, hardened libraries and frameworks, reusable patterns (authn/authz, input validation, secrets handling, crypto) that make the secure path the easy path Write code. Contribute fixes, security libraries, CI integrations, and automation directly to engineering repositories Threat Modeling, Security Reviews & Vulnerability Management Lead threat modeling and architecture security reviews for new products, features, and significant changes across the API, SDKs (web and mobile), dashboard, and data pipeline Run and mature the vulnerability management program: triage, risk-rate, and drive remediation of findings from scanners, pen tests, bug bounty, and customer reports — with clear severity standards and remediation SLAs Partner with the Compliance Lead, who runs the penetration testing program today, on scoping, retesting, and turning findings into engineering work — you bring the technical depth and own remediation Perform hands-on security testing of Fingerprint’s platform — manual review and exploitation of authn/authz, API, injection, SSRF, business-logic, and abuse-path issues — with particular attention to the fraud and bot-detection threat surface where adversaries actively attempt to defeat the product Incident Response & Detection (application layer) Serve as the technical lead for application-layer security incidents: investigation, containment, root cause, and remediation — partnering with Cloud Platform on infrastructure incidents Define what application security logging and alerting should exist, and partner with Cloud Platform and engineering teams to get it built Security Culture & Enablement Act as the AppSec partner to engineering teams: office hours, design consultations, secure coding guidance, and a Security Champions program that scales your impact beyond one person Develop and deliver practical secure coding training grounded in Fingerprint’s real codebase and real findings Mentor engineers in security thinking and raise the bar through code review and design feedback Partnership & Customer Trust Partner with the Senior Manager, Application Security on the AppSec roadmap: bring technical findings, risk assessments, and recommendations that shape priorities; own execution of the technical program Provide the engineering evidence behind security controls when compliance needs it — you make the controls real; the compliance program is owned elsewhere Support enterprise customer security conversations with technical depth: questionnaires, architecture questions, pen test summaries, and due diligence calls with customer InfoSec teams Contribute to vendor security assessments where third-party code or integrations touch the platform What We’re Looking For Required 8+ years in software engineering and/or security engineering, with 5+ years focused on application security — you’ve been the hands-on AppSec engineer at a product company, not a consultant or auditor passing through Strong software engineering foundation: You write production-quality code (TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Python, or similar), understand modern web and API architectures, and are comfortable working inside engineering repositories and CI/CD pipelines Deep practical AppSec expertise: OWASP Top 10 and beyond — authentication and authorization design, API security, injection classes, SSRF, cryptography misuse, business-logic and abuse flaws. You can find these issues by hand, explain why they matter, and propose fixes engineers accept Threat modeling and security review experience: You’ve led design-time security reviews for complex systems and produced threat models that engineers used Security tooling program experience: You’ve deployed and tuned SAST/DAST/SCA/secrets-detection tooling in CI/CD and made it useful rather than noisy AI-native security tooling: You’ve run AI-assisted code analysis, triage, or auto-remediation in a real program — not a trial — and have earned opinions about where it’s trustworthy, where it generates noise, and what should be allowed to block a merge. You use AI agents daily in your own security work Vulnerability management ownership: You’ve run triage, severity rating, remediation tracking, and pen-test programs with real SLAs Influence without authority: A track record of raising security outcomes across engineering teams through credibility, partnership, and good tooling — not mandates Clear communication: You write precise findings and design feedback, and you can explain technical risk to engineers, leadership, and customer security teams alike Nice to Have Experience in fraud detection, bot mitigation, identity, or device intelligence — the adversarial threat surface here is real and domain-specific Cloud security depth on AWS (IAM, network boundaries, secrets management, workload identity) and familiarity with Wiz or equivalent CSPM tooling Client-side and mobile SDK security: browser security model, anti-tampering, obfuscation trade-offs, iOS/Android SDK hardening Multi-tenant SaaS experience with high-volume, latency-sensitive APIs Bug bounty program operation (HackerOne, Bugcrowd, or equivalent) AI/ML security awareness: LLM-integrated features, prompt injection, agent tool permissions, model and data-pipeline risks Experience with autonomous or AI-augmented penetration testing and attack simulation , and a view on how it complements human-led testing Security certifications (OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT, CSSLP) or published research, CVEs, or open-source security contributions Experience supporting SOC 2 / ISO 27001 controls as the engineering owner of the control, not the program owner The Shape of This Role This is the senior individual-contributor counterpart to the Senior Manager, Application Security. The manager owns the program, the strategy, and the team; you own the technical depth and the execution. The two roles are designed to work as a pair: you’ll bring the findings, the engineering judgment, and the ground truth from inside the codebase, and together you’ll decide what to prioritize. As a Staff engineer, you are expected to operate with a high degree of independence — scoping ambiguous problems, setting technical direction for AppSec, and driving multi-quarter initiatives without needing day-to-day direction. As the founding engineer of a dedicated AppSec function, the patterns, tooling, and standards you establish will be the foundation the practice grows on. This is not a role for someone who wants to primarily write policy or manage a program from a distance. It’s for an engineer who finds real bugs, builds real tooling, and earns the trust of other engineers by making their code better. Why This Role? Shape a dedicated AppSec function from its first days, with a manager and a mandate behind you — this investment is sponsored at the VP level and prioritized A security problem that actually matters: Fingerprint’s customers use us to stop fraud and abuse. The adversaries are real, skilled, and motivated — the threat model here is more interesting than at most SaaS companies Modern stack and tooling already in place: Snyk, Wiz, Cloudflare, Okta, and a Cloud Platform team that treats security as a partner, not an obstacle Your time goes to engineering: Compliance, IT, and infrastructure are each owned by capable teams, so you spend your days on code, findings, and tooling — not evidence collection or ticket queues Staff-level scope and autonomy: You set the technical direction for application security at a company where security is a differentiator in enterprise sales Compensation & Transparency At Fingerprint, we believe in pay transparency — it’s part of how we operate as a distributed, remote-first team. Salaries are based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Because this role is open across the United States and can be based anywhere our team members work from, the salary range reflects that geographic breadth: $177k - $240k Some example salaries for specific locations are below: NYC: $209K - $240k Chicago: $177k - $204k Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including the successful candidate’s location, experience, and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above. Due to regulatory and security reasons, there’s a small number of countries where we cannot have Fingerprint teammates based. Additionally, because Fingerprint is an all-remote company and people can join our workforce from almost any country, we do not sponsor visas. Fingerprint teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive work environment for everyone. We embrace and celebrate the unique experiences, perspectives and cultural backgrounds that each employee brings to our workplace. Fingerprint strives to foster an environment where our employees feel respected, valued and empowered, and our team members are at the forefront in helping us promote and sustain an inclusive workplace. We highly encourage people from underrepresented groups in tech to apply. If you are applying as a resident of California, please read our CCPA notice here. If you are applying as a resident of the EU, please read our GDPR notice here. **We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates’ personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Fingerprint recruiting email communications will always come from the @fingerprint.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Fingerprint via other sources should be ignored.
