For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks. Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector. Visit gomotive.com to learn more. About the Role: Business Operations at Motive is a highly cross-functional group that is responsible for developing our go-to-market strategy, improving go-to-market efficiency, and ensuring that we are hitting our growth targets. Our team is maniacal about and energized by the challenge of getting our hands dirty in any problem across Sales, Marketing, or Customer Success, and finding ways to help us scale more efficiently. We are a low-ego, highly-motivated group that collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders to drive alignment and execution. Examples of major strategic initiatives Business Operations takes on are optimizing the structure of our sales force, experimenting with new sales and marketing motions, and determining how we can leverage AI to improve operations. What You'll Do: Develop go-to-market strategies by analyzing market trends, customer segmentation, and Motive’s competitive landscape. Collaborate with senior leaders to prioritize high-growth opportunities and drive strategic execution, ensuring alignment across all go-to-market functions. Lead cross-functional initiatives that connect the dots across different functions and stakeholders. You will be the driving force behind high-impact, high-visibility strategic initiatives that are critical to scaling our business by facilitating communication and collaboration between departments to ensure alignment and effective execution. Create robust analytical models and dashboards to provide actionable insights into go-to-market and product performance. You will take a hands-on approach to proactively identify trends, opportunities, and risks, translating data into clear recommendations for optimizing commercial results - leveraging AI throughout the process to drive scale and efficiency. Champion operational efficiency by continuously identifying and addressing process inefficiencies - you never stop asking “can we be doing this better?” Design and implement innovative solutions to streamline workflows, enhance productivity, and drive a culture of continuous improvement across the organization. What We're Looking For: 6+ years of relevant experience in consulting, banking, private equity, or Strategy & Operations, combined with in-house at a SaaS company Recent experience at a hypergrowth and rapidly scaling SaaS company Recent Bachelor's degree required; MBA is a plus Advanced communication, presentation, and organization skills Executive presence and comfort communicating with the C-suite Exceptional spreadsheet / data management skills, SQL proficiency preferred Expert with Google Sheets & Excel, with the ability to build data models Proficient in AI tools and comfortable leveraging AI to maximize effectiveness of daily work Intellectual curiosity supported by exceptional analytical skill Strong, demonstrated leadership capabilities Experience working on cross-functional projects with various stakeholders and a demonstrated expertise in managing such projects Able to work in ambiguous, fast paced, environments under tight and unpredictable timelines Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. items.title: UX Researcher
items.summary: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world.
items.description: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We’re building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we’re always acting authentically. Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We’re taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us? What’s the position? The Mid-Level UX & CX Researcher sits within Hard Rock Digital growing Research and Insights function and helps the business understand how players experience our digital products. Reporting to the Senior Research Manager and partnering with Product, Design, Marketing and the wider Insights team, this role will deliver defined qualitative and quantitative UX/CX research projects, with strategic guidance from the Senior Research Manager. The role helps the whole research team turning player evidence into clear, actionable insight that informs decisions and improves the player experience. Key Responsibilities Work closely with the Senior Research Manager to translate business questions into actionable UX/CX research plans that support priorities across Product, Design and Marketing, ensuring projects are appropriately scoped, prioritised, resourced and delivered on time and to a high standard. Work on and deliver qualitative and quantitative research projects end-to-end, from briefing and method selection through scripting, fieldwork, analysis and reporting, with regular check-ins and strategic guidance from the Senior Research Manager. AI-assisted tools will be implemented where relevant while projects will mainly be run inhouse while agency projects might also be considered to meet business and team needs Organise participant recruitments, plan and conduct usability testing, customer journey mapping, experience evaluations, and concept and prototype testing to identify pain points, opportunities and improvements across our websites, apps, features, content and propositions. Track and report key CX measures, including NPS, SUS, satisfaction and ease of use, and contribute to/build/update dashboards and summaries. Connecting these measures and behavioural trends with customer attitudes, segments and experiences to provide joined-up insight. Facilitate in-person and remote research or design workshops with the team lead that help cross-functional stakeholders align on findings and next steps. Develop practical and creative approaches to recruiting participants from hard-to-reach player segments, including VIP players and customers in specific state markets. Stay current with UX/CX developments in gambling, gaming and relevant consumer sectors. Bring competitor and industry best practice into the team, and share useful tools, techniques and learnings across the wider UX and Insights community. Requirements What are we looking for? 3-5 years of experience in a UX or CX research role, ideally within digital products, gambling, gaming or a comparable consumer sector, or demonstrable interest in the gambling sector. Practical experience working on qualitative and quantitative research, online and in person, using methods such as usability testing, journey mapping, concept and prototype testing, and CX measurement, including NPS and CSAT. A hands-on, collaborative and organised researcher, confident using platforms such as UserTesting, Qualtrics, SurveyMonkey, Survicate and Power BI, with the ability to learn new tools quickly and use AI-assisted tools responsibly while maintaining research ethics, data privacy and confidentiality with senior guidance. Comfortable talking through results to key stakeholders A collaborative team member who works effectively in a fast-paced, scaling environment, responds constructively to feedback and cares about inclusive and accessible experiences. An understanding of research ethics, participant consent and data privacy, with the judgement to handle player information responsibly. Self-motivated, disciplined and organised, with the ability to work effectively in a remote environment and communicate confidently with colleagues and vendors through video calls and platforms such as Slack or Microsoft Teams What’s in it for you? We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include: Competitive pay and benefits Flexible vacation allowance A hybrid / remote working environment Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand Roster of Uniques We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer). Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Buscamos un Data Engineer con sólida experiencia en el ecosistema de Google Cloud Platform, capaz de diseñar, desarrollar y mantener pipelines de datos robustos y escalables. El rol implica trabajar en proyectos de implementación donde la calidad, trazabilidad y eficiencia del dato son prioridad. Si te apasiona transformar datos en activos estratégicos y disfrutas resolver desafíos técnicos complejos en entornos cloud, esta oportunidad es para ti. Responsabilidades principales Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener pipelines de datos confiables y escalables utilizando las herramientas del ecosistema Google Cloud Platform. Integrar diversas fuentes de datos mediante el consumo y exposición de APIs REST, garantizando la correcta ingestión y disponibilidad de la información. Gestionar y transformar datos en la nube utilizando BigQuery, Dataform y Cloud Storage, asegurando consistencia, calidad y rendimiento en cada capa del modelo de datos. Implementar flujos de mensajería y procesamiento de eventos en tiempo real a través de Pub/Sub, coordinando la orquestación entre servicios. Documentar los procesos, arquitecturas de datos y decisiones técnicas para garantizar la mantenibilidad y transferencia de conocimiento en el equipo. Colaborar con equipos de Analytics, Ingeniería y Producto para comprender los requerimientos de negocio y traducirlos en soluciones de datos eficientes. Requirements Experiencia mínima de 3 años en roles de Data Engineering, con participación activa en proyectos de implementación de pipelines en entornos productivos. Dominio de Google Cloud Platform, incluyendo BigQuery, Dataform, Pub/Sub y Cloud Storage como componentes principales del stack de datos. Sólido manejo de Python para el desarrollo de scripts de transformación, automatización de procesos y consumo de APIs. Capacidad avanzada en SQL para modelado, consultas complejas, optimización de queries y construcción de modelos analíticos en BigQuery. Experiencia en integración con APIs REST: autenticación, paginación, manejo de errores y normalización de datos provenientes de distintas fuentes. Conocimiento de buenas prácticas de ingeniería de datos: versionado de código, testing de pipelines, gestión de dependencias y documentación técnica. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: Proudly voted a Great Place to Work®, we are a dynamic startup in the SaaS space that is revolutionizing the way businesses communicate.
items.description: Proudly voted a Great Place to Work®, we are a dynamic startup in the SaaS space that is revolutionizing the way businesses communicate. Our team is made up of 500 energetic and passionate Unifones who are dedicated to delivering the best possible experience to 5000+ customer-centric companies. We pride ourselves on our fun and collaborative work environment, where creativity and new ideas are constantly encouraged. As shareholders in the business, we’re so much more than a group of passionate communicators. We are Unifones. Join our team and be a part of something big! Meet the team! Our Engineering team is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the systems and technologies that drive Unifonic ’s solutions. We work closely with other departments to ensure our products and services meet the needs of our customers. If you are passionate about technology and are excited about working on cutting-edge communication and engagement solutions, we want you on our team. As a Senior Machine Learning (AI) Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying advanced machine learning solutions across various domains, including NLP, Text Classification, RAG, LLMs, Recommender engines, and Anomaly detection. This role involves end-to-end project ownership, from data preprocessing to the creation of service APIs, and offers opportunities to work on cutting-edge AI technologies. Help us shape the future of communication by: Leading the end-to-end design, development, and deployment of robust and scalable machine learning solutions, with a strong emphasis on NLP and RAG architectures. Architecting and implementing RAG systems, combining large language models (LLMs) with robust retrieval mechanisms to improve the accuracy, factual grounding, and interpretability of generated content. Applying advanced NLP techniques for tasks such as text classification, entity recognition, sentiment analysis, summarization, question answering, and information extraction. Researching, evaluating, and integrating state-of-the-art NLP models and RAG frameworks (e.g., Transformers, BERT, GPT variants, Vector Databases, Semantic Search). Mentoring junior team members on the team, sharing knowledge, and advising the best machine learning and software engineering practices and approaches. Establishing and maintaining robust communication channels with other cross-functional teams to facilitate the integration of machine learning solutions into other Unifonic products. Developing and optimizing highly confident machine learning algorithms and models and creating/exposing the service APIs using frameworks such as Flask, FastAPIs, or other relevant frameworks. Staying up to date with the latest machine learning research papers, and AI trends (i.e. Generative AI). Collaborating with the data engineering team and other teams to collect and analyze extensive datasets, extracting insights and patterns, in real-time, near-real-time, or batch processing mode. Implementing proof of concepts and prototypes to demonstrate the potential of new AI use cases and innovations. Building scalable, maintainable machine learning services, which should handle thousands of requests per second, and help to perform the required load tests to meet the SLA. Reviewing the code of other team members and suggesting improvements to ensure the SOLID principles and clean architecture. Assisting in the project documentation and demos. Requirements What you'll bring: Proven experience designing and implementing RAG systems, including familiarity with various retrieval strategies (e.g., BM25, dense retrieval, hybrid approaches) and knowledge graph integration. Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar tools for building and managing autonomous agents. Deep expertise in various NLP techniques and models, including but not limited to: Transformer architectures (e.g., BERT, GPT, T5, LLama, Mistral) Large Language Models (LLMs) and their fine-tuning/adaptation Vector embeddings and similarity search Text classification, named entity recognition (NER), sentiment analysis, summarization, and question answering. Hands-on 3-5 years of relevant work experience as a Machine Learning Engineer. Hands-on 3+ years of experience with Python. Excellent analytical abilities, with the capacity to collect, organize, and analyze large datasets to glean valuable insights. End-to-end experience in training, evaluating, testing, and deploying machine learning products in production. Ability to write world-class code in Python (SOLID principles), considering the best software engineering fundamentals, i.e. data structures, algorithms, and data modeling Solid experience in ML frameworks such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, PyTorch, Keras, BERT, Tensorflow, and similar. Familiarity with MLOps best practices, e.g. Model deployment and reproducible research. Mastering data science needed skills like SQL, hypothesis testing, Data cleansing, data augmentation, data pre-processing techniques, and dimensionality reduction. Basic knowledge of Kubernetes and Docker is nice to have. Excellent understanding of Machine learning techniques like Naive Bayes classifiers, SVM, Decision Tree, KNN, K-means, Random Forest, modeling and optimization, evaluation metrics, classification, and clustering. Experience with the Hugging Face libraries (i.e. transformers). Experience fine-tuning pre-trained models and using vector search to enhance LLMs results. Experience with LLM frameworks (i.e. LangChain) and prompt engineering techniques. Familiar with code versioning tools such as GIT, CI/CD concepts, and toolchains. Familiar with Agile methodologies i.e. scrum and kanban. Ability to develop high-level architecture and low-level design, End-to-end for a specific project. Experience in event sourcing patterns and tools i.e. Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar is a plus. Experience with LLM frameworks (i.e. LangChain) and prompt engineering techniques is nice to have. Experience in event sourcing patterns and tools i.e. Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar is nice to have. General knowledge of Data warehouse tools e.g. Vertica is a plus. A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field. (e.g. Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software, etc). Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Good level of spoken and written Arabic and English. As a Unifone you will receive a range of benefits: Competitive salary and bonus. Unifonic share scheme (we are all owners!). 30 holiday days after the first anniversary. Your Birthday off! Spend up to 25 days per year working from anywhere in the world! items.description: About Us Flying Bisons is a leading Strategic Design & Digital Consulting company based in Warsaw, with projects across Europe and the Middle East. Our mission is to help our clients Unleash Digital Potential™ . We work at scales where real impact happens: enterprise platforms, government services, and corporate ecosystems used by millions of people. Our projects include national workforce platforms (Qiwa, Ajeer), education ecosystems (Madares), major banks (Bank Pekao, Alinma), global telecoms (Ooredoo, Salam), and international brands (KFC, Hebe, NaTemat, Enel-Med). Our uniqueness comes from going beyond design craft. As we wrote in our manifestos - Strategic Design - Manifest and Strategic Design - The Future of Design - design craft is only 10% of success . The other 90% - the Invisible 90% - is about navigating politics, aligning stakeholders, and protecting fragile visions until they reach reality. That’s why we’re building the discipline of Strategic Design - and we want you to be part of it. Role context We're looking for a UX Researcher to work with us on client projects, on a B2B basis. In this role, you will lead and support research initiatives across a variety of digital products and services, helping clients make informed product and business decisions through user-centered insights. You will work closely with designers, strategists, developers, data analysts and stakeholders to identify user needs, validate solutions and shape exceptional customer experiences. Scope of services Preparing and executing research processes, from mapping research problems to analyzing research materials. Creating reports and delivering key project insights to the team. Conducting research using techniques such as user testing, in-depth interviews, IDIs, occasionally focus group interviews, FGIs, tree testing and card sorting. Preparing and facilitating workshops with clients and internal teams. Synthesizing and communicating findings to inspire design and product decisions and create visibility across departments. Creating personas, user journey maps and blueprints as outputs of the research conducted. Collaborating with other researchers and with an interdisciplinary team, including designers, strategists, developers and data analysts. What we are looking for Commercial experience as a UX Researcher working on digital products and services. Strong knowledge of qualitative and quantitative research methodologies. Deep understanding of the digital product development lifecycle. Ability to independently plan and execute research projects. Excellent communication, storytelling and presentation skills. Ability to navigate multiple stakeholder groups and influence others. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Proactive, solution-oriented mindset. Fluency in Polish and professional proficiency in English. Knowledge and experience in working with AI. Nice to have Experience working in consulting, agency or multi-project environments. Familiarity with tools such as Dovetail, TheyDo, Lookback, Figma and FigJam. Cooperation terms B2B cooperation for independent contractors. Suggested commercial range: 10 000 to 12 000 PLN net + VAT per month, depending on experience, expertise, scope and availability. Remote cooperation. Cooperation in an Apple and Google Workspace-based environment. Access to selected project tools, systems and environments where required for project delivery, security or client compliance. Possibility to cooperate with experienced specialists from strategy, design, research, product, analytics, technology and delivery areas. items.description: Data and Analytics Job Description: Job Title: Data Analyst/Engineer Corporate Title: AVP Location: Chester Company Overview: At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. Being a Great Place to Work is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes our commitment to being a diverse and inclusive workplace, attracting and developing exceptional talent, supporting our teammates' physical, emotional, and financial wellness, recognizing and rewarding performance, and how we make an impact in the communities we serve. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us! Location Overview: Find us in the city of Chester, a destination renowned for its culture, history, and beauty. Working at Bank of America Chester offers a far-reaching global career for a world-renowned organisation, whilst being ideally situated against the backdrop of the rolling North Wales hills and the banks of the serene River Dee. Role Description: This role will enhance security compliance, reduce exposure to cyber threats, improve reporting accuracy, increase automation, and enable more effective management of patching and vulnerability remediation activities across the enterprise. The position is essential for maintaining operational resilience and supporting strategic technology risk management objectives. Responsibilities: Key responsibilities include working with stakeholders to understand their needs; analysing problems; capturing requirements; creating solutions; solving problems through automation; and providing subject-matter expertise to support scope and requirement decisions. The role also involves collaborating with project stakeholders to analyse and confirm requirements, improve processes, and write user and technical stories. As a critical liaison between the Patching and Currency team and its stakeholders, this role defines, analyses, and delivers technology solutions that support strategic business objectives. It gathers and documents requirements, translates business needs into actionable deliverables for Agile teams, supports testing and implementation, and drives successful outcomes across the full delivery lifecycle. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills, technical aptitude, and stakeholder management capabilities to deliver high-quality solutions in a fast-paced environment while using modern tools, including GenAI, to improve analysis and delivery effectiveness. What we are looking for: Independent, hands-on development experience with the following technologies: Python/Java Scripting Microsoft SQL Server Kafka AutoSys Tableau Ansible Splunk Jira ServiceNow Skills that will help: Knowledge of Linux and Windows server environments Hands-on experience as a business systems analyst on an Agile team, including writing user stories and creating technical design documentation and system flows Benefits of working at Bank of America: UK Private healthcare for you and your family plus an annual health screen to help you manage your physical wellness with the option to purchase a screen for your partner Competitive pension plan, life assurance and group income protection cover if you become unable to work as a result of a disability or health reasons 20 days of back-up childcare including access to school holiday clubs and 20 days of back-up adult care per annum The ability to change your core benefits as well as the option of selecting a variety of flexible benefits to suit your personal circumstances including access to a wellbeing account, travel insurance, critical illness etc. Access to an emotional wellbeing helpline, mental health first aiders and virtual GP services. Access to an Employee Assistance Program for confidential support and help for everyday matters Ability to donate to charities of your choice directly through payroll and the bank will match your contribution Opportunity to access our Arts & Culture corporate membership program and receive discounted entry to some of the UK's most iconic cultural institutions and exhibitions. Opportunity to give back to your community, develop new skills and work with new groups of people by volunteering in your local community. Bank of America: Good conduct and sound judgment is crucial to our long term success. It's important that all employees in the organisation understand the expected standards of conduct and how we manage conduct risk. Individual accountability and an ownership mind-set are the cornerstones of our Code of Conduct and are at the heart of managing risk well. We are an equal opportunities employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of sex, gender identity or gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, race, religion or belief, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origins, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy or maternity, socio-economic background, responsibility for dependants or physical or mental disability. The Bank selects candidates for interview based on their skills, qualifications and experience. We strive to ensure that our recruitment processes are accessible for all candidates and encourage any candidates to tell us about any adjustment requirements.

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities) Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com An award-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including: TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026) Fortune Change the World (2024) CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024) Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024) Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024) Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023) Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024) About the Role: Maven is looking for a Director of Marketing Operations who will own the systems, data, and reporting infrastructure behind our B2B Growth Marketing team — from HubSpot/Salesforce instrumentation to pipeline attribution to the budget that funds it all. This person will lead a team across marketing analytics, marketing operations, and web optimization, and serve as the go-to partner for Sales, RevOps, Strategic Finance, and Client Success on shared data and reporting. Reporting to the Senior Director of Growth, they'll bring structure and rigor to a fast-moving org, ensuring marketing's numbers hold up in front of executive leadership. What You’ll Do: Marketing Technology, Data & Attribution HubSpot instrumentation (and its integration with Salesforce): own lead management strategy, campaign orchestration and tracking, and stage definitions for the B2B funnel. Pipeline attribution: own marketing's multi-touch attribution methodology and represent it in cross-team pipeline conversations. Data governance: maintain data dictionaries and definitions (MQL/MQA thresholds, pipeline vs. bookings vs. revenue) so reporting stays consistent as tools and AI use expand. Martech stack: own B2B-facing tools and integrations, including CaliberMind, GA4, HubSpot, Qualified, Webflow, and evaluate new tooling as needs evolve. Training and enablement: ensure the has the resources and knowledge to own the reporting and orchestration of their channels. Analytics & Reporting KPI ownership: define and maintain B2B marketing metrics (MQLs, MQAs, pipeline coverage, Pipe-Spend ratio) and the reporting cadence behind them. Executive reporting: build and deliver pipeline briefings and performance readouts for B2B marketing leadership. Dashboards: own the B2B analytics stack across CaliberMind, Looker, Data Studio, Salesforce, and GA4, and keep it accurate as definitions change. FY planning support: partner with Strategic Finance and RevOps on fiscal year target-setting, run-rate projections, and scenario modeling for B2B pipeline and budget as well as org-level OKR setting. Budget & Planning Budget ownership: oversee the B2B marketing budget, including forecast, actuals, monthly reconciliation, and shifts across programs and months. Vendor management: track spend and manage relationships with external vendors. FY planning: lead annual and quarterly budgeting and planning for B2B Growth Marketing in partnership with Strategic Finance. Marketing Website & CRO Marketing website: manage the web team that owns navigation, landing pages, and on-page SEO/AEO for the Enterprise/B2B experience. Testing and optimization: run a structured A/B testing and CRO program for B2B landing pages. Accessibility: maintain WCAG 2.1 AA compliance across the B2B site experience. Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership People leadership: manage and develop a team covering marketing analytics, marketing operations, and web optimization. Process and tooling: set the team's operating rhythm and own its project management tooling (Asana and Jira). Builds with AI: personally build AI-powered workflows for reporting, analysis, and campaign operations that enable the team to make better decisions and scale without additional headcount. AI enablement: lead rollout of AI tools within B2B Growth Marketing, including data governance for tools connected to live CRM and marketing data, and set the team's judgment for where AI helps and where it doesn't. Cross-functional partnership: serve as B2B Growth Marketing's primary point of contact for Sales, SDR, RevOps, Strategic Finance, and Client Success on shared data, process, and reporting questions. What You’ll Bring: 8+ years in B2B marketing operations, analytics, or revenue operations, ideally supporting complex or enterprise sales cycles. Hands-on ownership of a marketing automation platform (HubSpot or similar) and the integration with Salesforce, including lead routing, lifecycle stages, and campaign orchestration. Experience building and defending pipeline or marketing attribution models with Sales and Finance stakeholders. Track record owning multi-million dollar marketing budgets, including forecasting, actuals, and reconciliation. Experience owning a B2B marketing website and CRO program, including A/B testing and accessibility standards. Experience managing and developing a high performance team. Sharp, direct communicator, comfortable presenting pipeline and Marketing performance data to executive leadership. Comfortable operating in a fast-changing org structure and building processes from ambiguity. Experience rolling out AI tools within a marketing team, with an eye toward data governance and accuracy. The base salary range for this role is $170,000 - $200,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset. This role requires active work authorization in the US. Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, and remotely via San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in Boston, DC, Chicago, Seattle, and San Francisco, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend monthly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction. At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams. Benefits That Work For You Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits: Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics. Whole-self care through wellness partnerships Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+) Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits. Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: security@mavenclinic.com . For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/maven-clinic-director-marketing-operations

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United Kingdom (Remote) Who we are Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot. We’re excited to hire someone based in London , where we’re looking to grow our sales presence. About The Role Our team is still early in its evolution, operating with a start-up mindset within a scaling company. We're building stronger processes, a clearer operating model, and the foundation for our next stage of growth. We’re looking for someone who wants to help create that future—not just operate within it. As a Senior Account Executive reporting directly to the Head of Sales, you’ll be a key driver of our outbound engine. You’re a strategic seller who owns the full cycle, thrives on proactive outreach, and isn’t phased by cold calls or pipeline creation. You combine discipline with initiative, independence with collaboration, and urgency with long-term relationship-building. Your territory spans Mid-Market and Enterprise customers, blending short-cycle and long-cycle opportunities. But make no mistake: outbound is the heartbeat of this role. Things you will do: Outreach + engagement : contact leads via email, cold calls, conferences, and more. Manage inbound and referral leads. Lead gen + prospecting: research potential customers, generate leads, and build a consistent outbound sales pipeline. Attend industry events and develop connections to drive future sales growth. Qualification + closing : run discovery calls, demos, and follow-ups to qualify and close new customers. Build proposals and RoI cases that convince qualified prospects to buy Listen. Negotiate contract terms when needed. Process improvement: improve our internal sales processes (slides, call scripts, meeting templates, contract terms, CRM workflows, metrics, dashboards, etc.). Run weekly “Sales Review” meetings company-wide to review deals and answer questions. Cross-team work : work with Customer Success, Engineering, and Product to consistently delight customers. Work with our co-founding team on all things sales and revenue-related. What you already bring to the table: 5–8+ years of quota-carrying closing experience in B2B SaaS Experience selling into enterprise or upper mid-market accounts Proven ability to run consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles Track record of closing meaningful deals ($50K–$250K+) and expanding accounts Strong discovery and storytelling skills Comfortable balancing inbound + outbound pipeline generation Highly organized and proactive in managing deals end-to-end *Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We move as one team , empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters strong bonds grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. We champion our diverse customer base by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we hold high expectations for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Everyone is welcome here. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/typeform-senior-account-executive

items.title: Trust & Safety Product Manager (Full Remote - Ireland)
items.summary: Our Vision & Products EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World 50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users…
items.description: Our Vision & Products EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World 50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next At EverAI , we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting , we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories. Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform , redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first . And we’re only just getting started! Our Team We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO. Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO] • 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership • Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO) • Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23 Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO] • 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM • Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands) Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO] • 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth • Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal] • 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A • Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone) • Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited) • Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited) Your Role We are looking for a Trust & Safety Product Manager to own the product and technical delivery of our compliance and safety initiatives across our platforms. You will turn safety requirements into effective product features, moderation capabilities, third-party integrations, and measurable improvements. Working closely with Compliance, Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Customer Support, you will help us identify risks earlier, build safeguards into new features, and continuously improve how our safety systems perform. This is a newly created role within our Product team, working directly with our CTO, Michael Monin and our Legal & Safety Lead, Maxwelle Sokol . You will have significant ownership from the outset and the opportunity to shape how the safety product function develops as the company continues to grow. Our platform serves adults and permits lawful adult content. We are looking for someone who can navigate sensitive, context-dependent issues thoughtfully, protecting users and enforcing clear boundaries without unnecessarily restricting legitimate expression. Here’s what you can expect: Key Responsibilities Safety & legal product strategy and delivery. Translate safety policies, legal requirements (e.g., in online safety and AI-specific laws such as the EU AI Act), incident findings, and user feedback into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and engineering work. Drive initiatives from problem definition through implementation, testing, launch, and ongoing improvement. Internally developed moderation technologies . Own the product side of improvements to our in-house moderation systems, including our proprietary LLM technology EverGuard. Partner with Engineering and AI/ML teams on, e.g., detection capabilities, moderation rules and thresholds, and appropriate interventions across user inputs and AI-generated outputs. Third-party safety partnerships and integrations . Lead the technical and product lifecycle of third-party safety partnerships, from identifying needs and evaluating providers to implementation, testing, rollout, and ongoing performance management. Safety dashboards, monitoring, and quality assurance . Establish dashboards and a recurring QA that help us proactively identify emerging issues, prevent harmful content, and ensure that our T&S measures are working as intended. Red teaming and adversarial testing . Own our testing for how moderation systems and product safeguards respond to deliberate misuse and difficult edge cases. Track findings through remediation, retesting, and closure—not just delivery of a report. Trust and safety reviews for new features . Establish and run a dedicated T&S review for new features, with proportionate reviews for material changes to existing features, models, and integrations. Engage early in product design to identify foreseeable misuse, affected users, and appropriate safeguards. Incident follow-through and continuous improvement . Coordinate the product and engineering response to significant safety issues, working with colleagues responsible for incident management, policy, and user support. Learn more about our Trust & Safety infrastructure in our Trust & Safety Hub . Your Qualifications Data-driven product decisions that align with legal/ethical standards: You can name the metrics you want to influence, explain why it matters, and say whether your work actually moved them. You’ve run A/B tests, product experiments, data deep-dives, or lightweight user research and used the findings to shape what was built next. You can assess risks associated with user-generated content, transactions, and interactions, and translate these into policies that align with legal and ethical standards, trackers/dashboards, and strategic planning; Content moderation and AI guardrails : You understand how product realities and safety requirements interact on a tech platform; you explore strategies for efficient and scalable content moderation, including automation, machine learning, human review and user reporting. Legal/safety work experience : You have worked closely with trust and safety and compliance requirements and understand how to translate and implement these for a consumer-facing product; Collaborative mindset and communication : You work cross-functionally with engineering, legal, operations, and customer support teams — these are your partners and support system, not your adversaries or a box to be checked. You ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and are fully fluent and comfortable in English; AI fluency: You are completely comfortable working with and leveraging AI tools. You actively seek out and experiment with new tools and techniques without waiting for a project or manager to require them; You are point person for third-party partnerships: You proactively test and can autonomously handle discussions with third-party tools and integrations that affect our compliance and safety posture; You take ownership and move without waiting for certainty: Comfortable with ambiguity, you create clarity by investigating, building, testing, and learning rather than waiting for a complete brief. You balance execution against planning, address blockers early, and take responsibility for the outcome rather than waiting to be told what to do, caring more about reaching the right result than following a fixed process; You are comfortable with the product category: you are fully comfortable building products based on uncensored models and content; Bonus points You have previous legal/compliance education Professional experience or interest in AI Experience with consumer-facing features, particularly in the entertainment or gaming industry Soft Skills Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English) Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment ⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and need people who can balance execution, planning, and strategy Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback #NSFW - Comfortable reviewing and discussing uncensored AI-generated content and NSFW material We believe strongly that information can be learned, but effort and motivation cannot. If this role appeals to you but you don’t have hands-on experience in all the fields listed in this job description, apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a good fit! Why EverAI? Exponential Growth : From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation : We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it Global Impact : Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance Proven Leadership : A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship Elite Remote Team : 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies , with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity ️ Ethical Core : Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology , ensuring responsible development at scale What We Offer ✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work ️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset ‍‍‍ Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together ❤️‍ Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members) Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD ⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows * Compensation: Our salary ranges are set based on role level, scope, location, and market data, and applied consistently regardless of candidate background or negotiation history. The final offer within the published range reflects assessed experience and scope. Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech , led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies . We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with. We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business. If that’s you — reach out and apply!

items.description: Location & work modality: Remote Start: Asap Type of Contract: Freelance or Permanent About Radian Arc . Radian Arc delivers AI infrastructure and GPU-as-a-Service (GPUaaS) solutions that enable enterprises, telecommunications operators, governments, and AI organizations to deploy, operate, and scale high-performance GPU infrastructure. With teams across the USA, Australia, Europe, Malaysia, Singapore, and Japan, we work with customers and strategic partners to deliver platforms for enterprise AI, sovereign AI, inference, training, and next-generation GPU cloud services. What impact you will have We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to own complex, multi-stakeholder GPUaaS and AI infrastructure deployments from planning through production handover. You will set the plan, critical path, and delivery governance for each deployment. You will coordinate Solutions Architecture, Engineering, Product, Procurement, Data Center Operations, Service Delivery, Sales, customers, vendors, and strategic partners, and keep delivery aligned with customer expectations and commercial commitments. You will also play a key role in building Radian Arc 's Project Management Office (PMO). That means designing and standardizing how we deploy, and applying automation and AI-assisted development tools to turn those processes into repeatable workflows and live dashboards, with less manual coordination as deployment volume grows. This is a highly autonomous role for someone who enjoys creating structure in a fast-growing company. You will work with teams across the USA, Europe, Asia, and Australia, so you will regularly need to collaborate outside standard business hours. What you’ll do: Deployment Delivery Own end-to-end delivery of GPUaaS, AI infrastructure, hardware, and new data center / PoP deployments, from initial planning through production handover. Build and maintain the integrated deployment plan and critical path across all workstreams: scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, owners, risks, decisions, and completion criteria. Coordinate hardware procurement, site readiness, installation, networking, storage, compute, platform deployment, and customer onboarding across internal teams and external partners. Keep solution and engineering requirements, hardware delivery, site and operational readiness, customer commitments, and target production dates aligned. Lead deployment acceptance, go-live readiness, stabilization, and formal handover into Service Delivery and Operations. Manage multiple deployments in parallel, balancing shared resources, dependencies, and competing priorities. Deployment Process Design and Governance Define Radian Arc 's standard deployment lifecycle, including stages, owners, required inputs, approval gates, and entry/exit criteria for each phase. Establish delivery governance, including project kickoffs, readiness reviews, change control, decision logs, and escalation paths. Create practical templates, checklists, and runbooks so new deployments start quickly and run consistently. Help build Radian Arc 's PMO by setting project-management standards and delivery disciplines that scale across customers, regions, and data center environments. Run post-deployment reviews and feed lessons learned back into the standard process. Automation, Dashboards, and Reporting Use AI-assisted development and automation tools, such as Claude Code, to build, document, and continuously improve deployment workflows and project-management processes. Work with Engineering to connect deployment workflows to Radian Arc systems, tools, and data sources, and automate routine coordination, tracking, reporting, and data updates wherever practical. Build a standardized, shareable dashboard for each deployment, generated directly from workflow data so status is never maintained twice. Provide executive and working-level views of scope, procurement status, milestones, dependencies, blockers, decisions, owners, and next actions, as a single source of truth throughout the project lifecycle. Risk, Issues, and Stakeholder Communication Identify risks, blockers, resource constraints, and dependency conflicts early, and drive mitigation, escalation, and cross-team resolution. Provide clear, consistent status reporting to internal leadership, customers, vendors, and partners, and run regular project reviews, readiness reviews, and executive updates. Translate complex technical, operational, procurement, and delivery issues into concise updates, clear decisions, and actionable next steps. Build trusted relationships with customer, partner, and vendor stakeholders at both working and executive levels. What success looks like: In your first 90 days, you will: Own active deployments, with an integrated plan, critical path, and risk register in place for each. Document version 1 of Radian Arc 's standard deployment lifecycle, including stages, owners, gates, and completion criteria. Stand up a live dashboard for each active deployment that updates from workflow data rather than by hand. Within six months, you will: Have the standard deployment process in use across all new deployments. Have measurably reduced the manual effort spent on coordination, tracking, and status reporting What you'll need 7+ years in project management, program management, technical delivery, or infrastructure deployment roles, including 5+ years managing complex infrastructure deployments involving multiple internal teams, vendors, partners, and customers. 3+ years working with AI infrastructure, GPU platforms, cloud infrastructure, data centers, hardware deployments, telecommunications operators, or managed infrastructure services. A track record of owning deployments end to end, with direct responsibility for timelines, dependencies, and delivery outcomes, from hardware procurement and site readiness through go-live and handover to operations. Experience building or improving PMO processes, project governance, reporting frameworks, dashboards, and standardized delivery processes. Demonstrated ability to design and improve integrated project workflows, with a practical understanding of how automation, APIs, workflow tools, and AI-assisted development tools can reduce manual coordination and reporting. Technical fluency across compute, networking, storage, data center, platform, and operational workstreams: enough to challenge a plan, spot a missing dependency, and earn engineers' trust. Excellent written and verbal communication, including with customers and executives. Experience working with distributed teams across multiple countries and time zones. Nice to have: Hands-on experience building workflow automation, integrations, or AI-assisted tooling using scripting, APIs, workflow platforms, Claude Code, or similar tools. Direct experience deploying GPU clusters or other high-performance compute environments. Experience with telecommunications operators, or with government or sovereign AI programs. Experience at a fast-growing company where you built delivery processes from scratch. PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum certification What we offer • Attractive compensation package reflecting your expertise and experience. • A great work environment characterised by friendliness, international diversity, flexibility, and a hybrid-friendly approach. • You'll be part of a fast-growing scale-up with a mission to make a positive impact, offering an exciting career evolution. Our job titles may span more than one job level. The actual base pay is dependent on a number of factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. Our inclusive responsibility Radian Arc is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected category under applicable law. items.description: To learn the Hiring Ranges for this position, please select your location from the Apply Now dropdown menu. To learn more about our Hiring Range System, please click this link. Why Mozilla ? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. About this team and role: Mozilla Finance is responsible for strategic resource allocation, overseeing day-to-day financial operations as we scale our mission impact with new and existing products, technology, and business models. Core Services brings together the functions Mozilla runs on: Legal, People, Data Science, Trust & Safety / Customer Experience, Strategy, IT, Cloud Engineering & Ecosystems, and Security - teams supporting every part of the Company. We are seeking a detail-driven Senior Financial Analyst, Core Services to execute the recurring planning, reporting, and analysis that supports this portfolio. This role will be responsible for preparing the forecast, reconciling actuals through close, maintaining headcount and vendor tracking, and producing the reporting that reaches budget owners and the COO. This role reports to the Finance Manager, Core Services, who leads business partnership with the functional leaders, and works closely with teams across the organization. To succeed, you will need to work accurately across a broad portfolio, translate variances into explanations a non-finance audience can act on, and balance competing cycle deadlines with outstanding attention to detail. This position requires a resourceful self-starter who takes recurring processes from start to finish and improves them along the way. What you'll do: Prepare the Core Services forecast each cycle. items.description: At Affirm , we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. We are seeking a highly motivated and analytical individual to join our Growth Analytics International team. This team plays a crucial role in conducting research, monitoring performance, and running experiments to develop exceptional products for both consumers and merchants while driving long-term growth for the business. As Affirm continues expanding into new international markets, this role will be instrumental in establishing the operational analytics framework for new launches, beginning with Australia and expanding into future international markets. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, a collaborative mindset, an eagerness to learn, and the patience to tackle complex challenges. Our team takes an end-to-end business analytics perspective, partnering across the organization to develop recommendations and solutions that enable the business to successfully execute its growth and profitability strategies. This role requires someone who can combine analytical rigor with business acumen to influence decisions and drive measurable outcomes. What you’ll do Establish and evolve the operational analytics framework for new international markets, ensuring scalable measurement, reporting, and decision-making capabilities as we expand globally. Operate with a business owner mindset by proactively identifying opportunities through analysis and product sense to enhance user experience, growth, and profitability. Own business problems from end to end by translating analytical insights into recommendations and optimization strategies that support business growth, profitability, and operational excellence. Take ownership of the end-to-end analytics process: define success metrics, generate insights and hypotheses, track performance, and create intuitive dashboards and reports that can be easily shared across the organization. Develop scalable analytics solutions and data models. Tackle ambiguous problems by identifying the core hypotheses and designing actionable experiments to validate product-market fit and economic viability. Translate analytical findings into clear and compelling narratives and business cases for leadership to inform decision-making. Spearhead weekly cross-functional metric reviews, collaborating with partners to conduct deep dives into significant metric shifts and suggest actionable steps. Partner effectively across Product, Risk, Finance, Commercial, and Operations to align strategies and execute against business objectives. Foster strong cross-functional relationships and establish yourself as a trusted advisor to team members. Mentor and guide junior analysts to deliver high-impact work that drives business results. What we look for: Passion to redefine the lending and financial industry for the better. Strong understanding of the consumer lending and credit industry, including lending economics, portfolio performance, and credit metrics. Experience supporting international lending markets, particularly Europe and/or APAC, is highly desirable. Demonstrated ability to balance growth objectives with profitability and develop data-driven growth strategies. Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitatively rigorous subject area such as statistics, mathematics, finance, or economics. 5+ years of proven success in a cross-functional analytical role. Practical and theoretical knowledge of A/B testing. Experience with SQL and performing statistical analysis using Python. Experience simultaneously balancing multiple workstreams and prioritizing an analytics roadmap. Demonstrated curiosity and a growth mindset, with hands-on experience using AI-powered tools such as Cursor, Claude, or similar assistants to accelerate analysis, automate workflows, enhance problem-solving, and advocate for AI adoption across analytical workflows. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical audiences. Comfortable partnering across multiple cross-functional teams, particularly Product, Risk, Commercial, Finance, and Operations. Ability to think creatively and critically while thriving in a fast-paced, dynamic, and often ambiguous work environment. Willingness to go out of your way to help teammates, with humility and a team-first mindset. Previous experience mentoring and guiding junior analysts. Compensation & Benefits Pay Grade - M Equity Grade - 5 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range . Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience. Benefits designed for you Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights: Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents. Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you. Experience: Proven experience as a Product Manager or in a similar role within the advertising or software development fields. You should have a track record of successfully managing and launching products that meet market needs and drive business growth. SaaS Expertise: Good understanding of SaaS interfaces, dashboards, charts, and reports. This expertise is essential for developing user-friendly products that provide valuable insights and drive user engagement. AdTech Knowledge: A deep understanding of the online advertising technology landscape, including customer needs and market dynamics. Experience and knowledge in AdTech and online advertising are crucial. Knowledge and experience with affiliate marketing are a plus. Analytical Skills: Strong ability to analyze market data, interpret insights, and make informed decisions. This involves using data to prioritize product features, measure performance, and guide the product development process. You should also be comfortable with SaaS analytics and reporting tools to extract meaningful insights. Rapid Prototyping: Knowledge and experience with rapid prototyping techniques to quickly iterate and refine product concepts. This is crucial for fast-paced development cycles and ensuring that ideas are effectively translated into functional designs. We are looking for someone who not only meets the skill requirements but also brings additional qualities that will help drive our success. Your proficiency with tools, experience in scope management, and ability to lead and inspire are critical for this role. Product Management Tools: Proficient in using product management tools and methodologies such as Atlassian Product Discovery. These tools help streamline the product development process, ensure all team members are aligned, and facilitate efficient project management. Scope Management: Experience in transferring scope from Product Management to Product Owners for product development. This skill ensures that product development is focused and efficient, with clear responsibilities and timelines, leading to successful project execution. Wireframing & Prototyping: Familiarity with high-level wireframing and prototyping techniques. This allows you to create initial design concepts that can be tested and refined before full-scale development, ensuring that the final product meets user needs and expectations. Productivity & Quality: We expect high productivity and a work mentality based on productivity-focused work. Visionary Thinker: A forward-thinking leader with the ability to inspire people and drive teams toward achieving strategic goals. Your vision and leadership will be crucial in guiding the product development process and achieving business objectives. If you are passionate about AdTech and have the expertise to lead product development in a dynamic environment, we would love to hear from you.
