We got there by moving incredibly fast and hiring an exceptionally sharp, hard-working and deeply committed team from leading tech and accounting companies — Ramp, Meta, Microsoft, Lyft, PwC, Deloitte, J.P. Morgan, Bloomberg, Sage, Xero and Intuit. And some of us don't have a fancy logo on our resume and are here for a shot to prove ourselves. We’re a small team, growing fast with huge momentum - join early. This is an intense, hands-on role with full ownership. We expect you to push for excellence and raise the bar. 📍 Location: Remote - this role is available across all EU/LATAM countries with 4hr+ overlap for the US ET timezone (NYC HQ) As our Frontend Engineer , you’ll own and build major product surfaces end-to-end. This is an intense, hands-on role with full ownership. Where you'll create impact You’ll own end-to-end execution for core frontend features in React + You’ll build and deliver intuitive, high-performance UI that makes complex workflows simple You’ll collaborate with product, design, and backend engineering to ship fast and with clarity You’ll strengthen our frontend architecture, performance, accessibility, and responsiveness You’ll help shape our component library and frontend system as we scale You’ll elevate the quality and polish of the product with user empathy and attention to detail What sets you up for success Hardcore work ethic and high agency 5+ years experience in frontend development with React ( a strong plus) Proven track record in high-growth environments Deep expertise in JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals and modern frontend principles Strong grasp of responsive UI, accessibility, and usability Comfort building and testing APIs; experience with HTTP, Postman, debugging Clear product intuition, design sensitivity, and craftsmanship Pragmatic mindset with high-speed execution Curiosity, autonomy, and ownership Why you’ll thrive here Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry Your feedback shapes the product directly High-speed culture High-trust environment with high expectations Ambitious mission Compensation & Benefits Base Salary: $65K–$120K USD Equity: ~$30K Contract type: B2B Remote-first team — the fastest team you will have ever worked with\ 15 PTO days + 12 public holidays Visa sponsorship option for relocation to NYC within 2+ years Early-stage role with high autonomy and real long-term upside Enjoy a learning & development budget for courses, certifications, and language learning to keep growing your skills Work where you feel most productive at co-working spaces or from your home office with support for setup, internet, and phone Plus, wellness perks and more to make your workday even better! We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career - an archaic and huge industry like ERP only goes through a seismic shift like this once in a lifetime. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll do this decade. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard! At DualEntry , we believe great products come from diverse teams. We’re an equal opportunity employer, and we’re committed to a culture where everyone feels included, supported, and able to do their best work. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Argentina Remote Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality. About the Role We’re looking for a S enior Infrastructure Engineer to improve reliability and stability of Webflow’s customer-facing, production infrastructure, serving millions of page views per hour. Our product is used by over 2 million users world-wide across 190 countries, and you’ll help ensure our platform is secure and scalable for these users as tens of thousands of projects are launched on Webflow each month. Location: Remote-first (Argentina) Permanent, full-time employee (this is not a contractor position) Application Information: Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled This posting is for a new position. As an Senior Infrastructure Engineer you will: Own and evolve the cloud platform that Webflow's product and engineering teams depend on, including our compute layer, EKS fleet, serverless infrastructure, networking, and cloud operations across AWS and GCP. Help design and maintain our infrastructure-as-code foundation, evolving the patterns and shared components other teams build on. Design and maintain the networking layer that connects Webflow's services, ensuring reliability, security, and scalability across our cloud environments. Help make observability data the foundation of how we operate, improving the dashboards, alerts, and SLOs for the infrastructure you own so that issues are caught before customers notice, and on-call pages are actionable instead of noisy. Build and maintain AI-powered automation that improves how we manage cloud infrastructure, from policy-as-code and drift detection to LLM-assisted runbook generation. Help define the culture of this growing team as it expands its international presence. About you You’ll thrive as a Senior Infrastructure Engineer if you: Have a background as an infrastructure, site reliability engineer or cloud engineer with an enthusiasm for automation and code, or a background as a software engineer with deep enthusiasm for cloud infrastructure and distributed systems. Have 5+ years of experience owning and operating cloud infrastructure in a customer-facing environment that allows for little to no downtime. Have deep hands-on experience with AWS and a strong opinion on what good cloud operations look like. Have experience managing Kubernetes clusters at scale, including upgrades, node group management, autoscaling, and cluster add-on lifecycle. Have experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Pulumi or Terraform, and a strong preference for changes made through code, not consoles. Have experience navigating multi-region or multi-cloud environments on AWS or GCP. Stay curious and open to growth, demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact. It would be a bonus if you had even one of the following: Experience with Karpenter, cluster autoscaler, or other Kubernetes-native scaling tooling. Have experience with OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus or Grafana Experience building AI-assisted infrastructure tooling, including cost optimization loops, anomaly detection, or policy-as-code with LLM assistance. Experience contributing to multi-region architecture including data residency, regional failover, or latency-based routing. You Are: Collaborative : You possess a collaborative spirit, thriving when working with both your immediate team and cross-functional partners. Strategic thinker : You're a strategic thinker, adept at defining clear business needs and evaluating solutions to make informed build-versus-buy decisions. Comfortable with ambiguity : You navigate ambiguous situations with ease, gathering data and making progress even with incomplete information or unclear requirements. If you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying . Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements. Our Core Behaviors: Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first. Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act. Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible. Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers. Benefits Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company. Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums. Support for every stage of family life . 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions. Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired. Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching. Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally. Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts. Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program. Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment. Remote, together At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Texas URL: https://kyro.ai Sales Development Representative (SDR) Location: Remote, non-US based, working US Central Time business hours Experience: 1-3 years in a B2B SDR/BDR role Employment type: Full-time Reports to: Product Manager - Growth ABOUT KYRO AI When a major storm knocks out power, utilities race to mobilize crews and get the lights back on. Kyro AI builds the software behind that effort: workforce and contractor management for electric utilities, storm restoration contractors, and aggregators. We are headquartered in Plano, Texas, and were spun off from Think Power Solutions, so we pair long-standing utility expertise with the pace and ownership of a product company. https://kyro.ai/ WHY JOIN KYRO - Work that matters: our platform helps communities get power back after storms and keeps a critical, regulated industry compliant. - A growing product suite: StormShield for storm restoration, Kyro Capital for contractor invoice factoring, KORY (our AI copilot), and contractor onboarding and verification. - Credibility from day one: you sell with the backing of real utility relationships and domain know-how. - Close to leadership: direct access to the CEO and product team, and what you hear from customers shapes the roadmap. - Room to grow: a clear path from SDR to Account Executive. - Flexibility: fully remote team. THE ROLE As an SDR, you are the first conversation most utilities and contractors have with Kyro. You will work two segments with very different buying motions: Utilities (enterprise): You will talk to storm response, emergency management, contractor management, supply chain, and procurement leaders. Cycles are long, involve multiple stakeholders, and are often tied to RFIs/RFPs. A win is a qualified discovery meeting or demo handed to the account team. Contractors (SMB to mid-market): You will talk to owners, operations managers, and storm coordinators at line, vegetation, and restoration contractors. Cycles are shorter, phone-first, and owner-led. A win is a demo held and the contractor signed up and onboarded. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Prospect outbound: research target utilities and contractors, build account lists, and reach decision-makers by phone, email, and LinkedIn. - Own the follow-up: run multi-touch cadences, chase no-shows and stalled conversations, and make sure every lead has a dated next step. - Respond to inbound leads the same business day and qualify them before they go cold. - Qualify with rigor: confirm need, timeline, decision process, budget, and compliance requirements before booking. - Book and confirm demos, send reminders, and hand off with clear notes. - Drive conversions: stay with contractors after the demo until they sign up and start onboarding; keep utility opportunities moving to the next stage. - Keep the CRM clean: log every activity, stage change, and next step. - Feed the product team: share objections, competitor mentions, and feature requests from the field. HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED Success is measured on demos held and the conversions that follow. Activity counts are leading indicators, not the goal. KPIs: demos booked, demos held, demo-to-opportunity rate, conversions (contractors signed up and onboarded; utility opportunities advanced to proposal or pilot), pipeline sourced, speed to lead, follow-up coverage (share of open leads with a dated next step), and outreach activity. Targets are set separately for each segment; utility credit weighs meetings and pipeline more than closed conversions. WHAT YOU BRING - 1-3 years as an SDR or BDR in B2B sales, ideally SaaS, with a record of hitting or beating meeting and demo quotas - Disciplined follow-up across phone, email, and LinkedIn without being reminded - Confident cold calling, including with field-oriented buyers who rarely live in their inbox - Clear, concise written communication - Hands-on experience with a CRM and a sales engagement tool (HubSpot, Apollo, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar) - Comfort with metrics: you track your own funnel and know where deals stall - Ability to learn a technical, regulated domain quickly - Self-directed and organized in a fully remote setting - Native English speaker, available during US Central Time business hours NICE TO HAVE - Experience selling into utilities, energy, construction, field services, or regulated industries - Familiarity with storm restoration, line work, vegetation management, or contractor ecosystems - Exposure to both enterprise (long-cycle) and SMB or self-serve sales motions - Experience selling workforce management, compliance, or fintech products - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience COMPENSATION AND PROBATION - Competitive market base plus uncapped commission. Base is paid bi-weekly and commission quarterly. - Accelerators: 1.5x at 101-125% of quota, 2.0x above 125%. - The first six months are probationary, with performance reviews at 3 and 6 months against ramped KPI targets (demos held, conversions, follow-up coverage). - If targets are not met, Kyro may extend the probationary period or end employment. - - Employment remains at-will during and after probation. WHAT WE OFFER - Competitive base and variable pay - A fully remote role - A clear path to Account Executive for SDRs who consistently hit target - Direct exposure to product and leadership at a company shaping how utilities run storm response To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/kyro-ai-sales-development-representative

items.description: Silverback Strategies is a performance marketing agency built to help marketers grow and capitalize on change. Ad Age, Inc Magazine, The Washington Post, The Washingtonian, and The Washington Business Journal have recognized Silverback as one of the best places to work. We hire the best and help them get better. Silverbackers are supported, challenged and inspired by their peers. Regardless of title or tenure, every Silverbacker plays a role in helping our agency get better. This is a place where you can make a difference. Today, we’re looking to add a new Senior SEO Manager to the team. Silverback’s next Senior SEO Manager will serve as a premier subject matter expert in all things related to SEO & Organic Search. You will develop and manage a portfolio of 4-6 SEO accounts while building great client relationships and managing projects & deliverables. You’ll bring a scrappy & tenacious attitude to your work, diving headfirst into the “new frontier” of organic search by pushing the boundaries of AI search testing. You’ll flex best-in-class data analysis chops to break down performance metrics and directly impact the success of our clients’ businesses. Here’s what we expect from our Senior SEO Manager: What You’ll Do Strategic Chops: Responsible for driving and executing the strategy, innovation and performance of multiple client SEO strategies. AI & LLM Expertise: Hands-on experience with Generative AI and LLMs, including their influence on search behavior and the ability to implement optimized strategies for these engines. Ability to identify new opportunities Analytical Skills: Fluently leverage tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and other SEO platforms, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex data into actionable insights. Client-Facing: Lead recurring status and reporting calls & serve as assigned clients’ primary point of contact with Silverback for all things SEO. Clearly communicate complex SEO strategy and execution details to clients in a digestible, jargon-free manner. Client Management: Act as a trusted advisor & consultant to clients — an extension of their marketing team — to build long-lasting client relationships. Tactical Execution: Translate channel strategy to time-bound, tactical roadmaps. Build and maintain structured content systems, including topic clusters, pillar pages, internal links, and supporting schema. Prioritize performance-based initiatives and drive authoritative content at scale. Innovation: Research emerging trends in search and AI technologies to refine strategies and implement innovative best practices. Process/Delivery Improvements: Identify opportunities to improve the SEO delivery and process to increase the value of the work or improve efficiency. Data Analysis: Review performance data to identify trends, measure the impact of initiatives and build actionable strategies. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with internal teammates across measurement, paid media, and creative to bring strategies to life. Sales Support: Work with the sales team to put together SEO strategy proposals and audits that align with their goals and objectives. What You’ll Need to Succeed Agency Background: You’ve previously “done the work” at another performance marketing agency, and know what it takes to deliver results. Years of Experience: We’re seeking candidates with at LEAST 3 years of agency experience; 5+ years of overall relevant marketing/SEO experience is required. Client-Facing Comfortability: This role is not a good fit for someone who doesn’t want to talk directly to clients. You must be comfortable building rapport, establishing expertise / credibility, and serving as the face of the SEO engagement with your assigned clients. Embrace Complexity: As a Senior SEO Manager, this role will be exposed to more complex and challenging situations. You have a strong ability to navigate complexity and tackle challenges head on. AI Search Testing & Optimization: You have hands-on experience optimizing for AI search (not theoretical; actual tests). You don’t have all the answers — nobody does! — but you’re excited to test, experiment, and figure it out. Business Acumen: Being able to build & execute SEO strategies across multiple industries is crucial, but your ability to tie SEO wins to a measurable impact on the clients’ business, bottom line, etc is what will make you a superstar. Content Experience: You’re an expert at driving content strategy based on audience, keyword and competitor research. You have a strong ability to craft content briefs to provide to content teams for production. Tools/Platforms: You’re a pro with common SEO tools & platforms such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, SEMrush, AHRefs, and Screaming Frog. Get Sh*t Done” Mentality: You’d rather take a big swing and miss than sit around twiddling your thumbs. You’re energized by & thrive in an environment where no two days are the same, and results are king. Adaptability & Growth: Feedback fuels you. You lean into change, sharpen your skills, and push yourself and your team to get better every day. Project & Time Management: You run a clean calendar and keep priorities straight. Competing demands don’t throw you. Why Silverback? Silverback isn’t for everybody. If you’re an A player, you will get paid more, learn more and grow faster with support from a smart and fun team. If you’re a B player, you will be miserable. Make an impact: We’re a small agency. Everybody has the opportunity to drive change and impact. Get paid: We hire the best and pay them generously. Do cool sh*t: From media to SEO to measurement, learn the cutting edge of what works. Benefits & Perks Unlimited PTO Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans Virtual Team Events and a fun, casual, inclusive company culture Company-paid ClassPass membership 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave Summer Fridays 401(k) with Employer Match $90,000 - $103,000 a year Silverback Strategies is an equal opportunity employer. If you believe you meet the qualifications for the position, then we invite you to apply. We celebrate the free flow of conversation, ideas and opinions at Silverback, but actions such as bullying, discrimination, harassment or retaliation of any kind are strictly prohibited in our workplace. We are committed to providing a safe, open and accommodating environment that allows all of our team members to thrive. Employment decisions are made without regard to age, color, disability, family, genetic information, origin, race, religion, sex. For more information, we invite you to visit eeoc.gov. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

items.description: A little about us… Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation ! More about our team and company: Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YoXyXTFWbkg Our careers page: https://www.fleetio.com/careers We are seeking a versatile, execution-focused Manager of Revenue Operations to be the operational backbone for GTM functions such as SDRs, Solutions Consulting, and Partnerships. This is a net-new, individual-contributor role — you'll build the operating rhythm, reporting, and processes these functions need as they scale, and you'll flex your focus as priorities shift across the business. Who you are This role will be a strategic partner to leaders within the SDR, Solutions Consulting, and Partnerships org. On any given week, you might be investigating breakdowns in pipeline generation for SDR leadership, standing up a process to track Solutions Consultant deal coverage and win rates, and defining how partner-sourced deals get registered and reported. You bring strong Salesforce and reporting fundamentals, a bias toward action, and the judgment to know when to build a lightweight process versus a fully scaled system. This new role reports directly to the Senior Director of Revenue Operations and will have significant latitude to shape how the function is built. As a Revenue Operations generalist, you will collaborate closely with the field and central Revenue Operations teams. We believe AI will fundamentally change how revenue organizations operate. The ideal candidate is actively incorporating AI and automation into their workflow to build reports faster, surface insights, and scale their impact. Your impact In this role, you will: Serve as the primary Revenue Operations point of contact for SDR, Solutions Consulting, and Partnerships leadership — running point on reporting, process design, and day-to-day support Track and report on SDR activity and pipeline generation, Solutions Consultant deal coverage and win rates, and partner-sourced/influenced pipeline and revenue Articulate the strengths and opportunities of pipeline funnel conversion, especially as it relates to what SDRs and SCs can influence Facilitate the operating cadence (e.g., weekly business reviews) for supported GTM functions to bring executive leaders up to speed on the health of the business Design and improve the workflows, tools, and processes that let each team scale without adding operational overhead — from lead routing to deal registration Define deal registration processes and the operational rules for how partner deals are tracked Take on strategic, transformational projects that redefine how Fleetio’s GTM orgs operate in partnership with the CRO, Sales leaders, and other cross-functional leaders Prioritize and sequence your own work across various GTM functions with competing demands — bringing structure and judgment to a role without an established playbook Partner with the GTM systems team to prioritize and implement improvements to the tech stack that serve GTM functions, and act as their voice in the broader Revenue Operations roadmap Leverage AI and automation tools to accelerate reporting, summarize trends, and reduce manual work Your experience 5+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or Business Operations within a B2B SaaS environment Experience supporting either a SDR, Solutions Consulting, and/or Partnerships org Proven ability to support multiple stakeholder groups or functions at once, prioritizing effectively amid competing, shifting demands Strong hands-on experience building reports and dashboards and navigating workflows in Salesforce; experience with engagement tools (e.g., Outreach, Salesloft) is a plus Strong analytical skills with a track record of turning data into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical stakeholders Demonstrated ability to incorporate AI-powered tools into day-to-day workflows to improve efficiency and accelerate analysis Proven track record of operating with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment — setting your own priorities and driving outcomes without waiting to be directed Demonstrated ability to incorporate AI-powered tools into day-to-day workflows to improve efficiency and accelerate analysis Benefits Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family) Vision insurance Incentive stock options 401(k) match of 4% PTO - 4 weeks (increases at year two!) 12 company holidays + 2 floating holidays Parental leave - birthing parent (16 weeks paid) non-birthing (4 weeks paid) FSA & HSA options Short and long term disability (short term 100% paid) Community service funds Professional development funds Wellbeing fund - $150 quarterly Business expense stipend - $125 quarterly Mac laptop + new hire equipment stipend Fully stocked kitchen with tons of drinks & snacks (BHM only) Remote working friendly since 2012 #LI-Remote Fleetio provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need. This application is not intended to and does not create a contract or offer of employment. Employment with Fleetio is at will. If you have a disability or a special need that requires an accommodation to fill out the online application, please let us know by calling (205) 718-7500.

Our team is made up of 400+ energetic and passionate Unifones who are dedicated to delivering the best possible experience to 5000+ customer-centric companies. We pride ourselves on our fun and collaborative work environment, where creativity and new ideas are constantly encouraged. As shareholders in the business, we’re so much more than a group of passionate communicators. We are Unifones. Join our team and be a part of something big! Meet the team! Our Engineering team is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the systems and technologies that drive Unifonic ’s solutions. We work closely with other departments to ensure our products and services meet the needs of our customers. If you are passionate about technology and are excited about working on cutting-edge communication and engagement solutions, we want you on our team. As a Product Operations Lead, you will partner closely with Product Leadership to translate product strategy into scalable operational practices that drive alignment, efficiency, and measurable business outcomes. You will establish and continuously improve product operating models, governance frameworks, and cross-functional processes that enable Product, Engineering, Commercial, Marketing, and Customer-facing teams to work effectively toward shared goals. Acting as a trusted partner to stakeholders across the organization, you will drive collaboration, facilitate informed decision-making through data and insights, and ensure clear communication of product priorities, roadmaps, and outcomes. You will lead product enablement initiatives, support successful product launches and adoption, develop performance metrics and reporting frameworks, and identify opportunities to streamline workflows through process optimization and automation. By championing operational excellence, customer-centricity, and continuous improvement, you will help create an environment where product teams can scale efficiently, deliver value consistently, and maximize the impact of the product portfolio. Help us shape the future of communication by: Leading and continuously improving product operations frameworks, governance, and ways of working across Product teams. Owning and optimizing product planning processes, roadmap reviews, prioritization workflows, and operational cadences. Establishing scalable operational practices that improve alignment, transparency, delivery predictability, and execution quality. Driving standardization of product reporting, KPIs, operational dashboards, and decision-support insights. Identifying operational inefficiencies and implementing process improvements to increase team effectiveness and focus. Promoting adoption of AI tools, automation, and operational best practices to improve workflows, reporting, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Commercial, Customer Success, Support, Presales, and Marketing teams to ensure strong operational alignment. Acting as a central point of coordination between business and product organizations. Facilitating communication of product priorities, roadmap updates, launches, and operational initiatives across stakeholders. Supporting leadership teams with operational insights, strategic reporting, and executive-ready communications. Leading Product Enablement initiatives that help internal teams effectively position, support, and adopt product capabilities. Supporting product launches, feature rollouts, demos, and internal readiness activities. Translating complex product functionality into clear messaging, use cases, enablement materials, and customer value narratives. Partnering with Commercial and Marketing teams to improve product awareness, adoption, and customer engagement. Helping identify and remove adoption barriers impacting internal teams or customers. Synthesizing customer feedback, product analytics, sales insights, and market trends into actionable recommendations. Identifying product usage patterns, operational gaps, and growth opportunities that can influence product strategy and commercial outcomes. Supporting Product leadership in defining and tracking success metrics tied to product and operational performance. Contributing to strategic initiatives focused on scaling Product Operations maturity and organizational effectiveness. Requirements What you’ll bring: 5+ years of experience in Product Operations, Product Management, Product Enablement, Product Marketing, Presales, Solution Consulting, or related roles. Proven experience leading or scaling operational processes within Product or SaaS organizations. Strong understanding of product lifecycle management, product delivery processes, and cross-functional collaboration. Experience working closely with Product, Engineering, and Commercial teams in fast-paced environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to translate insights into actionable outcomes. Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills. Demonstrated ability to drive initiatives independently and influence cross-functional teams. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. Experience in SaaS or CPaaS environments is a strong advantage. Craft and Toolkit: Product Operations & Process Optimization Strategic Planning & Execution Cross-Functional Leadership Product Enablement & Adoption Operational Excellence & Governance Data Analysis & Insight Generation Communication & Executive Storytelling Stakeholder Management & Influence Solutioning & Product Demonstrations AI Tools & Workflow Automation Customer-Centric Mindset Proactive, ownership-driven approach Character Traits: Analytical thinking and problem-solving – approach problems clearly, use data, and find solutions. Ownership and accountability – take responsibility and follow projects through to completion. Communication – explain ideas clearly and listen to others across teams. Collaboration – work well with others and support team goals. Adaptability and learning – adjust to change and keep learning new skills or tools. Mentorship and knowledge sharing – help others grow and share what you know. Resilience – stay calm under pressure and handle setbacks constructively. Quality and attention to detail – do work carefully and strive for improvement. Advocacy and innovation – encourage best practices, efficiency, and new ideas As a Unifone you’ll receive a range of benefits: Competitive salary and bonus Unifonic share scheme (we are all owners!) 30 holiday days after the first anniversary Your Birthday off! Spend up to 25 days per year working from anywhere in the world! Paid leave for new parents Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Senior Data Modeler
items.summary: Our partner, a Fortune 500 company, is building scalable, analytics-ready data architectures for a client in the healthcare sector.
items.description: Our partner, a Fortune 500 company , is building scalable, analytics-ready data architectures for a client in the healthcare sector. We're looking for a Senior Data Modeller to design and maintain dimensional data models using Kimball methodology that power reporting and analytics at scale. You'll translate business requirements into well-structured logical and physical models, working closely with data engineers, BI teams, and business stakeholders — with particular emphasis on healthcare Encounters data. This is a long-term, remote-first contract position with required US working hours overlap (2-6 PM CET). Responsibilities Dimensional modeling: design and maintain data models using Kimball methodology (star and snowflake schemas, fact and dimension tables, SCDs). Healthcare Encounters data: model Encounters data, ensuring accuracy and alignment with business and regulatory requirements. Advanced SQL: develop and optimize complex queries for data extraction, transformation, and validation. Implementation: collaborate with data engineering teams to implement models within the data warehouse/lakehouse environment. Data quality: perform data profiling, quality checks, gap analysis, and troubleshooting across source and target systems. Documentation: maintain data models, data dictionaries, and mapping specifications. BI enablement: partner with BI and analytics teams to ensure models support downstream reporting needs. Work Conditions Type: Full-time & Long-term contract work Start Date : ASAP Location : Remote US Time Zone Overlap : Required ( 2 PM - 6 PM CET , ideally until 7 PM CET) Contract with EU LLC Requirements Healthcare industry experience — including hands-on knowledge of Encounters data. Experience working with claims, member, or provider data in a healthcare payer (health insurer) or provider setting. Strong Kimball dimensional modeling background — star/snowflake schemas, fact and dimension tables, slowly changing dimensions (SCDs). Advanced SQL skills — complex query writing, performance tuning, debugging, and data profiling across large datasets. Proven ability to design logical and physical data models for data warehouses/lakehouses optimized for reporting and analytics. Excellent problem-solving skills and keen attention to detail. Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and lead technical discussions with data engineers, BI teams, and business stakeholders. Have a consultancy mindset → always try to find a solution for the client Highlights If you are passionate about Data Modeling , SQL , Healthcare data , and building analytics-ready data warehouses , this role with our client offers an exciting opportunity to shape healthcare analytics! Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Toronto, Ontario URL: https://c4media.com/ C4Media, Inc. is looking for a Demand Generation Specialist (Contractor) to join our fully remote, global team. You’ll own digital marketing campaigns that drive QCon registrations, certification enrollments, and InfoQ Live registrations. This is a hands-on, results-driven role where you’ll write copy, manage email campaigns and audience segments, run paid advertising, analyze performance, and continuously improve our marketing processes. The ideal candidate is an experienced digital marketer who enjoys building repeatable campaigns, reaching new audiences, and writing compelling content for a technical audience of senior software engineers and architects. Experience with marketing conferences, certifications, courses, or professional development is a strong plus. What You'll Do Own end-to-end demand generation campaigns for QCon, certifications, and InfoQ Live. Create email sequences, landing page copy, social posts, and paid ad copy. Manage audience segmentation, exclusions, automations, and email campaigns. Plan and execute organic and paid campaigns across Google, LinkedIn, and social channels. Track and report weekly on registrations, enrollments, cost per registration, and revenue. Maintain marketing dashboards, trackers, and campaign calendars. Test new channels and strategies to reach audiences beyond our existing database. Build repeatable campaign processes and continuously improve performance. Coordinate campaigns across products while managing shared audiences and contact limits. Use AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate research, content creation, testing, analysis, and automation. What We're Looking For 5+ years of experience in digital marketing and demand generation, with a strong focus on email and lifecycle marketing. Proven experience driving measurable registrations, enrollments, leads, or sales. Hands-on experience with email marketing platforms such as HubSpot, Marketo, Brevo, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, or similar. Excellent written and spoken English, with strong copywriting skills for technical audiences. Experience with Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, GA4, and organic social media. Strong analytical and reporting skills. Ability to work independently and manage multiple campaigns and deadlines. A proactive approach to staying current with marketing platforms, tools, trends, and best practices. Comfortable using AI tools to improve marketing performance and productivity. Remote Work Requirements Must reside in Europe Able to work in a full-time remote position Able to work in overlap with our core global office hours (9 AM - 1 PM EST) Reliable high-speed internet and a suitable home-office setup Willing and able to travel to the USA or Europe 1–3 times per year for conferences and company meetings Why work at C4Media Work from home - always : We are a remote-first and remote-always team that has been successfully operating on a work-from-home basis since 2007. And we have no intention of changing that. Travel the world: C4Media offers an opportunity to travel 3-4 times a year at our expense to NYC, SF, London, and other fun, global locations for conferences & team building. We also got you covered to add a sightseeing day to the end of the trip. Take care of each other: We look out for one another and prioritize respect, fairness, support, and well-being. Check out our core values on our careers page. Learn something new: C4Media’s culture is one of learning & mastering. Everyone has a training and education budget for professional growth every year and is encouraged to use it. Make friends across the world : Be a part of a leading, fast-growing international company and build a network of international friends and colleagues for life. Support wellbeing: In an effort to make physical activity more readily accessible, we offer staff an annual subsidy towards fitness and wellness. Generous paid time off: In addition to 25 paid days off in the 1st year and 30 paid days off in every subsequent year, we provide 1 paid day off for birthdays (or a similar special day) and 2 paid days for continuing education. Qualified candidates are to submit their applications on our C4Media website. Only candidates who submit their applications in English will be considered for this role (including resume). To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/c4media-inc-demand-generation-specialist

items.description: All Other Remote Headquarters: Canada (Remote) Upgrade aide ses clients à avancer dans la bonne direction grâce à des produits financiers abordables et responsables. Depuis 2017, nous avons aidé plus de 7,5 millions de clients à accéder à plus de 42 milliards de dollars en crédit à la consommation. En nous concentrant sans relâche sur l'amélioration du bien-être financier de nos clients, nous développons des produits qui leur permettent de faire des économies et qui les soutiennent pour un meilleur avenir financier. Nous sommes soutenus par certains des meilleurs investisseurs dans le domaine de la technologie et avons été récemment valorisés à 7,3 milliards de dollars. Nous sommes constamment reconnus pour notre culture de collaboration et d'inclusion. Plus récemment, nous avons été classés parmi les Premières entreprises fintech au monde par CNBC, Meilleurs lieux de travail par Built In, et par le San Francisco Business Times, Meilleurs lieux de travail d'Amérique par Newsweek, Meilleur employeur ''Startup'' par Forbes, et Employeurs les plus sains par Phoenix Business Journal. Nous recherchons de nouveaux membres d'équipe qui sont enthousiastes à l'idée de concevoir et de proposer des produits nouveaux et meilleurs. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à bâtir un meilleur avenir financier pour des millions de personnes. À propos du rôle Un(e) Développeur(-euse) Expérience IA est responsable du cycle de vie complet des parcours que nos clients vivent avec l'agent IA d'Upgrade par clavardage, par téléphone et par courriel : création, optimisation, gestion des cas particuliers et augmentation du taux de résolution autonome. Cette personne conçoit des parcours dans les outils sans code de Sierra, collabore avec les groupes produits d'Upgrade pour intégrer leurs processus de service à l'agent, et répond de la capacité de l'agent à résoudre le problème du client de façon sécuritaire, exacte et sans intervention humaine. Nous recherchons un(e) Développeur(-euse) Expérience IA pour prendre en charge l'agent IA d'Upgrade destiné à la clientèle. Vous ferez le lien entre les équipes de développement, de produit et des opérations clientèle. Vous transformerez des processus de service, comme effectuer un paiement, consulter les détails d'un prêt, mettre à jour une adresse ou activer les paiements préautorisés, en parcours de production, et vous continuerez à les améliorer après leur lancement. Vous concevrez et gérerez les parcours de A à Z, de la première ébauche jusqu'à leur pleine maturité. Le travail est à la fois celui d'un bâtisseur et d'un analyste : concevoir le parcours, gérer les cas particuliers, lire les transcriptions et augmenter continuellement le taux de résolution autonome. Le taux de résolution autonome, la satisfaction client (CSAT), la qualité des transferts et le taux d'hallucination sont vos indicateurs clés. Au cours de votre première année, vous serez responsable d'un portefeuille de parcours couvrant l'ensemble de nos produits (prêts personnels, carte, paiement différé (BNPL), marge de crédit hypothécaire (HELOC), dépôts) et contribuerez à établir les normes selon lesquelles Upgrade conçoit, teste et déploie ses expériences IA. Nos technologies principales Sierra Agent Studio (parcours sans code), simulations et analyse des conversations Sierra, API GraphQL et REST (comme outils de parcours), Genesys (transfert vers le centre de contact), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, Claude et autres outils de LLM. Ce que vous ferez Création de parcours : Concevoir et développer des parcours Sierra dans Agent Studio pour le clavardage, la voix et le courriel, de la phase de découverte avec les opérations jusqu'au déploiement en production Optimisation : Analyser chaque semaine les transcriptions, les enregistrements et les données analytiques, repérer où les conversations échouent ou sont transférées, et déployer des correctifs à la logique des parcours, aux instructions et à la base de connaissances Gestion des cas particuliers : Cartographier les scénarios problématiques (paiements refusés, identité non concordante, comptes en souffrance, demandes non prises en charge) et s'assurer que chacun se conclut par une réponse exacte ou un transfert fluide Résolution autonome : Assumer la responsabilité des cibles de résolution autonome et de CSAT pour chaque parcours, mener des déploiements progressifs (1 % → 100 %) et prioriser les travaux ayant le plus d'impact sur ces indicateurs Partenariat produit : Collaborer avec les groupes produits (prêts personnels, carte, BNPL, dépôts) pour définir la portée de nouveaux parcours, maintenir les parcours à jour au fil de l'évolution des produits et définir les API dont l'agent a besoin Sécurité et conformité : Appliquer l'authentification à plusieurs niveaux et la vérification renforcée, le libellé de conformité exact ainsi que des garde-fous contre les hallucinations et les réponses non conformes aux politiques Transferts : Concevoir les transferts vers des agents humains dans Genesys avec des résumés exacts et le contexte d'authentification Tests : Créer des suites de simulation et de tests de régression afin que chaque modification de parcours soit déployée avec la preuve qu'elle n'altère pas le comportement existant Surveillance : Suivre la latence, les erreurs et les abandons dans SumoLogic et Grafana, et être responsable des alertes Optimisation vocale : Latence, phrases de transition, interruptions, personnalité et ton Relation avec Sierra : Agir à titre de responsable technique de notre côté, faire remonter les problèmes liés à la plateforme et orienter les demandes relatives à la feuille de route Ce que nous recherchons De 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en développement logiciel, ou une expérience équivalente dans des rôles en solutions techniques, en IA conversationnelle ou en gestion de produits techniques Connaissance pratique du comportement des agents LLM : instructions, appels d'outils, récupération de connaissances, et les points de défaillance de chacun Expérience dans la conception d'évaluations pour des systèmes non déterministes : jeux de tests, simulations, LLM évaluateur (LLM-as-judge), seuils de régression Une maîtrise technique suffisante pour lire des spécifications d'API, collaborer avec des développeurs backend sur des intégrations REST et GraphQL, et raisonner sur les autorisations et les portées de permissions Un esprit axé sur le produit et le client : vous comprenez les procédures opérationnelles, lisez les transcriptions, accordez de l'importance au ton et mesurez votre réussite selon la résolution du problème du client Sens des responsabilités en production : déploiements, surveillance, analyse de journaux et réponse aux incidents Rédaction claire et capacité à travailler avec des interlocuteurs non techniques des équipes des opérations, de la conformité et des affaires juridiques Atouts supplémentaires Expérience pratique de Sierra Agent Studio ou d'une plateforme d'agents sans code comparable (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect) Expérience en IA vocale : reconnaissance vocale (speech-to-text), synthèse vocale (text-to-speech), optimisation de la latence, gestion des interruptions (barge-in) Connaissance des systèmes de centre de contact tels que Genesys et de la conception de transferts vers des agents Expérience en fintech ou dans un autre secteur réglementé (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2) Expérience en conception conversationnelle ou en rédaction UX Ce que nous vous offrons Salaire compétitif ($140K-$180K) et plan d'options d'achat d'actions Assurances médicales, dentaires et de la vue payées par l'entreprise Congés payés flexibles Possibilités de croissance et de développement professionnel Congé parental payé Initiatives de santé et de bien-être Exigence linguistique English language is required for this position, as it involves interacting with staff at Upgrade's offices worldwide. L'anglais est requis pour ce poste, puisqu'il comporte des interactions avec le personnel des bureaux d'Upgrade à l'échelle internationale. Conditions environnementales et de travail Le travail s'effectue à l'intérieur dans un environnement au rythme soutenu qui exige la capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités et de respecter les processus de travail, les horaires et les attentes en matière de service établi. Les employés saisissent, extraient et échangent régulièrement des informations avec précision à l'aide de systèmes et d'applications numériques afin d'appuyer les objectifs opérationnels et de service à la clientèle. Le poste exige la capacité de recevoir et d'échanger des informations avec les clients, les collègues, les superviseurs et les partenaires interfonctionnels par le biais des moyens de communication disponibles, qui peuvent inclure des réunions, des courriels, des appels téléphoniques et des outils de collaboration numériques, et peut impliquer des échanges en temps réel, verbaux ou en personne selon les besoins de l'entreprise. Les fonctions peuvent inclure la gestion d'un volume élevé d'interactions entrantes et/ou sortantes avec la clientèle ainsi que d'activités de travail à l'aide de systèmes de télécommunication et informatiques. Le poste exige la capacité de lire, d'analyser et d'interpréter les informations affichées à l'écran d'ordinateur et de maintenir une posture de travail pendant de longues périodes, conformément aux exigences du poste. Le travail peut s'effectuer dans un centre de contact, un bureau ou en télétravail, selon les besoins de l'entreprise et la nature du poste. Les environnements de travail sur place peuvent inclure des espaces de travail partagés, un éclairage de bureau standard et un bruit de fond modéré typique des environnements de service à la clientèle ou opérationnels. Les employés en télétravail sont responsables de maintenir un espace de travail sécurisé et productif avec une connexion Internet fiable qui prend en charge les systèmes de l'entreprise et protège la confidentialité des informations de l'entreprise et des clients. Des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables peuvent être mises en place pour permettre aux personnes qualifiées vivant avec un handicap d'exercer les fonctions essentielles du poste, conformément à l'Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) et aux lois étatiques et locales applicables. Nous sommes un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances et nous valorisons la diversité au sein de notre entreprise. Nous ne faisons pas de discrimination fondée sur la race, la religion, la couleur, l'origine nationale, le sexe, l'orientation sexuelle, l'âge, l'état civil, le statut d'ancien combattant ou le statut de handicap. Upgrade n'accepte pas les candidatures spontanées soumises par des agences de recrutement, des cabinets de recherche de personnel ou toute autre tierce partie. Tout CV soumis à un employé d'Upgrade sans accord écrit préalable en vigueur sera considéré comme la propriété d'Upgrade, et Upgrade ne sera pas tenue de payer des bonus de recommandation ou de placement. Les agences doivent obtenir une approbation écrite au préalable du service d'acquisition de talents d'Upgrade pour soumettre des candidatures, et ce, seulement si une entente valide et dûment signée est en vigueur. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upgrade-developpeur-euse-experience-ia-ia-conversationnelle

items.title: Research Fellow (PhD or Postdoctoral) - LMIC Family Planning
items.summary: GF Family Planning Survey Initiative — Manuscript FellowshipSurgo Health is building the Behavioral Intelligence layer for healthcare — revealing why people behave as they do, predicting what they will do next, and helping organizations make the decisions that change outcomes.
items.description: GF Family Planning Survey Initiative — Manuscript Fellowship Surgo Health is building the Behavioral Intelligence layer for healthcare — revealing why people behave as they do, predicting what they will do next, and helping organizations make the decisions that change outcomes. A Public Benefit Corporation grounded in two decades of global health experience, Surgo generates foundational behavioral data that reveals the unseen why and builds the AI products that powers decision-grade insights at population scale — equipping healthcare organizations, funders, and public agencies to act on what actually shapes health outcomes: people's beliefs, motivations, and barriers. From predicting who will enroll and remain in a clinical trial, to understanding what drives treatment decisions, to designing more effective health programs, Surgo brings the missing human layer into decisions traditionally made with clinical data alone. Backed by 40+ peer-reviewed publications and trusted by partners including the Gates Foundation, J&J, Takeda, Pivotal Ventures, and the Clinton Health Access Initiative, Surgo is building a future where healthcare organizations don't just understand human behavior, but anticipate it — making healthcare more personal, precise, and effective for everyone. Role Summary We are inviting applications for a Research Fellow to join Surgo Health ’s Gates Foundation (GF)-funded Family Planning initiative, a multi-country study spanning Senegal, Côte d’Ivoire, Nigeria (Kano, Kaduna, and Lagos states), and Pakistan (Sindh). This fellowship is centered on manuscript production. Fellows will collaborate closely with Surgo's research team to advance a priority research question – building on analysis and framing already underway – through to a submission-ready manuscript for a peer-reviewed journal. What you’ll achieve: What You’ll Achieve Develop and lead a manuscript around an agreed priority research question, building on existing analyses and data and conducting additional analyses as needed Produce a submission-ready, publication-quality manuscript for a peer-reviewed journal Translate complex survey and causal-modeling findings into insights relevant to global health policy and program design Contribute to Surgo Health ’s growing portfolio of family planning research and thought leadership in low- and middle-income country (LMIC) contexts Research Focus Areas Priority Papers You will lead on completing the analysis that has already been started. With this, you will write the manuscript, with guidance and support from the research leads throughout. Couples-linked segmentation in Northern Nigeria (Kano and Kaduna): How do women's and their partners' own attitudes toward family planning align or diverge, and what does this mean for programs designed to shift partner-related norms? This work links directly to an active program partnership focused on norm-shifting interventions in the region. Rethinking how we measure FP intention (Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Pakistan/Sindh): Standard measures of contraceptive intention – a binary yes/no, or a 12-month time horizon – may obscure meaningful variation in fertility desire, intent strength, near-term planning, and confidence. This paper aims to describe how we have developed and tested a more multidimensional approach to measuring intent across three countries. Patterns of change in FP attitudes and behaviors over time in FP journeys (Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Nigeria [Kano and Kaduna], Pakistan [Sindh]): Using panel data collected roughly a year to two after baseline, this paper aims to characterize which women's contraceptive trajectories are "sticky", and tests which baseline predictors of conversion, intent development, and discontinuation generalize across countries versus which are context-specific. Additional Areas of Interest If none of the priority papers above are the right fit, the following list is intended to spark ideas rather than define the boundaries. If you have an interesting idea that isn't included here, please feel free to propose it. Determinants of contraceptive intention, uptake, and method choice in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Nigeria (Kano, Kaduna, Lagos), and Pakistan (Sindh) Causal inference approaches to family planning behavior (e.g., Bayesian networks, causal forests, propensity score matching, doubly robust/DoubleML methods, G-computation) Segmentation-informed analysis using belief- and behavior-based segments to explain heterogeneous contraceptive outcomes Comparative, cross-country analysis of family planning drivers and structural barriers Subgroup and geographic vulnerability (e.g., state-level variation, rural/urban differences, adolescent and youth subpopulations) Contraceptive discontinuation and continuation dynamics Comparative methodology, including analysis that contextualizes findings alongside established survey instruments (e.g., DHS, PMA) Data Available to Fellows Fellows will work with de-identified data from Surgo's Gates Foundation-funded multi-country Family Planning study: a cross-sectional baseline survey plus a longitudinal follow-up conducted at a later point in time, across Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Nigeria, and Pakistan (Sindh). Baseline: Women's FP Survey — Representative baseline surveys of women of reproductive age (15–49), covering fertility intentions, contraceptive use and method choice, household decision-making, perceptions and norms, health system access, and information exposure. Data was collected in 2024 to early 2025 depending on the geography. Sample sizes range from roughly 7,000 women in Senegal to around 10,000 in Côte d'Ivoire and Pakistan (Sindh), with Nigeria in between. In Nigeria, the baseline covers three states — Lagos, Kano, and Kaduna. Baseline subset: Male Partner Interviews — In a smaller subset of baseline households, the woman's male partner also completed a companion interview, capturing his perspective on decision-making, approval, and household dynamics — enabling dyadic/couple-level analysis. Partner interviews were conducted with roughly one in ten baseline households in most countries, somewhat higher in Nigeria. Follow-up: Longitudinal Women's Survey — A subset of baseline women who consented to re-contact were re-interviewed roughly one to two years after baseline to track changes in intentions, behavior, and access over time. This enables analysis of intention-to-behavior gaps, method continuation/discontinuation, and segment transitions. Follow-up samples range from under 2,000 women in Senegal to several thousand in Côte d'Ivoire, Nigeria (Kano and Kaduna), and Pakistan (Sindh), split between women who were contraceptive users and non-users at baseline. Fellows will receive final sample sizes, codebooks, and documentation upon onboarding. What You’ll Do Develop and lead a research paper within agreed priority areas, either building on existing analyses and insights from the GF-funded multi-country family planning studies or developing a new research question using the available data, with additional analyses as needed. Synthesize and translate existing findings and/or generate new analyses to deepen understanding of the mechanisms, risk factors, and protective factors shaping family planning behaviors and outcomes. If applicable, utilize rigorous quantitative and/or causal inference methods appropriate to the research question Draft and revise a manuscript for submission to a peer-reviewed journal, incorporating feedback from Surgo’s research team Collaborate with Surgo’s research scientists for methodological guidance and framing Expected Outputs One submission-ready manuscript for a peer-reviewed journal (primary deliverable) Clean, documented analysis code and supporting analytic materials if appropriate Program Structure & Support Selected Fellows will receive: Access to de-identified, multi-country family planning survey data under a data use agreement Codebooks and methodological documentation Regular check-ins with Surgo’s research team for methodological guidance and feedback on drafts Methodological and analytic support Guidance on funder framing and positioning Co-authorship and publication support Opportunity to present progress to the broader research team Fellows will retain academic independence while benefiting from Surgo’s translational and methodological support. Fellows are additionally supported through a structured cadence of meetings throughout the fellowship. Regular check-ins are designed to keep work on track and give fellows direct access to Surgo researchers and leadership: Weekly check-ins with Surgo project lead(s): Fellows will meet twice per week with their respective Surgo project lead(s). These sessions are intended to support analytic progress, troubleshoot methodological questions, and provide feedback on developing outputs. Fellows are invited to join the Surgo FP analytics team meetings. This gives fellows visibility into the broader team context and an opportunity to share work in progress with colleagues across the initiative. Leadership exposure (optional): Fellows will have two scheduled opportunities to present findings to Hannah Kemp, Chief Strategy Officer, Client Engagement and Mokshada Jain, Vice President of Global Health. These sessions are built into the fellowship calendar and are a chance to share developing work with senior leadership. Fellows who want additional exposure can also request up to two optional meetings with Vincent Huang, Senior Director of Data Science & AI, to discuss their analytic approach and findings. These sessions are available but entirely at the fellow's discretion. Timeline Project Duration: maximum 17 weeks (~4 months) Earliest start date: Oct 15, 2026 Expected main deliverables include: (Week 1-2): Confirmed scope of work (Week 1–2): For papers requiring new analysis, this is an analytic plan. For papers building primarily on existing analysis or an established framing (e.g., the intent measurement paper), this is instead a confirmed research question, agreed division of remaining work between the Fellow and lead(s), and a manuscript outline. (Week 6 or earlier): Preliminary results or draft findings (midpoint review) (Week 12 or earlier): Draft initial manuscript for internal reviews delivered (Week 16-17 or earlier): Final submission-ready manuscript delivered Authorship Fellows are credited as co-first-author or first author depending on their contribution. All publications and external communications will follow the agreed authorship and review process. Surgo Health retains the right to review and approve all outputs prior to external submission or distribution. Stipend Stipend amount: $6000 Payment is milestone-based. The stipend is distributed in four equal installments, with 25% ($1,500) awarded upon the successful completion of each milestone. Milestone | Conditions for payment Milestone 1 | Scope of work confirmed (week 1-2): For papers requiring new analysis, this is an analytic plan. For papers building primarily on existing analysis or an established framing, this is instead a confirmed research question, agreed division of remaining work between the Fellow and lead(s), and a manuscript outline.Signed data use agreement on fileSatisfactory onboarding requirements (cybersecurity training, etc) Milestone 2 | Preliminary results or draft findings shared at midpoint review meetingSurgo team confirms satisfactory progress Milestone 3 | First draft manuscript Milestone 4 | Two rounds of internal review revisions incorporated Submission-ready manuscript delivered and accepted by Surgo team. All deliverables complete by agreed deadline About you: About You PhD candidate, postdoctoral researcher, or early-career researcher in a relevant field (e.g., public health, demography, economics, biostatistics, epidemiology, data science) Strong experience in quantitative analysis, survey data, and/or causal inference methods Demonstrated ability to produce rigorous, publication-quality research Experienced in family planning, reproductive health in LMIC contexts is strongly preferred Experience in behavioral science and program implementation context is a plus Comfort working with large-scale, multi-country survey datasets Location: Remote friendly Travel: None required How to Apply Path A — Join a Priority Paper. Apply to collaborate on one of the three papers listed under Priority Papers Open for Collaboration. In place of a general statement of interest, submit a short written response (up to 1,000 words) addressing all three of the following: Understanding: In your own words, what is the core analytic challenge this paper is trying to solve, and why does it matter? (2–3 sentences) Approach: How would you approach the methodological question below for your chosen paper? Walk through your reasoning, including tradeoffs you'd weigh. Couples-linked segmentation in Northern Nigeria: How would you approach measuring alignment or divergence in paired partner responses on family planning attitudes? What would guide your definition of "alignment," and how would you handle the non-independence between partners' responses? Rethinking how we measure FP intention: How would you validate that a multidimensional measure of contraceptive intention (fertility desire, intent strength, near-term planning, confidence) actually captures distinct dimensions, rather than one underlying construct measured multiple ways? Longitudinal typologies of FP journeys: How would you define and empirically identify "sticky" versus "fluid" contraceptive trajectories from panel data, and how would you convince yourself the resulting typology reflects real behavioral patterns rather than measurement noise? Framing & Evidence Needed: Based on what's described above, what angle or framing would you propose for this manuscript? What evidence or additional analysis would need to emerge from the data to support that framing — and what would change your mind if it didn't? Path B — Propose Your Own Idea. Apply with your own research question, grounded in the Additional Areas of Interest listed above (or a closely related idea). Include a short concept note (up to 1,000 words) outlining your proposed question, analytic approach, and how it would draw on the available data. All applicants should submit: CV or resume Path A : the written response described above (up to 1,000 words), indicating which priority paper you're applying to. This can be a Word document or PDF file attached to your application Path B : the concept note described above (up to 1,000 words). This can be a Word document or PDF file attached to your application One prior peer-reviewed publication (strongly preferred), as first author or a major contributing author. If that is unavailable, submit a scientific writing sample. This can be a Word document or PDF file attached to your application Contact information for two references Benefits What You’ll Love About Surgo Fantastic, fun and collaborative colleagues; opportunity to solve tough challenges in healthcare and global health Ability to be entrepreneurial, with tremendous opportunities for growth Public Benefit Corporation with an impact and equity mission Our Hiring Philosophy We hire for passion and core competencies. We look for problem solvers and lateral thinkers. We love it if you have done different things with your time. If you think you are ideal for this position, write to us even if your experience doesn’t match all the requirements listed above. Equal Opportunity and Diversity Policy Surgo believes a diverse, inclusive staff makes a stronger team and more impactful organization, and we are committed to building and developing this team and environment. Qualified people of all races, ethnicities, cultures, ages, sex, genders, sexual orientation, gender identities and expressions, languages, social class, marital status, religions, veteran status, and disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply. Getting healthcare is often the easy part — finishing it is where things fall apart: people book the appointment and skip the follow-up, fill the prescription and stop taking it, get the referral and never make the…
items.description: About League League is one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Canada and the leading healthcare experience platform. Getting healthcare is often the easy part — finishing it is where things fall apart: people book the appointment and skip the follow-up, fill the prescription and stop taking it, get the referral and never make the call. That gap costs health plans and health systems money, and it costs people their health. League closes that gap — identifying what each person needs to do next, clearing what’s in their way, and getting it done, for the 70 million+ people whose care already runs through our platform. Health plans and health systems trust us to do this at scale. Organizations like Manulife, SCAN, Geisinger, and Medibank on the payer side, and Baptist and Shoppers Drug Mart on the provider side. Position Summary: This is a builder role, not a maintainer role — equal parts strategy and execution. You're the most senior growth marketing hire on a team that's re-building its demand generation engine. You'll have the budget, a team, and direct access to leadership to do it. You'll be marketing into two of the most sought-after B2B buyer groups in health tech: payers with long procurement cycles and multiple clinical/financial stakeholders, and providers balancing patient experience against margin pressure. If you want to prove you can build and run demand gen at enterprise scale, in a category where the sales cycle actually tests your craft, this is that proving ground. You're inheriting a full, well-funded MarTech stack — Salesforce, Pardot, Bizible, Demandbase, and Qualified — and the website itself, but the job isn't to just run any of it as-is. We want someone who rebuilds how that stack operates to be agentic-first: designing AI agents that pull signal to plan campaigns, launch and sequence them across channels, and continuously test and optimize without manual hand-offs between tools. What You'll Do: Own and optimize our tech stack and website Own pipeline generation across paid search, paid social (LinkedIn), SEO, content, lifecycle/email, and account-based marketing Continuously test messaging, creative, and campaign structure — and bring examples of non-boilerplate campaigns that actually moved pipeline Own reporting: define KPIs and dashboards, and keep pipeline numbers trusted by Sales Own the AI-Native Workflow strategy and AI Engine Optimization (AEO): as buyers increasingly use LLMs to research vendors, you have ideas on how to build League's presence in those results Strategically partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product Marketing and Revenue Operations Security-Related Responsibilities Compliance with Information Security Policies Ensure access management is performed in compliance with the employee's role and responsibilities Responsibility and accountability for executing League's policies and procedures within the department/ team Notification of HR, Legal, Compliance & Security of any incidents, breaches or policy violations What You'll Bring: 7+ years in B2B demand generation or growth marketing, with real ownership of pipeline outcomes — not just campaign support Enterprise background: you've marketed to large, complex organizations with long sales cycles and multiple stakeholders; payer or provider experience is a strong plus Hands-on across the full stack: paid search, paid social (LinkedIn), SEO, content, and account-based marketing Fluent in the pipeline metrics that matter here — MQL/SQL/SQO conversion, pipeline contribution, cost per opportunity — not just CAC/LTV/ROAS Real experience building AI agents or automations, not just prompting a chatbot — bonus if you already gravitate toward MCP-first, Salesforce-native tools Strategic and hands-on: you're equally excited to set the plan and execute it Bonus: experience with ABM platforms like Demandbase or 6sense Bonus: experience in HealthTech, FinTech, InsurTech, or other large enterprise-focused products CANADA APPLICANTS ONLY: The Canada-specific compensation range below for this full-time position is exclusive of bonus, equity and benefits. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target for base salaries for the position across all Canadian locations. The salary range is intentional to account for the performance and career progressions a Leaguer will experience in the role throughout their time at League. Where in the band you may land is determined by job-related skills/experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range specific to your skills and experience during the hiring process. Compensation range for Canada applicants only $145,000—$170,000 CAD AI Fluency & Ways of Working At League, we are an AI-native organization . We expect all employees regardless of role or level to thoughtfully leverage AI to improve the quality, speed, and impact of their work. What this means in practice: Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow to enhance productivity, problem-solving, and decision-making (e.g., drafting, analysis, coding, research, or process automation) Apply judgment and accountability when using AI by reviewing outputs for accuracy, bias, and quality before use Continuously learn and adapt as new AI tools and capabilities emerge, incorporating them into your ways of working Identify opportunities to improve how work gets done from personal productivity to team-level workflows by leveraging AI effectively Operate with strong data responsibility and security awareness , especially when working with sensitive or regulated information How this scales by level: Individual Contributors: Use AI to improve personal productivity and quality of output Senior ICs / Managers: Integrate AI into team workflows and improve processes Leaders: Drive AI adoption at the organizational level and shape how work is done across teams What we look for: Demonstrated experience using AI tools in a practical, responsible way Curiosity and openness to experimenting with new technologies Ability to balance efficiency with quality and sound judgment Our employees come from different backgrounds, and we celebrate those differences. We are looking for the best candidates for our open roles, but do not expect applicants to meet every qualification in order to be considered. If you are excited about what you could accomplish at League and believe you can add value to our team, we would love to hear from you. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you are an individual in need of assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please contact us at recruitinginfo@league.com . Our Application Process: Applying to a role you love can be exhausting, and understanding the next steps can feel vague and uncertain. You have done the hard part of submitting your application; let's do ours by sharing potential next steps You should receive a confirmation email after submitting your application. A recruiter (not a computer) reviews all applications at League. If we see alignment with League's needs, a recruiter will reach out to learn more about your goals. The recruiter will also share the team-specific interview process depending on the roles you are exploring. The final step is an offer, which we hope you will accept! Prior to joining us, we conduct reference and background checks. Additional checks could be required for US Candidates, depending on the role you are exploring. Here are some additional resources to learn more about League: Learn about our platform, leadership team and partners Highmark Health, Google Cloud, League: new digital front door to seamless care Former Providence President and Workday EVP of Corporate Strategy join League Board of Directors League raises $95 million USD in Series C to build world’s leading healthcare CX platform Forbes x League: The Platformization Of Healthcare Is Here Fast Company x League: If we want better innovations in healthtech, we need more competition Work Location: We have a mix of office-centric roles based in our vibrant Toronto office, and remote-eligible roles based anywhere in Canada or US. Each job posting will indicate where the role will be based. Regardless of the role’s posted location, all Toronto-area Leaguers (living within 65 km of our downtown HQ) collaborate in-office Monday through Thursday. Depending on your distance to the office, you’ll enjoy 10 or 20 Flexible Remote Days each quarter for focus and deep-work time. We are committed to fostering a meaningful work environment and connections for all Leaguers regardless of location. Recognize and Avoid Employment scams. Practice safe job searching. Scammers are getting craftier and leveraging fake job postings to get personal information. Know the warning signs and protect yourself from scammers. Learn more here . Use of AI Notice We are committed to ensuring fairness and transparency throughout our hiring process. League may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the screening of applicants for this position. Please check out our stance on using AI in recruitment here . Privacy Policy Review our Privacy Policy for information on how League is protecting personal data.

items.description: Du findest technische Beratung in Finance & Controlling, Logistik oder Utilities im SAP-Umfeld spannend, bist interessiert an Themen der Datenmigration und bringst ausgeprägte Modulkenntnisse in den SAP-Modulen mit?
