items.description: Design Headquarters: Remote - United States About Vercel: Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. About the Role: AI Gateway gives developers one place to connect applications and agents to hundreds of models with one API key. It handles provider routing and fallbacks, unifies billing and observability, and lets teams manage spend and security controls across production AI workloads. Designing this well is a systems problem. A developer should be able to choose the right model, make and verify a first request, diagnose a failed request, and configure routing, budgets, credentials, and security controls without losing sight of the application they are trying to build. The right interface might be in the dashboard, on the public model catalog, in the CLI, in an API response, or in code. You will be the Design Engineer for AI Gateway, owning product design and frontend implementation across those surfaces. You will work with customers, a Product Manager, and engineers to understand the problem, explore solutions, build the production experience, ship it, and learn from what happens after launch. AI Gateway is live, the model ecosystem changes every week, and the team can move from an observed problem to production quickly. This is a rare chance to use your product judgment, design craft, and code to shape a developer product and ship the experience yourself. You will be the design owner embedded with a Product Manager and a dedicated engineering team. You will also have the Product Design team around you for critique, collaboration, and support. AI Gateway will be your main product area, with room to pursue design-led improvements across Vercel. You will report to the Design Team. If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team. What You Will Do: Own product design and frontend implementation for meaningful parts of the journey from discovering a model to making a first successful request and operating AI in production. Design and build production experiences across the website, dashboard, CLI, and APIs, choosing the right medium for each problem. Make models, providers, credentials, routing, budgets, logs, performance, privacy, and governance understandable, then create patterns that extend across new providers, modalities, and workloads. Talk directly with customers and use product data to understand problems, define success, make tradeoffs, and improve what ships. Own quality after launch, including visual and interaction craft, accessibility, performance, resilience, instrumentation, and edge cases. Use coding agents to explore and implement ideas quickly, while testing, debugging, and taking responsibility for what ships. About You: Your work shows what you personally identified, designed, built, shipped, and learned after launch. You build production-quality web applications with React and TypeScript and can contribute confidently in a large, existing codebase. You bring strong visual and interaction craft and have made technical or data-rich products understandable without removing the control advanced users need. You can move between graphical interfaces, CLI workflows, API behavior, and implementation details, treating accessibility, performance, failure recovery, and instrumentation as part of the design. You use customer research and product data to make decisions, communicate your reasoning clearly, challenge ideas constructively, and change direction when the evidence changes. You use coding agents in your daily work, but you can explain, test, debug, and take responsibility for the code they help produce. There is no required path into this role. You may come from product design, frontend engineering, creative development, or a career that does not fit a standard title. We care about the quality of what you have shipped and the judgment behind it. Bonus If You: Have experience with developer tools, infrastructure products, model marketplaces, or observability experiences. Have worked with AI models, providers, inference platforms, guardrails, or AI application tooling. Have experience with APIs, command-line tools, structured product content, or agent-facing interfaces. Have built an application or agent with Vercel’s AI SDK or AI Gateway. See the work: AI Gateway AI Gateway documentation Browse AI models AI model leaderboards Design Engineering at Vercel Compensation & Benefits: Competitive compensation package, including equity. Inclusive Healthcare Package. Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills. Flexible Time Off. We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed. The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $208,000 - $312,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process. Disclosures: Privacy: Please review our J ob Applicant Privacy Policy for more information on how we handle your data. Equal Opportunity: Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/vercel-design-engineer

items.description: Job title VP of Growth - Financial Solutions Department Financial Solutions Sales Reports to Chief Marketing Officer Classification Full-Time / Non-Exempt Work Location Remote / Local Travel - Open to Candidates in U.S. Eastern and Central TIme Zones Travel Requirement Travel Requirement: Regular local or regional travel within the assigned territory is required for client meetings, networking, and partner development, in addition to occasional travel for BELAY’s annual company Summit and other business meetings. Job purpose The VP of Growth for Financial Solutions is a senior leader responsible for owning and scaling new-business revenue for BELAY’s Financial Solutions business, with a primary focus on small and midsize businesses (SMBs). Our services include bookkeeping, outsourced accounting, controller, tax, payroll and fractional CFO support. This role blends executive leadership with hands-on sales leadership. You’ll build the foundation for Financial Solutions’ growth, including the strategy, playbooks, partner programs, and metrics that allow the business to scale. You’ll lead the outbound and business development team day-to-day, owning pipeline and revenue results. You’ll also stay close to the customer by personally opening doors, helping close key deals, and representing BELAY with strategic partners and key industry stakeholders. This role reports to the CMO and partners closely with the SVP of Revenue (inbound sales) and the VP of Growth for Assistant Solutions to advance company-wide growth priorities. Duties and responsibilities Lead Outbound Revenue Growth & Business Development Own outbound and business development pipeline and monthly/quarterly revenue targets. Manage daily seller activity, follow-up, and accountability; review funnel and pipeline performance weekly. Coach and develop sellers through ride-alongs, deal reviews, and training (virtual or on-site). Recruit and develop top talent, and make timely talent decisions to keep the team performing. Carry a personal book of strategic deals and join prospect calls to support deal strategy, objection handling and closing. Partner with the SVP of Revenue on shared pipeline, handoffs, and education across inbound and outbound. Lead the sales team day-to-day. Manage seller activity, follow-up, and accountability through BELAY’s tech stack (Salesforce, Outreach, Gong). Hold sellers to clear standards for outreach volume, pipeline creation, and conversion. Run weekly pipeline and funnel reviews. Inspect deal health, remove roadblocks, and advance opportunities. Keep the forecast accurate and on track to monthly and quarterly revenue targets. Strengthen how the team sells. Coach sellers on deal strategy, objection handling, and closing through ride-alongs, Gong call reviews, and joining prospect calls. Make sure messaging stays consistent with Marketing and with the inbound team led by the SVP of Revenue. Develop Strategic Partnerships & Channels Source, negotiate, and manage a select set of high-impact partnerships that drive qualified SMB opportunities. Identify, develop, and strengthen strategic partnerships with industry organizations, technology providers, professional service firms, and referral networks to expand BELAY’s market reach, generate qualified leads, and drive new business opportunities. Represent BELAY externally at partner meetings, industry events and conferences. Establish partner expectations, referral targets and ROI tracking; refine or sunset partnerships that aren’t delivering. Drive SMB & Owner-Led Growth Develop sales motions that resonate with founder-led, owner-operated and growth-stage businesses. Apply industry and end-market knowledge (e.g., inventory-based businesses, ecommerce, consumer products) to improve relevance and close rates. Partner with Marketing on ICP, messaging, and targeting for owner-led businesses. Growth Strategy, Operations & Data Shape the Financial Solutions growth strategy, forecast and long-term plan with the Officers and Board. Build repeatable outbound and partner playbooks, performance standards and operating rhythms. Establish KPIs, dashboards and forecasting that guide resource allocation and investment decisions. Partner with Revenue Operations to run the team in BELAY’s approved tech stack (Salesforce, Outreach, Gong). Partner with Marketing, Operations, Finance and Delivery so growth aligns with capacity, client experience and margin goals. Develop and maintain deep expertise in BELAY’s services and solutions, serving as a champion and advocate both internally and externally to drive awareness, adoption, and growth. Qualifications Required 10+ years of experience in sales, revenue, growth, or business development within accounting services, outsourced finance, or professional services. 5+ years in a senior leadership role with direct ownership of revenue outcomes. Proven experience scaling outbound sales organizations and senior sales leaders. Demonstrated success building outbound, enterprise, or partnership-led growth motions—not solely optimizing inbound demand. Deep background in consultative, B2B service-based selling with complex buying journeys. Experience selling to CEOs, CFOs, Business Owners, Controllers, and senior finance leadership. Strong executive presence with the ability to influence at the CEO, Board, and enterprise-client level. Preferred Experience working in or alongside PE-backed, multi-entity, or acquisitive environments. Familiarity with account-based selling models and long-cycle enterprise deals. Experience partnering closely with Marketing on ICP definition, messaging, and demand strategy. Leadership Attributes Builder’s mindset with the discipline to scale what already exists Data-driven and highly analytical Collaborative and cross-functional Comfortable operating in a fast-growth, remote-first environment Strong alignment with BELAY’s mission, values, and commitment to integrity and excellence Working conditions BELAY Corporate offers full-time remote work, requiring a dedicated, distraction-free home office for standard Monday-Friday business hours, with occasional travel for some roles. As a full-time, non-exempt W-2 employee, you’ll join a vibrant, award-winning company culture where you’re a valued, engaged team player in a thriving organization. Direct reports 6 Direct Reports Legal Disclosures Pay Range: $165K - $175K + commission Starting Pay Range: $165,000 as noted in range above, based on candidate experience / qualifications Other Types of Pay: Bonus and Commission Health Insurance: Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance are available to eligible employees. BELAY covers 70% of employee premiums and 65% of dependent premiums for medical, and 70% of employee premiums for dental and vision. Company-paid life insurance ($15,000 coverage) and short-term/long-term disability coverage (STD: 60% of weekly earnings up to $1,500; LTD: 60% of monthly earnings up to $10,000) are provided at no cost to full-time employees. Retirement Benefits: 401(k) plan through Vanguard, with a 4% discretionary employer match. Employees are eligible after 90 days of employment. Paid Time Off: Full-time (40 hr/week) employees receive 15 days of PTO annually; full-time (30 hr/week) employees receive 12 days. Additional PTO is awarded at 3- and 5-year tenure milestones. Paid Holidays: 12 paid holidays annually (New Year’s Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day, President’s Day, Good Friday, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, Day After Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, and one floating holiday of the employee’s choosing). Paid Sick Leave: Full-time employees’ PTO accrual generally satisfies state and local paid sick leave requirements in the states where BELAY hires. BELAY follows all state specific requirements. Method of Application: Apply online via the link provided in this posting. Application Window: The posting will remain open until filled. Contact Information: Questions regarding this posting may be directed to [email protected]. EEO Statement: BELAY is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.

items.description: Are you ready to unlock intelligence? If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others. Senior SRE, Managed Gateways About the Role: Kong's Managed Gateways is the fastest-growing product in the Kong portfolio, a SaaS offering with ARR growing multifold. As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer focused on Managed Gateways, you'll be instrumental in architecting and maintaining the resilient, scalable infrastructure that powers Kong's mission-critical managed services — and you'll be the technical face of that product for the enterprise customers who depend on it, directly ensuring the reliability and performance that lets them build the next generation of connected applications at global scale. What You’ll Do: Cloud Gateways is a complex, multi-cloud problem — supported across AWS, GCP, and Azure — and our enterprise customers run large, often unique topologies. This role carries two equally deep engineering mandates: owning production reliability for the platform, and acting as the senior technical authority who takes an enterprise customer from kickoff to a fully successful, live implementation. Platform & Reliability Engineering Lead, mentor, and inspire a high-performing team of Site Reliability Engineers dedicated to Kong's Managed Gateway offerings. Architect and implement robust, scalable, and fault-tolerant cloud-native systems using technologies like Kubernetes, Golang, and major cloud providers. Own the end-to-end operational lifecycle, from proactive monitoring and alerting to incident response and blameless post-mortems, ensuring continuous service improvement. Drive a culture of developer delight by implementing automation, self-service tooling, and streamlined workflows for deploying and managing API gateways. Define, track, and report on key SLOs and SLIs to ensure optimal performance and reliability of Managed Gateways. Champion technical debt prevention and advocate for architectural best practices that enhance system resilience and reduce operational toil. Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, engineering, and Customer Success to influence roadmap decisions and ensure operational readiness for new features. Enterprise Implementation Engineering Partner directly with enterprise customers — working alongside Product leadership, Professional Services, and Customer Success — to drive end-to-end onboarding and implementation of Cloud Gateways, and productize recurring implementation patterns into repeatable playbooks and platform capabilities. Bring deep, cross-cloud breadth (AWS, GCP, Azure) to handle unique customer topologies and turn complex setups into successful, production-ready deployments. Serve as the technical owner of the customer relationship through implementation, primarily supporting our North America customer base, and be the escalation point Customer Success leans on for technically complex accounts. Feed real-world implementation patterns and customer constraints back to Product to further contribute the roadmap. What You’ll Bring: The Toolkit Extensive experience as a Site Reliability Engineer, focusing on highly available and distributed systems. Deep expertise with Kubernetes and cloud-native architectures, preferably across multiple public cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure). Strong proficiency in Golang or similar modern programming languages for automation and tool development. Proven track record in building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible). In-depth knowledge of monitoring, logging, and alerting systems (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, Datadog). Experience with managed services, API gateways, or similar network infrastructure is highly desirable. The Kong DNA You take immense ownership of your systems, treating reliability as a first-class feature. You operate with a sense of urgency, especially in critical situations, and drive quick, effective resolutions. You thrive in a collaborative environment, actively sharing knowledge and elevating the entire team. Kong moves fast, and our team's spread across continents and time zones — plans shift mid-flight, and things don't always line up neatly. You don't need everything settled to do good work. You bring your own calm to the noise, figure things out as you go, and help the people around you do the same. Bonus Points: Experience with Service Mesh technologies (e.g., Istio, Linkerd). Familiarity with database administration for high-throughput systems (PostgreSQL, Cassandra). Contributions to open-source SRE tools or projects. Relevant cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, CKA). #LI-KC1 About Kong: Kong Inc. , the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com .

items.title: Associate Director, Merchandise Planning
items.summary: Associate Director, Merchandise PlanningBrilliant Earth is searching for an Associate Director, Merchandise Planning to lead our Inventory Planning function and the team behind it.
items.description: Associate Director, Merchandise Planning Brilliant Earth is searching for an Associate Director, Merchandise Planning to lead our Inventory Planning function and the team behind it. Reporting to the Senior Director of Merchandising, you'll own forecasting, open-to-buy, and inventory strategy across every category and function, as well as the roadmap that takes our planning capabilities to the next level. This is a builder's role as much as a planner's: our planning infrastructure is actively evolving, and you'll set the direction, partner with Technology and Merchandising to implement new tools, and raise the analytical bar for the whole team. You'll build planning approaches that work for attribute-based, specification-driven assortments while holding the line on turn, in-stock, and margin. We have a social and environmental mission at the core of our company, and we're looking for someone excited to deliver exceptional business results while helping us advance it. What You'll Do: Inventory Strategy and Forecasting Own sales and inventory forecasts across all categories and functions, and hold the team accountable for the accuracy, timeliness, and achievement of inventory plans and KPIs. Set inventory strategy for fine jewelry assortments, including diamond, gemstone, and precious metal commodities, establishing the parameters (weeks of supply, safety stock, reorder points) that balance service levels against inventory productivity. Lead inventory planning for new showroom launches and growth initiatives, directing the scenario modeling and statistical analysis that pressure-test those plans. Open-to-Buy and Financial Planning Own and continue to evolve the OTB alignment and consensus process, translating financial plans into actionable buying strategies with Merchandising and Finance. Contribute to the annual bookings, ASP, and margin budget-setting process, bringing the inventory point of view to category and department targets and reporting consistently against inventory KPIs. Planning Systems and Process Create and drive the Inventory Planning roadmap. Work with leadership to initiate, prioritize, and approve projects, and manage long-term program schedules through to adoption. Partner with Technology on planning system implementation and maintenance, leading the broader team’s adoption of new demand planning and reporting tools. Adapt planning tools and models to integrate cleanly with our evolving enterprise systems and reporting, identifying gaps, developing workarounds, and replacing them with durable solutions. Leverage AI tools to automate recurring analysis and reporting, and drive identification and rollout of new AI-enabled planning workflows across the function. Team Leadership and Partnership Manage, coach, and develop a growing planning team through hiring, feedback, and clear team objectives. Raise planning fluency across the organization by mentoring cross-functional Merchandising partners on forecasting and inventory principles, and by representing Planning credibly to executive leadership. What You Bring: 10+ years in merchandise planning, inventory planning, forecasting, or quantitative analysis within retail, product, or e-commerce, including demonstrated success leading and developing a team. Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certification a plus. Experience with attribute-based or commodity inventory planning (precious metals, gemstones, or other specification-driven categories) is a strong plus. Expert Excel skills: complex formulas, pivot tables, financial modeling, and efficient handling of large datasets. Retail math is second nature. Hands-on experience with demand planning software (Blue Yonder, Logility, Demantra, o9, MI9, or similar) and reporting/BI tools (Domo, Tableau, Power BI); NetSuite or comparable ERP experience a plus. A track record of leading system implementations and cross-functional programs end to end—from defining business requirements and guiding development through adoption—including new forecasting tools, report automation, and process redesign. Experience with AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Excel Copilot, BI-native AI features, Snowflake Intelligence) to automate analysis and reduce manual effort; familiarity with prompt engineering and connecting AI tools to live data sources such as data warehouses or ERP is highly valued. Comfort operating in an evolving systems environment: you can spot the gap, build the workaround, then turn it into lasting process. Expert written and verbal communication, with clear, direct, concise presentations to broader teams and executive leadership. Entrepreneurial spirit and a self-starter mindset, with the ability to think critically and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment. Commitment to respect and inclusion in the workplace. Interest in socially and environmentally responsible organizations and products. What We Offer: Career Growth. We want to see you sparkle! Through regular 1-1’s with your manager, a variety of training opportunities, and an annual 360 review process for all employees, our leaders are dedicated to creating clear pathways for growth. Ask the hiring team for more information on how Brilliant Earth creates a culture of collaboration and growth during your interview conversations! Diverse, mission-minded team. We were founded to cultivate a more transparent, sustainable, compassionate, & inclusive jewelry industry. Learn more about our impact and team diversity Here! Lifestyle Spending Account. At Brilliant Earth , we're committed to your well-being. Enjoy company reimbursements for eligible wellness expenses, such as gym memberships, massage, counseling, and more! Continued Education. Company-sponsored learning in leadership, professional skills, diversity & inclusion, and access to tuition reimbursement for role-specific trainings. Employee Discounts. As an employee at Brilliant Earth , you’ll receive a generous discount on our jewelry. Mental Wellness Perks. We offer access to mental health resources, such as self-care apps and seminars. Our Employee Assistance program offers 24/7 access to counseling! Giving Back and Volunteer Opportunities. In addition to our giving back programs, our teams support local initiatives and spend time together by volunteering. Medical, Dental, and Vision. We offer multiple plans to choose from, including a $0 monthly premium option for employee health insurance and employer HSA contributions. Insurance kicks in on the first day of your 2nd month! 401k match. We know that saving for the future is important. That's why we offer a generous 401k match. Paid Time Off. We know it’s important to recharge and relax Parental Leave. We aim to support our growing families. Employees can utilize our paid parental leave to bond and care for their new additions. Disability and Life insurance. 100% employer-paid. Pre-Tax Commuter Benefits More About Us At Brilliant Earth , our mission is to cultivate a more transparent, sustainable, compassionate, & inclusive jewelry industry. We believe in creating jewelry you can feel good about wearing, without ever compromising between quality and conscience. We are hard-working team players that welcome challenges and rise to any occasion. Our community of collaboration, respect and encouragement is fostered by frequent team events, cross-departmental meetings and celebrating our wins, big and small. As one of the fastest growing e-commerce jewelers in the world, we're searching for bright and passionate people who are excited to make an impact from day one and grow with the company to take on greater responsibility over time. Brilliant Earth recognizes the value of diversity and inclusion on our team, as we work together to reinvent fine jewelry in a thoughtful and modern way. At Brilliant Earth , we celebrate each other – our successes, the lessons along the way, and the unique perspectives each individual brings to our team. It is our intent to maintain a work environment and hiring process which is free of harassment or discrimination because of sex, race, religion, color, national origin, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, military service, veteran status, or any other status protected by Federal, State or local laws. We are committed to complying with all Federal, State and local laws providing Equal Employment Opportunities, and all other employment laws and regulations. When you apply for a job with Brilliant Earth , we process personal information about you. Please see our Privacy Policy for more information. Notice to Los Angeles, CA Applicants: Qualified Applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for Employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Notice to San Francisco, CA Applicants: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for Employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notice to Colorado Applicants: There is no application deadline. Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis. Notice to Philadelphia, PA Applicants: Qualified Applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for Employment in accordance with the Philadelphia Fair Criminal Record Screening Standards. items.description: Role Title: Shopify Specialist Role Type: Contract (~5 - 10 hs/week) Location: Remote Required Skills Shopify data model E-commerce analytics Applied Shopify experience Feedback quality In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Scope of Work Review proposed Shopify and e-commerce task structures, identifying where they diverge from actual platform workflows and data models. Provide clear, actionable written and verbal feedback on the realism and completeness of analytical scenarios and deliverables. Advise on Shopify's core data objects—including orders, products, customers, and reporting—to ensure analytic tasks align with real-world use. Highlight gaps, edge cases, or unrealistic assumptions in scenario framing, drawing on direct hands-on experience. Recommend improvements to task structures, terminology, and metrics based on best practices in the Shopify and e-commerce ecosystem. Validate that terminology and definitions are consistent with standard Shopify/e-commerce analytics language. Suggest additional cases or refinements to better reflect the operator and analyst perspective. Preferred Qualifications 5+ years of deep, hands-on experience within the Shopify ecosystem—across store operations, development, or analytics. Comprehensive knowledge of Shopify's data model (orders, products, customers, reporting). Strong foundation in e-commerce analytics, including conversion, retention, cohort, and revenue measurements. Proven ability to communicate feedback clearly and effectively in both written and verbal forms. Direct experience advising on best practices for structuring Shopify-related analytical work. Experience with multiple Shopify stores, or as a consultant or agency professional (nice to have). Familiarity with Shopify Plus, advanced reporting, and analytical tools such as SQL or BI platforms (e.g., Looker) is a plus. items.title: Senior Java Engineer (Payments)
items.summary: We’re looking for a Senior Java Engineer to join Payforge and take technical ownership of reliable, scalable payments platforms — the systems that move money securely, at scale, where getting it wrong isn’t an option.
items.description: We’re looking for a Senior Java Engineer to join Payforge and take technical ownership of reliable, scalable payments platforms — the systems that move money securely, at scale, where getting it wrong isn’t an option. We’ve just begun working with a few of the most recognised names in global payments — organisations whose infrastructure sits behind everyday transactions — so the scale is real and the engineering bar is high. As a specialist payments consultancy, we offer variety: new clients, new platforms, and hard problems you haven’t solved before, rather than one codebase for the next five years. We’ve been fully remote from the start. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications using Java and Spring Boot, owning features end-to-end from design through production. Lead technical design for significant components — defining service boundaries, data models, integration patterns, and non-functional requirements. Partner with product managers, solution architects, and DevOps engineers to translate business needs into technical solutions — and challenge requirements where the technical trade-offs matter. Own application reliability, performance, and compliance with security and regulatory standards. Build and maintain integrations with external systems, APIs, and third-party providers. Write clean, testable, efficient code and raise the bar for those around you. Drive improvements to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, observability, and deployment processes. Lead code reviews, mentor mid-level and junior engineers, and act as a technical point of escalation. Own production incidents through root-cause analysis to durable fixes. Skills & Experience 7+ years of professional Java development experience, with a track record of owning non-trivial systems in production. Practical, day-to-day use of AI coding assistants and LLMs as part of the development workflow — for implementation, refactoring, test generation, debugging, and documentation — combined with the engineering judgement to review and validate what they produce for correctness, security, and maintainability. We use these tools heavily across everything we build, and we expect them to be directed by an engineer who knows when the output is wrong. Hands-on experience building or operating payments or fintech systems — card issuing, acquiring, processing, authorization, settlement, cross-border, or equivalent. You should be comfortable with the realities of money movement: idempotency, reconciliation, transaction lifecycles, and the regulatory constraints that come with them. Strong knowledge of Java 21/25 (LTS) and Spring Boot 4 / Spring Framework 7, building RESTful and event-driven microservices. Solid experience with Apache Kafka and asynchronous processing, including idempotency and exactly-once semantics. Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and ORM frameworks (Hibernate, JPA). Strong API design skills (REST, OpenAPI) and integration best practices. Confident with modern build tooling — Gradle and Maven — and with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Helm, Terraform). Hands-on experience with AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes. Strong testing discipline (JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers) and production observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana). Experience mentoring engineers, leading code reviews, and working in distributed teams. Nice to have Depth in payments standards and protocols: ISO 20022, ISO 8583, EMV, 3-D Secure, or scheme certification. Depth in security: encryption, OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, mTLS, HSM integration, tokenization. Infrastructure-as-code and platform engineering experience. Experience working directly with enterprise clients in a consultancy or professional-services setting. What we value Precision & reliability — software that meets the highest standards for performance and accuracy. Security-first mindset — applying strong security practices throughout the development process. Adaptability — moving between domains, clients, and problem spaces without losing momentum. Collaboration — working effectively with technical and business stakeholders across teams and geographies. Ownership & accountability — taking initiative to deliver high-quality, production-ready code. Technical leadership — lifting the standard of the whole team, not just your own output. Curiosity & innovation — staying current with emerging trends across the payments industry. About Payforge Payforge is a specialist professional-services company focused exclusively on payments and fintech. We help clients deliver high-quality, scalable technology solutions in an evolving global financial landscape — including some of the most established names in the industry. Equal Opportunity Statement Payforge is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Originally posted on Himalayas

Experiência com observabilidade e monitoramento utilizando Dynatrace, Datadog ou Grafana. Conhecimento em plataformas de mensageria, como RabbitMQ e Kafka. Com o propósito de criar um futuro melhor, ampliando oportunidades para pessoas e empresas, no Brasil somos mais de 4 mil pessoas que atuam em diversos times e especialidades. Cada reconhecimento nos indica que estamos no caminho certo, proporcionando um ambiente de trabalho cada vez melhor para nossos talentos. items.description: Back-End Programming Headquarters: Canada (Remote) About the Role: An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human. We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics. Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences. Our Core Technologies Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools. What You'll Do • Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout • Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge • Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff • Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most • Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs • Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers • Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context • Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior • Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts • Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone • Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks What We Look For: • 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles • Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails • Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates • Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes • Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms. • Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved • Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response • Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal Nice To Have: • Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect) • Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling • Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design • Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2) • Conversation design or UX writing experience What We Offer You: • Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan • Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance • Flexible PTO • Opportunities for professional growth and development • Paid parental leave • Health & wellness initiatives To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upgrade-ai-experience-engineer-conversational-ai

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: US - Remote Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work. Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. About the Role: You'll own your outcomes, from the strategies you run to the conversations that shape what we build next. Collaborative work management is a $14B category growing at 15% a year, and the enterprise competitive set is consolidating fast. Wrike is hiring a Director of Go-To-Market Operations to lead our global GTM Operations team across Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing. You will own Wrike’s revenue planning and operational architecture end-to-end driving annual planning, quota setting, territory management, and cross-functional alignment across our global revenue engine. Reporting directly to GTM leadership, you will serve as a strategic co-pilot to executive leaders while leading a hands-on global team of 6–15 operations partners and analysts. This is an action-oriented leadership role for an operational "athlete'' - someone equally comfortable steering C-level strategic decisions, designing enterprise sales workflows, coaching an international team across time zones, and diving deep into the details of compensation plans or GTM forecasting. Your Impact: Global Team Leadership: Build, scale, and mentor a global GTM Operations team (15 team members, including embedded business partners and visualization analysts across diverse time zones), fostering a high-performance, team-first culture. Annual Planning & Execution: Lead annual planning, quota allocation, capacity modeling, and territory design across Sales, CS, and Marketing teams. Retention & Growth PMO: Partner with executive leadership to program manage company-wide objectives focused on gross/net retention, bookings, and customer lifecycle optimization. Executive Facilitation: Lead recurring operational cadences with executive stakeholders (Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance, Legal) to eliminate friction and accelerate deal velocity. Commercial Support & Governance: Oversee non-customer-facing commercial execution, coordinating with Legal, Finance, and Deal Desk to streamline order processing and contracting workflows. Your Qualifications: 8+ years of progressive experience in Business Operations, Revenue Operations, or GTM Operations within B2B SaaS. Proven People Leadership: Direct experience managing and developing global operational teams (6+ direct/indirect reports) across international time zones. Core GTM Mechanics: Expertise in SaaS unit economics, quota setting, territory planning, retention/bookings metrics, and annual planning processes. Execution Track Record: High proficiency operating as an executive-level partner to Sales, Marketing, and CS leadership without needing a massive administrative layer. Location Preference: East Coast U.S. preferred (ability to align with global time zones and executive leadership). Standout Qualities: Core Traits: High curiosity (constantly seeking better ways to execute), unyielding commitment to follow-through, and rigorous attention to detail. Sales Methodology: Familiarity with enterprise value selling frameworks (e.g., Force Management's Command of the Message, MEDDPICC, or Challenger). Target Background: Experience operating in high-growth, execution-oriented B2B SaaS environments Team Dynamics: You will partner closely with executive leadership and lead a global team of GTM business partners and data visualization specialists. Your team acts as the central nerve center connecting field execution with executive strategy. Our Work Style: We run Wrike on Wrike. You will use our collaborative work management platform daily to run annual planning, manage operational portfolios, and track team execution. We value intellectual curiosity, data-backed decision-making, and swift cross-functional execution. Benefits & Perks: Flexible Time Off (FTO) Company 401(k) Match Parental Leave: 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity 2 Volunteer Days Health (medical, dental & vision) Insurance (EEs + Dependents) Disability (STD, LTD) & Life Insurance Plans (2x Salary, Capped) Working from Home Allowance ($40 / Monthly) $500 Working from Home home office set-up Stipend Your recruitment buddy will be Aziza Talhi , Senior Recruiter. #LI-AT1 The range below reflects the total on-target earnings (including base salary and performance-based bonus potential) for this full-time position and applies to all U.S. locations, excluding benefits and other incentives. The final offer within this range will consider factors such as the role, seniority level, geographic location, and employment contract type. An individual’s work location, unique skills, experience, and relevant educational background will also influence the final offer. For tailored compensation details based on your preferred location, please discuss with your recruiter during the hiring process. Total compensation pay range $180,000 — $205,000 USD Who Is Wrike and Our Culture We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow. Hybrid work mode Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations. While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection. Our persona Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched. Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too! Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful. Our culture and Values Customer-Focused We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind. Collaborative We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement. Creative We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions. Committed We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth. Check out our LinkedIn Life Page , Company culture page , Instagram , Wrike Engineering Team , Medium , Meetup.com , Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wrike-director-global-gtm-strategy-operations
