items.summary: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a fiercely focused team working to become the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world.
items.description: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a fiercely focused team working to become the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We're building a deeply curious team with a passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We're customer-obsessed — we care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight, and strive to ensure we're always acting authentically. Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us? What's the position? We are seeking a Trader - Soccer to join our trading team and report directly to the Soccer Lead. As a Soccer Trader, you will be part of a high-performing trading function responsible for the content, pricing and risk management of our soccer offering. You will ensure all trading activity aligns with internal risk controls, regulatory requirements, and compliance standards. In this role, you will monitor pre-match and live soccer fixtures across major global competitions, analyse market movements, and apply effective price and risk management strategies to optimize performance and maximize profitability. You will work closely with the Soccer Lead and Soccer Consultant to support wider soccer trading initiatives and help ensure our proposition remains complete and competitive on top-tier matches. This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated individual with a strong understanding of global soccer, betting markets, and an ability to identify market trends with precision. Requirements What are we looking for? We are looking for enthusiastic sports people with a genuine passion for soccer and prior experience working in a sportsbook trading or pricing environment. The ideal candidate will be proactive, data-driven, and comfortable making decisions quickly and accurately in a fast-paced setting. Key attributes include: Soccer Expertise - Deep and demonstrable knowledge of major global competitions (e.g. Premier League, Champions League, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, MLS, and major international tournaments), including team form, player analytics, and betting behaviours. A strong understanding of sportsbook operations and betting mechanics. Experience working in a trading room or similar fast-paced trading environment. A keen attention to detail with the ability to maintain accuracy under pressure. A data-led mindset and the ability to interpret, analyse, and act on quantitative information to inform pricing and risk decisions. A willingness to learn, grow, and adapt in a constantly evolving market. Comfortable working flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, to ensure coverage of key soccer fixtures. Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across trading, consultancy, and other business functions. What's in it for you? We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include: Competitive pay and benefits. Flexible vacation allowance. Flexible work from home or office hours. Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand. Opportunity to shape the soccer offering enjoyed by millions as part of a passionate team. Roster of Uniques We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer). Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: Role Title: Equity research Expert Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote We are engaging Equity research Experts to contribute to a customer's project focused on advanced financial analysis, modeling, and sector insights.
items.description: Role Title: Equity research Expert Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote We are engaging Equity research Experts to contribute to a customer's project focused on advanced financial analysis, modeling, and sector insights. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Required Skills equity research financial modeling earnings analysis peer benchmarking sector expertise investment thesis development written communication verbal communication data analysis valuation analysis Scope of Work Review, assess, and contribute to datasets modeling real-world equity research analysis, ensuring accuracy and relevance. Analyze earnings reports, perform estimate revisions, and synthesize peer benchmarking insights for AI training purposes. Deliver detailed written evaluations of company models, including revenue, margin, cash flow, and valuation drivers. Produce high-quality, concise written research summaries and event-driven updates based on deep sector expertise. Develop and articulate investment theses, connecting qualitative and quantitative factors to actionable perspectives. Identify key industry trends, sector-specific metrics, and company catalysts relevant for fundamental analysis. Collaborate with project stakeholders to provide feedback on data quality and enhance research-related content. Preferred Qualifications Extensive experience as a sell-side Research Associate with direct ownership of company models and written research, or as a publishing/lead Research Analyst (titles may include VP or Director). Track record of independently covering multiple companies through several earnings cycles and maintaining comprehensive models. Proven ability to connect business drivers to financial outcomes and valuation. Demonstrated expertise in at least one sector (e.g., banks, insurance, biotech), with the ability to provide deep, specialist insights. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, capable of articulating complex financial concepts clearly. History of performing granular earnings analysis, peer benchmarking, valuation, and event-driven research updates. Experience formulating and defending investment theses and research views, with accountability for research accuracy and quality. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Resilience Product and Adoption Lead
items.summary: The Climate Bonds Initiative is an international NGO working to mobilise global capital for climate action.
items.description: The Climate Bonds Initiative is an international NGO working to mobilise global capital for climate action. Our mission is to develop trusted standards, tools, and market intelligence that accelerate the transition to a climate-resilient and low-carbon economy. The Resilience Product and Adoption Lead will lead on external adoption of the Climate Bonds Resilience Taxonomy (CBRT) and the resilience component of the Climate Bonds Taxonomy , as well as any new resilience products, to guide investment in climate Adaptation and Resilience (A&R). The overarching goal will be to ensure the uptake of these tools by ensuring they are fit-for-purpose, user-friendly and interoperable with the emerging approaches and decisions of a range of target stakeholders. The post will also support ad hoc technical advisory and consultancy services relating to resilience, especially in engaging financial institutions. How you'll contribute Develop and drive external uptake of resilience products Work with the cross-Climate Bonds teams to clarify a ‘product suite’ for resilience. Clarify for Climate Bonds commercial teams how to standardise a product range - leveraging the resilience taxonomy – to accelerate uptake by financial institutions. Work with other engagement teams across Climate Bonds, including but not limited to the regional teams and investor teams, seeking strategic entry and engagement with large-scale investors. Factor the thinking of regional and policy teams into evolving use cases for the CBRT (and / or resilience elements of the Climate Bonds Taxonomy). Support a ‘Certification Task Force’ or equivalent, that ensures robust and timely response to inbound queries around application of the resilience taxonomy. Promote the full range of Climate Bonds resilience products (particularly the CBRT and the resilience elements of the Climate Bonds Taxonomy) Work with the relevant Climate Bonds Teams on a long-term strategy for visibility around the resilience taxonomy. Participate in external advisory groups and events to promote the CBRT and other taxonomy products related to resilience. Ensure that CBRT development is aligned with due consideration to ‘product-market’ placem ent Cultivate relationships with financial institutions, investors, governments, and multilateral agencies who wish to adopt or incorporate the CBRT and the resilience component of the Climate Bonds Taxonomy in their operations and guidance. Based on this engagement, outline and strengthen specific use cases for the CBRT, clarifying which to invest in (and hence which not to prioritise). Do this by working with other engagement teams across Climate Bonds, including but not limited to the regional teams and investor teams. Institutionalise strong feedback loops within Climate Bonds to ensure that lessons from ‘external engagement’ with the CBRT are fed back into plans for further development of either the taxonomy or specific use cases (includes liaison with the Climate Bonds Data Team to ensure that market trends and the needs of the data customers are factored in). Direct and manage the evolution of the CBRT (as a tool / platform) to better serve user needs, as well as adapt to a world where AI is reshaping work patterns globally. Contribute to a full suite of resilience produc ts Work with the Head of Resilience to support the development of new resilience products, should a clear need be identified via market feedback and the internal resilience strategy. Support resilience-related advisory work Work with capacity building, technical assistance and regional teams both to scope and deliver external engagement work, whether advisory, capacity building or other. Support fundraising for the CBRT and related strategic partnerships Work with the Head of Resilience and fundraising teams to raise money for the further development of Work with the Head of Resilience to develop and deepen strategic partnerships that drive widespread adoption of the resilience taxonomy. You should apply if you can demonstrate... Essential: Undergraduate degree in any relevant subject. Experience working in finance or close to financial institutions Experience in external engagement to ensure uptake of knowledge products or services Relationship building and stakeholder management, preferably in sustainable finance Excellent engagement and relationship management skills, including a track record of collaborating with a cross section of stakeholder groups Decent grasp of sustainable finance concepts Strong public speaking and presentation skills Proven experience of delivering projects independently Ability to manage complex projects with multiple partners Fluency in verbal and written English Desirable: Advanced degree in any related subject Experience in taxonomy or standards development Experience in A&R Experience working in emerging markets Experience brokering between teams ‘developing a product’ and teams ‘using or selling a product’. What's in it for you? 📍This role is fully remote ⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team. ✈️ Opportunities to work from another location ✅ Make a meaningful impact every day! items.summary: Are you knowledgeable about investments and eager to shape the future of AI?
items.description: Are you knowledgeable about investments and eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from simple conversational tools into systems capable of analyzing financial markets, interpreting investment strategies, and supporting decision-making across asset classes. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can help improve financial literacy, strengthen portfolio analysis, and support investors and analysts worldwide. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI. We’re looking for individuals with familiarity in areas such as equity and fixed-income markets, portfolio management, asset allocation, derivatives, valuation methods, financial modeling, risk management, behavioral finance, and macroeconomic influences on markets. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics such as fundamental and technical analysis, portfolio construction, diversification strategies, market cycles, performance evaluation, and investment research—documenting failure modes so we can strengthen model reasoning and analytical accuracy. On a typical day, you will engage the model with investment scenarios, analytical questions, and market-based reasoning tasks; verify factual correctness and financial logic; assess the validity of investment reasoning; capture reproducible error traces; and provide structured feedback to improve prompts, evaluation frameworks, and analytical depth. You may also help identify where models oversimplify market behavior or misinterpret financial data. A background in finance, economics, accounting, business, or a related field is preferred but not required. Experience in asset management, brokerage, research, financial planning, or related roles is valuable, and entry-level candidates with foundational knowledge of investments and strong analytical skills are encouraged to apply. Clear, metacognitive communication—explicitly articulating reasoning and decision processes (“showing your work”)—is essential. Ready to turn your knowledge of investments into the knowledge foundation for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and help train systems that support investors, analysts, and financial professionals worldwide. We offer a pay range of $6 to $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply. As AI models and digital commerce platforms increasingly integrate local business data, search mapping workflows, and automated merchant tools, their accuracy relies entirely on authentic, real-world verification. Expected deliverables include: Feature Testing & UX Evaluation: Independently testing newly deployed platform features, digital storefront tools, or AI recommendations designed for local business management and customer engagement. Search & Profile Auditing: Reviewing AI-generated business summaries, search visibility responses, and mapping integrations to verify empirical accuracy against actual business operations. Structured Feedback Generation: Providing comprehensive, audit-ready feedback detailing platform usability, relevance of digital tools, and practical day-to-day utility for local merchants. Anomaly & Context Reporting: Identifying and documenting specific instances where models misinterpret business categories, service offerings, operational hours, or local market nuances. Required Expertise To successfully fulfill the deliverables of this project, Contractors must possess direct operational experience and verified digital storefront assets. Required Asset: Must currently possess and actively manage a verified Google Business Profile associated with your enterprise. Strong analytical communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical observations, user-experience (UX) friction points, and actionable commerce feedback. A meticulous, detail-oriented approach to evaluating digital workflows, consumer-facing data representation, and local search mechanics from a merchant's perspective. We offer a pay range of $25-to-$100 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. items.description: Customer Support Headquarters: Remote (US) Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io. At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career. Lead Enterprise Revenue Architects at Gong are strategic partners to our largest customers. Focused on driving revenue transformation from Gong’s AI Operating System. You’ll guide executive stakeholders and operational teams to drive revenue with Gong by architecting workflows, accelerating adoption, and realizing business results across the entire revenue lifecycle. You will combine a deep understanding of how revenue teams operate with leading change management strategy to help customers operationalise the use of Gong into tangible business results. Your success is measured by activation and adoption, key persona engagement, customer value realization, and revenue impact (retention and expansion). RESPONSIBILITIES Revenue Transformation Strategy: Partner with senior GTM leaders to design and execute strategies that modernize their revenue operations through Gong’s AIOS Workflow Architecture: Map current-state customer processes to AI-driven workflows that translate to revenue outcomes Adoption and Change Management: Execute adoption initiatives that drive behavior change and embed Gong into daily team rhythms Value Realization: Use data-driven insights to quantify measurable business outcomes that demonstrate Gong’s ROI and strategic value Renewal and Expansion Management: Own the renewal strategy and execution, partnering with cross-functional teams on growth Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with internal teams to ensure an exceptional customer experience throughout the entire customer journey QUALIFICATIONS 10+ years proven experience in managing complex enterprise accounts with multiple stakeholders Track record owning relationships with senior (VP and C-suite) stakeholders and owning value and ROI conversations Passion for driving customer centricity by leveraging internal stakeholders such as Sales, Product, Support, Marketing and executives Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. Data-driven mindset with a focus on delivering measurable outcomes. Passion for driving customer outcomes and contributing to a high performing and accountable work culture Our RAs are self-starters who excel in high paced environments and thrive in change and ambiguity. Our top performers have a growth mindset and pride themselves in being coachable. We are a team that values collaboration and winning together, enjoying the ride, and challenging conventional wisdom. If that’s you too, we want to hear from you! PERKS & BENEFITS We offer Gongsters a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit you and your family’s needs. Wellbeing Fund - flexible wellness stipend to support a healthy lifestyle. Mental Health benefits with covered therapy and coaching. 401(k) program to help you invest in your future. Education & learning stipend for personal growth and development. Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend. Paid parental leave to support you and your family. Company-wide recharge days each quarter. Work from home stipend to help you succeed in a remote environment. The annual OTE for this position is $148,000 - $225,000 USD. All Gong recruiting email communications will always come from the @gong.io domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Gong via other sources should be ignored. Gong is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe that diversity is integral to our success, and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, military status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. To review Gong's privacy policy, visit https://www.gong.io/gong-io-job-candidates-privacy-notice/ for more details. items.description: Back-End Programming Headquarters: Ghent - Belgium URL: https://www.twikey.com/jobs Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you. Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough. Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly. Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product. As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product. You focus on developing and improving the back-end of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions. With your expertise you'll make valuable suggestions and streamline processes for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results. You provide technical support on integration projects with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries. Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build. What are we looking for in you? You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work. Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn . You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks. You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning . You think along, question things and keep building new solutions. You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset. You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test. You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework . Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus. You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies. You have a very good command of English , for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset. You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET , so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration. You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central. Twikey offers you: An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first. The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room. An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel! A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere. A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise , shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine. Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue. Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed! A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower. A salary package tailored to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose. The chance to work in an innovative Belgian fintech scale-up that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast! A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you here what it's really like to work at Twikey. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twikey-senior-java-developer

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote - US Airtable helps organizations build the applications and workflows they need to run their most important business processes, without being constrained by off-the-shelf software. Its flexible platform combines a relational database, custom applications, automations, and AI, giving teams the building blocks to create solutions around the way they actually work. Just like Lego blocks, what our customers can build with Airtable is virtually limitless. That flexibility is why more than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, use Airtable to power critical work across their businesses. We’re builders at heart, and we’re looking for builders who want to expand what’s possible in Airtable and what the world can build with it. As a Corporate Account Executive, you’ll work with a portfolio of SMB and Mid-Market customers across a wide range of verticals and industries. That means the best outcomes rarely come from running a standard playbook. We need someone who finds that energizing, someone curious enough to understand how a complex organization actually operates, disciplined enough to orchestrate complex,multi-threaded sales cycles, and resourceful enough to bring the right people in at the right moment. If you’re excited by the challenge of turning an initial opportunity into a strategic relationship, navigating increasingly complex deals, and finding new ways for Airtable to create value across an organization, you’ll thrive here. We hire Corporate AEs with growth in mind: you’ll get the exposure, coaching, and increasing deal complexity you need to ramp quickly toward becoming an Enterprise Account Executive. What you'll do Turn Airtable’s large self-service user base into new business, using existing adoption and proven use cases to uncover and develop high-potential opportunities. Build relationships with leaders across functions and industries, understanding what matters to them and finding opportunities to expand Airtable’s impact as their organizations grow. Own and prioritize your book of business, developing thoughtful account plans and finding your way from an initial champion to stakeholders across the organization. Lead complex sales cycles from first conversation through close, bringing in Customer Success, Solution Engineering, and other partners at the right moments to move opportunities forward. Become a trusted advisor to prospects: understand their business objectives and bring Airtable’s flexibility to life through compelling use cases that show how the platform can solve their problems and transform the way their teams work. Who you are You bring 1-3 years of quota-carrying closing experience at a technology company You’ve successfully closed deals with mid-market and larger organizations (50-3,000 FTEs), with a track record of hitting or exceeding your sales goals. You can run a structured sales process (e.g., Force Management) with rigor and self-awareness. You know where your deals stand, what needs to happen next, and which stakeholders to bring in at the right moments to move them forward. You’re a strong communicator and relationship builder. You build credibility with business leaders and executives, develop the trust needed to move opportunities forward, and create alignment across g stakeholders at each stage of the sales lifecycle. You’re an adaptable seller. You’re comfortable moving across industries, use cases, and buyer personas, and you know how to make your approach relevant to each. What we offer Compensation awarded to successful candidates will vary based on their work location, relevant skills and experience. The on-target earnings range for this role is $182,800 to $238,100 for all office and remote locations. Our total compensation package also includes the opportunity to receive benefits and may include incentive compensation. Working within our existing AirOps workflows, this role serves as a central point of contact between
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Sarasota, FL URL: https://www.simpletiger.com/ The Content Coordinator manages content assets and client communication throughout the production process, keeping projects organized and moving from initial intake through final delivery. Working within our existing AirOps workflows, this role serves as a central point of contact between clients, our editor, our stock image vendor, and the Content Production Manager. This is a coordination-focused role that combines clear communication, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through. The Content Coordinator ensures that each contributor has the information and assets they need, tracks outstanding tasks and approvals, and flags issues that could affect production timelines. Key responsibilities Coordinate content projects across each stage of production, following established AirOps workflows and internal processes. Collect, organize, and maintain client briefs, source materials, drafts, images, feedback, and final deliverables. Communicate with clients to request missing information, share status updates, clarify feedback, and follow up on approvals. Coordinate handoffs between clients, the editor, the stock image vendor, and the Content Production Manager. Track project status, deadlines, dependencies, and outstanding requests, keeping production records accurate and current. Consolidate client feedback into clear, actionable instructions for the editor and other production contributors. Coordinate stock image requests and delivery, ensuring that selected assets align with the content brief and client requirements. Check that required assets, revisions, and approvals are complete before moving content to the next production stage. Flag delays, unclear requests, missing materials, or scope changes to the Content Production Manager. Prepare and organize final content assets for delivery, ensuring that files are clearly labeled and the correct versions are shared. Identify recurring coordination issues and suggest practical improvements to documentation, communication, and workflow execution. Qualifications and skills Experience in content coordination, marketing operations, project coordination, or a similar client-facing support role. Strong written communication skills and the ability to provide clear, professional updates to clients and internal contributors. Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and follow-ups. Strong attention to detail, particularly when managing content versions, feedback, and production assets. Comfort working within established workflows and learning tools such as AirOps. Ability to distinguish routine coordination needs from issues that require escalation. A proactive, dependable approach to keeping projects moving and closing communication gaps. Experience working with B2B SaaS clients. What success looks like Content projects move through production with timely handoffs and clearly documented next steps. Clients receive consistent updates and understand what is needed from them. Editors and vendors receive complete materials and actionable instructions. Content assets, feedback, and approvals remain organized and easy to locate. The Content Production Manager has reliable visibility into progress, blockers, and upcoming deadlines. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/simpletiger-content-coordinator-u-s-based-remote-contractor

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Wyoming, United States URL: http://orchard.co About Orchard 'Orchard' began as the in-house creator programme behind 'In Print We Trust'. That programme took the brand to over a billion views a month and the 13th most-mentioned fashion brand on TikTok UK, and put thousands of creators on contract. We have now launched it as a business in its own right, selling guaranteed organic views with product placement to brands. This is how brands grow now. Celsius, Bloom, Cal AI and Polymarket became big because thousands of creators had the product in their videos at the same time. The business is at multi six-figures in its first month operating from inbound. You'll build the sales side from scratch: pipeline, pricing, contracts, the first hires. About the role What brands buy is simple: a number of views, at one CPM, guaranteed. You'll take the machine and find every way it can be sold. Some we can see: white-label it to agencies; sell it to labels as sound seeding; sell it to retailers and CPG brands as launch momentum; sell managed supply to creator platforms in the markets they can't cover. Some we can't see, and that's where you step in. Perhaps you've got a way in at an AI lab that buys creator footage by the thousand hours, or another channel we aren't even aware of yet. This is a high-ownership opportunity to build/run sales/growth. So you need to have built revenue from a standing start before, at an agency, a platform or your own company, and have hired and run people who sell. Requirements You MUST be DTC/ecommerce/Meta native. You are comfortable being first: no marketing team, no SDR, a product whose packaging you will change. You have extreme agency and can be scrappy/inventive. You've personally closed $100K+ sized deals with agencies, brands or platforms, and you've hired or managed people who sell. Experience selling to SaaS, ecommerce, DTC, retail and founder-led companies. You know the UK and US agency and creator world well enough to get 20 meetings from your own contacts in month one. Benefits £65,000 - £95,000 base + commission Unlimited PTO 6% pension contribution Travel budget for meetings, US trips included Remote first, with a London desk when you want one To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/orchard-founding-head-of-sales

items.description: Du willst nicht nur das Tagesgeschäft am Laufen halten, sondern die Vision eines Unternehmens operativ Realität werden lassen? Du denkst in zusammenhängenden System, steuerst komplexe Organisationen und sorgst dafür, dass strategische Konzepte nicht auf Folien bleiben, sondern im Tagesgeschäft gelebt werden? Als Operations Manager bei EVOLVE trägst du umfassende Verantwortung für Strukturen, Systeme und Teams. Das erwartet dich bei uns Als Operations Manager bei EVOLVE Digital verantwortest du die operative Steuerung in der Organisation. Du sorgst dafür, dass die strategische Ausrichtung des Unternehmens im operativen Tagesgeschäft wirksam wird. In deinem täglichen Handeln führst du die Organisation durch Phasen von Wachstum und Veränderung. Entwickelst Strukturen, Systeme und Abteilungen weiter und stellst sicher, dass EVOLVE als ganzheitlicher Wachstumspartner reibungslos funktioniert - anstatt in Silos zu arbeiten. Um eine zukunftsträchtige Agentur zu gestalten, nutzt du KI und Automationen gezielt als Wachstumshebel. Du definierst die operative System- und Automationsarchitektur und sorgst dafür, dass Technologie messbar zur Skalierung, Qualitätssicherung und Entlastung der Teams beiträgt. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung triffst du operative Grundsatzentscheidungen, setzt Prioritäten und schaffst die Voraussetzungen dafür, dass das EVOLVE planbar, effizient und zukunftsfähig wachsen kann. Über EVOLVE Digital EVOLVE Digital ist eine spezialisierte E-Commerce- und Performance-Marketing-Agentur mit einem klaren Fokus auf skalierbare Wachstumssysteme, strukturierte Prozesse und messbare Ergebnisse. EVOLVE Digital bietet dir ein Umfeld mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem Team aus 20+ erfahrenen Spezialisten. Es ist ein Umfeld für Führungspersönlichkeiten, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Komplexität beherrschen und Organisationen nachhaltig auf Skalierung ausrichten wollen. Deine Aufgaben im Überblick Du baust nicht nur die Prozesse im Hintergrund. Du sorgst im Alltag dafür, dass unser Unternehmen und das gesamte Team reibungsloser funktionieren: Deadlines werden eingehalten, Aufgaben abgeschlossen, Projekte kommen voran. Denn die besten Prozesse bringen nichts, wenn niemand nachhält, ob sie greifen. Genau das ist deine Aufgabe. Was das im Alltag heißt: Du übersetzt die Jahres- und Quartalsziele in konkrete Maßnahmen, Meilensteine und Checklisten. So bleibt die Strategie im Alltag greifbar. Du sorgst dafür, dass das EVOLVE OS als ganzheitliches System und Kern unserer Dienstleistung funktioniert und sich fortlaufend weiterentwickelt Du steuerst die operativen Abläufe vor allem innerhalb der Agentur und bei Bedarf zusätzlich in Finance und People Ops, von Rechnungswesen über Onboarding. Du entwickelst KPI-Dashboards und Übersichten, wo sie benötigt und sinnvoll sind. Du führst neue Automationen und Prozesse über Claude, Make und n8n ein. items.description: Job Title Project Monitoring Officer Location Global Position Type Paid - Regular Job Description The Project Monitoring Officer plays a critical role in supporting SIL's expanding Resource Development strategy by ensuring the effective coordination, monitoring, and reporting of projects that support organizational and staff fundraising efforts. As SIL continues to grow its network of donors, grantors, and funding partners, this position serves as a central hub for collecting and managing project information, facilitating collaboration across departments, and ensuring that project proposals and reports meet the highest standards of quality, accuracy, and donor compliance. This globally focused role is responsible for overseeing the systematic collection, analysis, tracking, and reporting of project data to support grant management, fundraising initiatives, and strategic decision-making. The Project Monitoring Officer works closely with project leaders, fundraisers, and organizational stakeholders to develop compelling proposals, monitor project progress, measure outcomes, and provide timely reporting that strengthens donor relationships and demonstrates impact. Additionally, the position serves as a key liaison between SIL and ETEN Alliance, fostering strong partnership engagement, coordinating cross-functional initiatives, and ensuring alignment of shared goals and reporting requirements. The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, relationship-oriented, and motivated by supporting successful fundraising outcomes that enable SIL to advance its mission and expand its global impact. Responsibilities Project Intake, Proposal Development, and Stakeholder Coordination Serve as the primary point of contact for Areas, SCOs, and project leaders regarding project intake, proposal development, and reporting requirements. Manage project intake processes to ensure submitted projects have appropriate leadership endorsement, align with organizational priorities, demonstrate funding potential, and support measurable outcomes. Review and strengthen project concept notes, project descriptions, impact statements, and budgets to meet donor and funding partner expectations. Coordinate with project leaders and stakeholders to gather information necessary for proposal development and donor communications. Facilitate ongoing communication regarding project expectations, reporting requirements, accountability measures, and funding opportunities. Collaborate with internal departments to collect project stories, impact narratives, testimonials, and related content for donor reports, annual reports, websites, email campaigns, and stewardship communications. Project Registry and Reporting Management Maintain a comprehensive project registry and filing system that serves as the central repository for project information, proposals, reports, donor requirements, and related documentation. Manage project tracking systems, including funding coordination, proposal status, reporting schedules, and project documentation. Maintain reporting calendars and proactively communicate reporting deadlines to project leaders and funding recipients. Coordinate the collection, review, and submission of financial and narrative reports in accordance with donor agreements and organizational requirements. Support the development, formatting, editing, and distribution of project proposals and progress reports using approved organizational templates and standards. Ensure project files remain current, organized, and accessible to authorized stakeholders. Track donor requirements, reporting obligations, giving page support needs, and process improvements to enhance operational effectiveness. Funding Administration Support Coordinate project-related donation processing activities with gift administration and finance teams. Support accurate allocation of project funding, indirect cost recovery, and funding transfers. Maintain project funding records and update project tracking systems accordingly. Communicate project awards, funding decisions, reporting expectations, and compliance requirements to project recipients. Monitor project financial activity to support accurate reporting and donor accountability. Alliance Partnership Management Serve as a primary liaison between related partners. Maintain regular communication and engagement processes that support strong partner relationships and coordinated action. Represent SIL priorities, constraints, and outcomes in partnership discussions while ensuring partner expectations are clearly communicated internally. Establish and maintain systems to track funded activities, grant commitments, deliverables, and reporting obligations. Curate, validate, manage, and analyze project and operational data associated with funded activities. Generate reports, dashboards, and data insights to support grant reporting, organizational learning, performance evaluation, and strategic decision-making. Facilitate proposal development, grant reporting, project implementation tracking, and compliance monitoring across multiple departments and partner organizations. Ensure partnership commitments, deliverables, and reporting requirements are completed accurately and on schedule. Skills and Abilities Strong project coordination and project management capabilities while managing multiple priorities Excellent organizational, planning, and deadline-management skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders across multiple countries, cultures, and departments. Proficiency in preparing, editing, formatting, and reviewing proposals, reports, and project documentation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. Competence in data collection, tracking, reporting, and analysis. Demonstrated initiative, follow-through, and commitment to continuous improvement. Education Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Nonprofit Management or related field preferred Travel Requirements Occasional domestic and international travel may be required, including attendance at approved in-person meetings, training events, and partner engagements. Weekly Hours 40 Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, USA Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions. Why you'll love this role StockX has redefined the global marketplace for culture — where buyers and sellers transact with confidence on an always-on digital exchange. We are building the next frontier of creator-driven, culturally rich commerce that blends excitement, community, expertise, and transaction in one platform. This initiative is designed to empower sellers and creators to build sustainable businesses while creating moments that drive deep engagement. To support this effort, we are forming a category-led Go-To-Market organization that scales with culture, category dynamics, and community expertise. The Category Manager is a foundational hire tasked with owning the growth and strategic trajectory of a major category. You will serve as the chief operator, strategist, and market voice for your category — identifying opportunity, building pipelines, and driving seller and creator engagement from early stages through scale. This role blends strategic planning, deep customer and market understanding, and hands-on execution, with full ownership of category growth outcomes. You will work closely with Partnerships, Marketing, Product, and Operations to define and accelerate the path to liquidity, engagement, and monetization within your category. What You’ll Do Category Strategy & Ownership Define the strategic vision and growth plan for your category on the platform Become a deep expert on the category’s supply landscape, demand drivers, community channels, and competitive dynamics Establish metrics and quarterly goals to measure and drive category performance Supply & Community Acquisition Build a robust pipeline of sellers, creators, influencers, and shops within your category Drive outbound outreach, onboarding, and enablement for high-potential sellers Cultivate long-term relationships with strategic sellers and community leaders Cross-Functional Go-To-Market Execution Partner with our Account and Partnerships Managers to scale seller engagement and support Collaborate with Category Marketing Managers to architect high-impact launches, moments, and campaigns Represent category needs and insights to Product and Engineering to improve seller tools, features, and platform performance Category Performance & Analytics Use data to diagnose growth opportunities, identify bottlenecks, and optimize playbooks Track supply, engagement, retention, and revenue trends and adjust strategies in real time Surface actionable insights to Growth leadership and cross-functional stakeholders Culture & Community Leadership Act as the platform’s representative within your category’s ecosystem Engage deeply with community norms, vernacular, and cultural drivers to inform both strategy and execution Champion creator and seller needs internally to ensure authentic, category-led growth About you Experienced GTM / Growth Operator: 5+ years in business development, partnerships, category management, or marketplace growth roles; experience in consumer platforms or two-sided marketplaces preferred Strategic Thinker + Doer: Comfortable defining vision while executing in ambiguous, fast-moving environments Relationship-Driven: Able to build trust quickly with sellers, creators, and internal partners Data Fluent: Makes decisions informed by data and measures what matters Community Minded: Understands cultural nuance, category subcultures, and trends that drive engagement Nice to Have Existing network within the assigned category (e.g., sneaker resellers, influencer communities, boutique shops) Marketplace experience across both supply and demand sides Experience with creator monetization platforms, community-driven commerce, or enthusiast ecosystems Comfort with CRM tools, sales pipelines, analytics dashboards, and seller performance metrics Why This Role Matters As one of the first Category Managers supporting this new commerce initiative, you will: Set the playbook for how categories scale on an emerging platform Shape how StockX engages sellers, creators, and communities at scale Build the foundation of a repeatable, category-centric GTM / Growth engine that expands into new verticals This role is both strategic and entrepreneurial, with meaningful ownership and the opportunity to influence the trajectory of a high-potential new product. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation. Pursuant to the Colorado Fair Pay Act, the base salary range in Colorado for this position is $120,000 to $130,000, plus opportunities for benefits (e.g., medical, dental), equity and discretionary bonuses. Compensation in other geographies may vary. About StockX StockX is proud to be a Detroit-based technology leader focused on the large and growing online market for sneakers, apparel, accessories, electronics, collectibles, trading cards, and more. StockX's powerful platform connects buyers and sellers of high-demand consumer goods from around the world using dynamic pricing mechanics. This approach affords access and market visibility powered by real-time data that empowers buyers and sellers to determine and transact based on market value. The StockX platform features hundreds of brands across verticals including Jordan Brand, adidas, Nike, Supreme, BAPE, Off-White, Louis Vuitton, Gucci; collectibles from brands including LEGO, KAWS, Bearbrick, and Pop Mart; and electronics from industry-leading manufacturers Sony, Microsoft, Meta, and Apple. Launched in 2016, StockX employs 1,000 people across offices and verification centers around the world. Learn more at www.stockx.com. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. However, this job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of qualifications, skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities or working conditions associated with the position. StockX reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. StockX may utilize AI to rank job applicant submissions against the position requirements to assist in determining candidate alignment. items.summary: Headquarters: Macedonia / Georgia / Moldova / Romania / Greece / Croatia / Kosovo / Serbia URL: http://belkins.io In 2017, Belkins started as an appointment-setting agency with just one service offering. Fast-forward to today, and we've transformed into Belkins Group — a vibrant ecosystem of services and products that define the cutting-edge landsc
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Macedonia / Georgia / Moldova / Romania / Greece / Croatia / Kosovo / Serbia URL: http://belkins.io In 2017, Belkins started as an appointment-setting agency with just one service offering. Fast-forward to today, and we've transformed into Belkins Group — a vibrant ecosystem of services and products that define the cutting-edge landscape of the SalesTech and MarTech industries. For seven years running, we’ve been the top appointment-setting agency, achieving amazing results across 50+ industries worldwide. Our results speak for themselves: with over 1,000 clients and a global portfolio, we’ve set up more than 200,000 appointments, delivering a $10 return for every $1 spent. We’re experts in B2B appointment setting, providing essential services for companies ready to take their growth to the next level. By diving deep into lead research and using customized, omnichannel strategies, we turn opportunities into real success. Joining Belkins means signing up for a journey of unstoppable growth and success, driven by curiosity, dedication, and a commitment to excellence. We are looking for a results-driven SDR to join our intake pod - the team that runs new clients through their first three months at Belkins. Each pod is built around an Account Strategist who owns client strategy through the pilot, supported by a Delivery Lead, Content Strategist, Researcher, and Email Deliverability Specialist. This structure means the technical side of outreach is handled for you - your focus is on calling and converting prospect responses into booked appointments. You will work across multiple pilot-stage client projects at once (typically 3-4), running high-volume cold calling via power dialer and personally managing all replies from automated email and LinkedIn campaigns. Because every account is brand new, the meetings you book in the first weeks carry extra weight - they're often a client's first real proof that the engagement is working. Things You’ll Be Doing: Cold Calling Running outbound calling campaigns via power dialer (Koncert) across multiple (3-4) pilot-stage client projects at once - every account brand-new, so there's no history to lean on and no slow ramp-up; Handling objections live, on the call, and steering each conversation toward a booked appointment, not just working through a script; Tracking connect rate and call-to-meeting conversion, flagging performance issues to your Account Strategist before they become a pattern - with only three months on the clock, a slow week can't go unnoticed. Reply Handling — Email & LinkedIn Personally owning every reply that comes in from automated email (Reply.io / Inbox AI) and LinkedIn (Expandi) campaigns -responding within 4–8 working hours, handling objections in writing, and nurturing prospects until they convert into confirmed meetings; Scheduling appointments and sharing meeting details with the team via Slack. Campaign Oversight & Reporting Monitoring key metrics across every project - connect rate, reply rate, conversion rate - as your own numbers, not someone else's dashboard. Feeding structured feedback to Research, Content, and EDS so lead quality and messaging actually improve, not just flagging that something isn't working. Keeping CRM hygiene tight in HubSpot and sharing a weekly recap your Account Strategist can actually use. What You Bring: 2+ years of outbound SDR experience with a strong cold calling background ; Fluent English - written and spoken - comfortable working across US and European time zones; Metrics-driven: you track your dials, connect rates, and conversion numbers and know how to improve them; Strong objection handling and a consistent track record of landing next steps; Comfortable working brand-new accounts with no track record yet, and able to manage multiple pilot-stage client projects in parallel without losing quality or pace; Reliable CRM hygiene and disciplined follow-up across all open threads; Self-starting and proactive - you hold your pace without needing external pressure. How We Hire: Recruiter Interview (~30 minutes) — with Yuliia or Inna. Practical Task (~60–90 minutes) — a written exercise covering outbound thinking, objection handling, and lead prioritization. Hiring Manager Interview (~45–60 minutes) — a conversation with the SDR Enablement Manager covering the details of your work, performance analytics, and a live cold-call roleplay. Final Interview (~60 minutes) — with the Managing Director and HR Business Partner to assess company fit and explore your values and working style. Offer & Onboarding — if it's a yes, we move fast. *We may use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process. Final decisions are made by humans. Contact us for information on data processing. At Belkins, we care deeply about our team members, and we prove it through: Competitive Pay: Your dedication deserves more than recognition; it deserves compensation that matches your expertise. Remote-First Flexibility: We’ve transitioned to a fully remote environment so you can work where you're most productive. Our flexible hours help you stay agile and focused. Professional Growth: We’re a launchpad for your career. Through regular feedback, 1:1s, internal mobility, and knowledge-sharing, your growth is enabled and celebrated. We also maintain an internal wiki for insights and a library of the latest business books to keep you sharp. Well-being focus: Your mental health is a priority. We offer mental health lectures and support for your overall well-being. Recharge Time: We prioritize your rest with 20 paid vacation days, parental leave, fully covered sick days, and unlimited days off for unexpected needs. Global Sync: We align with U.S. holidays to keep our global teams in sync. Memorable Team Experiences: Work hard, play hard — even from a distance. Our online team-building events and all-hands gatherings bring humor, memes, and a lively atmosphere that makes teamwork genuinely fun. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/belkins-sales-development-representative-intake-pod

items.title: Senior Product Manager - Data Product (API & MCP)
items.summary: SE Ranking, an all-in-one SEO and digital marketing platform, is seeking a Senior Product Manager to scale our Data Product - our API and MCP offering - from early traction into a repeatable, scalable revenue line.
items.description: SE Ranking , an all-in-one SEO and digital marketing platform, is seeking a Senior Product Manager to scale our Data Product - our API and MCP offering - from early traction into a repeatable, scalable revenue line. We've already gone from 0 to 1: we have paying API customers, a fast-growing MCP that recently overtook our classic API in daily unique users, and partners building agentic workflows on top of our data. Now we need someone to own the entire revenue funnel and turn that momentum into further growth of MCP usage and Data MRR. If you get excited about turning a data & developer product into a growth engine - and about making SE Ranking the marketing intelligence infrastructure for AI agents - then this role is for you. Key Responsibilities: You will report directly to Mike Korenugin , VP of Product, and own the entire funnel for the Data Product (API + MCP) : from acquisition and activation, to sales enablement, to onboarding, retention, and expansion. You'll drive two connected revenue engines - net-new MRR from API and Data customers, and net dollar retention (NDR) by embedding MCP and agentic workflows into the core SEO jobs our customers do every day. You'll lead a focused squad with Aleksander Germatsky as your Engineering Manager and Senior Engineers Dominik Stypula and Mikhail Liubushkin shipping the endpoints, infrastructure, and developer experience that make the product sell and stick. On go-to-market, you'll partner daily with Valentyna Havryliuk , our PMM driving API & MCP adoption, and with Alexey Trusevich , the dedicated Account Executive for the Data Product. Beyond your squad, you'll work closely with Demand Gen, SEO, Growth, and PR on getting the product discovered and promoted; with Sales & Success and Support on closing and retaining customers; and with the Data team on coverage, accuracy, and the endpoints customers ask for. Your job is to connect all of these into one growth motion. Initial Focus Areas: Craft a strategy for Data Product with two goals in mind Grow Data revenue : understand our current packaging and pricing gaps across plans & products, the PAYG funnel, and credit packs; define a clear, repeatable motion for upmarket deals. Define the inputs (acquisition, activation, expansion) that move the number and hold the product to them. Drive MCP usage and capabilities: own the MCP adoption track as a strong NDR lever. Scale the adoption flows and lifecycle upsells, close capability gaps customers hit, and make the Claude, ChatGPT, and n8n connector experiences feel amazing. Ramp up solution engineering for Sales & Success: we’ve got a new person starting as solution engineer and strong L3 technical support, but they would often need your help and insight to unblock AEs and CSMs on credit provisioning, key generation, quota changes, connector troubleshooting; and translating prospect requirements into solutions that win deals. Learn how Demand Gen & Outbound is connected to Product: partner with PMM and Demand Gen to scale what's working - workshops and MCP bootcamps, ABM, spokespeople and influencer content, PR, and SEO - and to sharpen the website. Help us find exciting API/MCP use cases from top clients and influencers and turn them into content and sales enablement assets. Long-Term Responsibilities: Make the Data Product a repeatable, scalable revenue line: evolve packaging, pricing, and the self-serve funnel so growth doesn't depend on heroics. Use signals from won and lost deals, usage, and feedback to generate strong hypotheses and continuously improve win rates, activation, and expansion. Grow MCP into the default "agentic SEO" workflow: keep MCP workflows healthy and lead the move from data to action, so customers believe SE Ranking is the way to automate SEO with AI agents - defending NDR and opening natural paths to expansion and win-back. Build a real solution-engineering function: grow from firefighting into a system - documentation, tooling, and onboarding that let customers discover and integrate our API and MCP, and let Sales & Success move fast without engineering in the loop. Expand endpoint & data coverage from the voice of the customer: translate prospect and customer feedback into a prioritized roadmap for new endpoints and data (e.g. URL-level GSC, prompt generation, Local Marketing and AIRT coverage), and partner with the Data team on accuracy and the questions buyers ask about how the data is sourced and validated. Be a strategic GTM partner across teams: surface trade-offs, unblock cross-team dependencies, and keep Product, Demand Gen, Sales, Success, and Data aligned as priorities and timelines shift. We are destined to be if you have: Launched new B2B products and taken them from 0 to 1 , leading Sales Enablement and deeply engaging with Demand Gen to achieve GTM success. Owned a revenue funnel end to end - acquisition, activation, sales enablement, onboarding, retention, and expansion - and know how to grow TOFU and help close deals. Built API-first or data products that offer a great self-served developer experience but don't completely puzzle out business stakeholders. Hands-on, practical AI experience and genuine excitement about MCP and agentic workflows - and ideas about how a data product becomes the tool of choice inside tools like Claude and Codex. Acted as a technical partner to Sales & Success , supporting demos, prospect setups, and troubleshooting, and turning that into product and tooling improvements. Either direct experience in SEO / AI Search , or a track record of ramping quickly in a new and technical domain - and the appetite to do so here. Explained complex concepts and strategies so that your team, fellow PMs, Designers, Senior Leaders, Support, Success, and Sales reps as well as users all understood you easily. Managed stakeholders' expectations with grace as delivery dates shift and plans change. Embraced the constant change of a startup. Great spoken English. * If you feel strongly that you have what it takes for this role but don't technically tick all the boxes - apply anyway, just highlight what you'd bring to the table. Tools we use for work: Self-served product analytics: Amplitude, PowerBI, Grafana In-app guides and surveys: Amplitude, Typeform Session replay: LogRocket User feedback: Enterpret, Avoma, Zendesk tickets & NPS, Brightback Tasks, roadmaps, documentation: Linear, Miro, Notion Communication: Slack Claude Code / Cowork to bring it all together. What we offer: 22 days of paid time off, plus your local national holidays Flexible work hours and a culture that trusts you to manage your time Private medical insurance or a medical allowance (depending on your location) Extended paid sick leave so you can fully recover without worry Career map with growth opportunities Support for wellbeing and L&D Best hardware for your work (team Apple) An award-winning product loved by thousands of customers worldwide A transparent, flexible culture with people at the core of everything we do Events that are actually fun Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: About Logos (λ) Logos (λ) is a movement of technologists, creatives, strategists, and activists working together to build a sovereign, people-owned technology stack that revitalises civil society and protects digital liberties at scale. This position is within the IFT Technical Services (IFT-TS) Distributed Systems Testing (DST) Team, a team that primarily supports Logos, while also contributing to other IFT projects. The role We are seeking an experienced Distributed Systems Evaluation Engineer to join the Institute of Free Technology - Technical Services, on the Distributed Systems Testing (IFT-TS DST) team. This role focuses on rigorously assessing the performance and reliability of IFT projects at scale, where Logos (λ) is one of them. Logos (λ) technology stack is composed of 3 main components: Logos (λ) Blockchain : Advanced privacy for a new era of decentralised applications and social institutions. Logos (λ) Messaging : Private peer‑to‑peer communication that resists surveillance and censorship. Logos (λ) Storage : Secure decentralised storage enabling fully decentralised apps and file sharing. We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic DevOps Engineer to join our Distributed Systems Testing (DST) team. You’ll be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive evaluation strategies, leveraging both large-scale lab deployments and protocol behavior modeling scripts. Your expertise will be crucial in analyzing these complex distributed systems, automating intricate test scenarios, and providing in-depth insights into system behaviors. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you’ll troubleshoot complex issues and translate technical data into actionable recommendations. Proficiency in containerization, cloud technologies, and distributed systems principles is essential. Key responsibilities Design, configure, and optimize Kubernetes clusters to support large-scale experiments and benchmarks of P2P technologies. Continuously improve cluster scalability and resource utilization, enabling increasingly complex deployments and experiments. Set up, maintain, and optimize supporting infrastructure such as monitoring, logging, and observability stacks (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, etc.). Collaborate with DST researchers and engineers to streamline experimentation workflows and make analysis easier and more reproducible. Automate infrastructure and deployment workflows to increase reliability and reduce overhead. Troubleshoot, profile, and tune distributed workloads to ensure accurate and performant benchmarking. Identify, reproduce, and debug complex issues in distributed systems, working closely with Logos development teams. You ideally will have Strong experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration in production or research environments. Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure, Linux systems, and networking (especially relevant to distributed/P2P systems). Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (Grafana, Prometheus, VictoriaLogs, etc.). Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible, Helm, etc.). Proficiency in at least one scripting/programming language (ideally Python). Interest in or experience with distributed systems, P2P networks, or blockchain technologies. Experience with networks and systems programming. Excellent written and conversational communication skills. Alignment with our core values and principles. Bonus points Hands-on experience with libp2p or projects in the Logos collective. Background in performance benchmarking, scalability testing, or systems research. Contributions to open source projects. Experience working for an open-source organization. Interview Process Interview with our POps team Interview with team member from the IFT-TS DST team Take-home assignment and discussion of results Interview with IFT-TS team lead

items.title: HMDA Specialist
items.summary: We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and experienced HMDA Specialist to join our team.
items.description: We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and experienced HMDA Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the accurate collection, validation, and reporting of loan data in compliance with the Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA) . This position requires deep familiarity with the mortgage origination process and a strong ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities Review, analyze, and validate loan application data for HMDA reporting compliance. Maintain data integrity and ensure timely submission of the LAR (Loan Application Register). Identify and resolve HMDA data discrepancies across loan files and systems. Monitor the accuracy of demographic, disposition, and transactional data in Encompass. Collaborate with internal teams including processing, underwriting, and compliance to ensure HMDA-related issues are properly documented and resolved. Generate ad hoc reports from Encompass as needed to support audits, quality control, and operational needs. Stay up-to-date with changes to HMDA regulation and advise the team accordingly. Assist with internal and external audits or regulatory examinations related to HMDA compliance. Support ongoing training and education of staff to promote HMDA awareness and compliance best practices. Skills, Knowledge and Expertise Proficiency in Encompass and strong understanding of its functionality as it relates to HMDA data. Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills including: Adding columns and reformatting spreadsheets Filtering data Performing basic formulas (subtraction, IF statements, VLOOKUP) Strong understanding of the mortgage origination process , from application through processing, underwriting, and closing Familiarity with loan documentation and the data fields critical to HMDA reporting. Solid knowledge of the adverse loan process , including: Denials Withdrawn applications Closed for incompleteness Approved but not accepted transactions Ability to think critically and solve problems creatively , without full reliance on a predefined checklist or process. High attention to detail and accuracy. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work independently while collaborating cross-functionally within the organization. 2+ years of direct HMDA reporting experience within a mortgage lending environment. Prior experience in a compliance, quality control, or mortgage operations role. Familiarity with additional compliance regulations (e.g., ECOA, RESPA, TRID) is a plus. Benefits Above market salary HMO on Day 1 for principal and two dependents Government-mandated benefits Performance-based Incentives Quarterly Company Events 1,000 PHP De Minimis Equipment and software provided Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: We are seeking a Project and Quality Administrator (Quality Systems) to provide project administration and data coordination support across multiple active projects. The role will maintain accurate project records, coordinate quality documentation, monitor outstanding tasks, prepare reports, and support audit readiness while working closely with internal teams to ensure project information remains complete, accurate, and up to date. Provide project administration and data coordination support across multiple active projects. Gather, maintain, and update project information, quality records, and supporting documentation. Manage project data and assigned tasks using Deltek, Jira, CRM, and other project management systems. Prepare and distribute reports, dashboards, and project performance information using available data. Monitor outstanding documentation, actions, deadlines, and quality requirements, proactively following up with stakeholders. Maintain accurate, complete, and auditable records to support quality assurance processes and audit readiness. Identify missing or inaccurate information, resolve discrepancies, escalate issues, and support continuous improvement of project workflows. Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in data coordination, project administration, project coordination, quality systems administration, or a similar role. Hands-on experience with Deltek is essential. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft 365, including data management, reporting, and documentation. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate with stakeholders and follow up on outstanding information. Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in maintaining project records, reports, and system data. items.summary: Position Type : Full-time Location: Philippines (Remote) Schedule: Mon-Fri, EST About the Company Our client is a global leader in swimming pool technology, specializing in robotic pool cleaners, pool safety products, water treatment solutions, and related pool equipment for residential and commercial customers. With a strong international presence and a network of distributors, subsidiaries, and partners across multiple markets, our client serves customers worldwide through a variety of sales and distribution channels. About the Role Our client is looking for a Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst to monitor online marketplaces and digital channels across North America and Europe. The role focuses on identifying unauthorized sellers, marketplace and distribution violations, misuse of brand assets, and other compliance issues. You will conduct online research, analyze seller and product data, maintain accurate records, and prepare reports that provide actionable insights to the business. Responsibilities Monitor Amazon, eBay, Walmart, BestBuy, Home Depot, AliExpress, Temu, and other major marketplaces. Research products and identify new or unauthorized sellers. Classify sellers and verify their authorization status. Identify MAP, distribution, territory, and marketplace compliance issues. Monitor unauthorized use of logos, images, trademarks, and product content. Collect evidence such as URLs, screenshots, seller information, and product details. Maintain accurate seller databases and internal records. Prepare daily reports and monthly Voice of Consumer reports. Build and maintain dashboards tracking brand-protection metrics. Identify opportunities to improve research and reporting processes. Competencies and Qualifications Must-Have 3+ years of experience in data analysis, online research, e-commerce, compliance, or a related field. Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables. Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy. Strong written English and reporting skills. Ability to work independently and follow SOPs. Familiarity with Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces. Nice-to-Have Brand protection or marketplace compliance experience. Experience with PROWL, Helium 10, Salesforce, or similar tools. Knowledge of MAP, distribution, or channel compliance. Experience with dashboards and reporting. Experience using AI research and translation tools. Key Qualities Detail-oriented Analytical Investigative Highly organized What We Offer 100% Remote Work â Work from anywhere in the Philippines. Career Growth Opportunities â Gain hands-on experience, and continuous learning. Collaborative & Innovative Team â Work alongside skilled professionals who value excellence. Application Process We understand that searching for a new job can be challenging, and weâre here to support you every step of the way.
